izzyondroid:dev.dettmer.simplenotes.name: Simple Notes Sync
izzyondroid:dev.dettmer.simplenotes.summary: Offline notes & checklists, self-hosted sync. Under 5 MB, no ads, no tracking.
izzyondroid:dev.dettmer.simplenotes.description:
Simple Notes Sync is a calm, private home for your notes and checklists. Everything lives on your device. When you want it everywhere, it syncs to your own server - no account, no cloud, no tracking. Ever.
 It stays out of your way: the whole app is under 5 MB, starts instantly, and works fully offline.
 ORGANIZE * Text notes and checklists with tap-to-check and drag & drop * Colored folders to sort everything your way * Pin important notes to the top * Grid or list view, 1-5 columns * Sort by title, date, or type
 YOUR SERVER, YOUR RULES * Sync with any WebDAV server (Nextcloud, ownCloud, and more) * Use it across phone, tablet, and desktop * Decide when it syncs: on save, on open, on Wi-Fi, periodically, or on boot * Wi-Fi-only sync, VPN support, parallel transfers, self-signed SSL * Live sync progress, smart conflict resolution, server-deletion detection
 COMING FROM ANOTHER APP? * Import your Google Keep archive (notes, checklists, labels) * Import and export Markdown for Obsidian, VS Code, Typora * Encrypted local backup & restore
 SHARE & EXPORT * Share notes as text or PDF * Export to your calendar
 BEAUTIFUL & LIGHT * Modern Material 3 interface built with Jetpack Compose * 7 color schemes including AMOLED black and Dynamic Color * Home-screen widgets: quick note and interactive checklist * Battery-friendly background sync
 PRIVATE BY DESIGN * No account, no ads, no tracking libraries * Your data never touches our servers - because we don't have any * Open source (AGPL-3.0) and under 5 MB, on a modern, well-tested Kotlin codebase
 Source code: https://github.com/inventory69/simple-notes-sync

izzyondroid:rkr.tinykeyboard.inputmethod.name: Tiny Keyboard
izzyondroid:rkr.tinykeyboard.inputmethod.description:
Android OS contains a default Keyboard and KeyboardView implementations (deprecated as of Android 10, but still available). Input method developers can use these classes as base for their own keyboard implementations. Tiny Keyboard is an implementation without any changes.
 Smallest possible APK size of 22kB (as of version 0.3)
 Permissions: 0
 Features: it has keys
 Supported layouts: en_US
 No Launcher icon and Settings
 To enable the keyboard: 
 Go to: System Settings - Language and Input - Virtual Keyboard - Manage Keyboards (path may be different across Android versions and brands).
 Enable the Tiny Keyboard (you my get a default warning about tracking, don't worry, it can't track what you type due to the lack of Network permission)
 Switch to Tiny Keyboard from current Input Method (differs between keyboards, usually long-press space)

fdroid:app.tvviewer.player.name: TV Viewer - IPTV Streaming
fdroid:app.tvviewer.player.summary: Free open-source IPTV player with community channels and opt-in analytics.
fdroid:app.tvviewer.player.description:
TV Viewer is a free, open-source IPTV streaming app built around community-maintained playlists and privacy-first design.
Features:
• Live TV and radio channels from community-maintained sources
• Community Statistics page with anonymous aggregated usage insights
• Timezone-based country detection (no GPS or IP lookup needed)
• Background audio playback for radio streams
• Multi-source failover when one stream stops working
• Search, favorites, source selector, and watch history
• Picture-in-Picture (PiP) support where available
• No account required and no ads
• Optional usage and playback analytics (opt-in only)
• Optional community sharing is off by default; when enabled, health reports
 use URL hashes and new playlist channels may be shared with their stream URLs
• Self-hosted web/Docker edition also available
• Regular updates with new channels and fixes from the community
Privacy:
• No account or contact details collected
• No account or login required
• Analytics are off by default; optional playback events include channel names
 and URL hashes that can be matched to known streams
• Channel health reports and automatic playlist contributions are off by default
 and can be enabled in Settings; URL hashes may be matched to known stream URLs
• Country detection uses device timezone only
• All source code is open and auditable
This app does not host or provide any streams. It aggregates publicly available M3U playlists maintained by the open-source community (iptv-org and others). Channel availability depends on the source providers.
Network services:
• Channel playlists are fetched from community and third-party hosts
• FMStream.org is queried for public radio-station listings
• Supabase provides the shared channel database, aggregated community statistics, optional analytics, and URL-hashed channel-health exchange
• Analytics and channel health/playlist contributions require separate opt-ins
Permissions:
• Internet: Required to stream content
• Wake Lock: Keeps playback active when needed
• Foreground Service: Background audio playback notification

fdroid:com.biketrackd.app.name: BikeTrackd
fdroid:com.biketrackd.app.summary: A cycling speedometer and GPS tracker with offline maps and bike maintenance
fdroid:com.biketrackd.app.description:
BikeTrackd is a cycling speedometer and GPS tracker built for Android with Jetpack Compose and Material 3.
Features:
• Real-time speedometer with animated counter and color gradient (green → yellow → red)
• GPS map with MapLibre GL, trail tracking, follow mode, and rotation
• Session recording with distance, max/avg speed, and duration persisted via Room
• GPX export for any recorded session
• Current weather display via Open-Meteo API
• Offline map tiles download (zoom 10–14, 40 km radius)
• Battery level indicator
• Metric/imperial unit toggle with live conversion
• Landscape and portrait optimized layouts
• Bike and parts management with wear tracking and maintenance alerts
• Speed limit warning
• Burn-in protection for OLED screens
• Adjustable font size
• Multiple languages (English, Portuguese)
Network services:
• Open-Meteo for weather display
• OpenFreeMap for online map tiles (optional offline downloads available)
• OpenStreetMap Nominatim for city search
• GraphHopper for A→B route navigation, using your own free API key (optional; unused without a key)

fdroid:com.dowardev.onespend.name: OneSpend
fdroid:com.dowardev.onespend.summary: Expense and budget tracker that works offline, with optional self-hosted sync
fdroid:com.dowardev.onespend.description:
OneSpend is an offline-first personal finance manager. (i) Sync is opt-in: the app never connects to a hardcoded server - the user picks the backend URL in Ajustes -> Conexiones (the bundled default is the author's public server, only used if the user enables sync, and overridable in-app without a rebuild). (ii) UI is wrapped for es + en; the language selector is in the side menu.
**Default servers** — the build ships with these defaults, which you can override in `Settings → Connections` after install:
* Sync server: `https://onespend-back.dowar.xyz`
* SSO server: `https://auth.dowar.xyz/api` (login panel: `https://auth-panel.dowar.xyz`)
The author maintains these as a public service for anyone who does not want to self-host. To use a self-hosted sync server and/or SSO, change the URLs in the Connections screen (no rebuild needed). The SSO source is public at `https://gitlab.com/dowardev/sso`.

fdroid:com.earendel.tapbar.name: Tapbar
fdroid:com.earendel.tapbar.summary: Launch apps or quick actions from the status bar or anywhere on your screen
fdroid:com.earendel.tapbar.description:
Tapbar lets you create tappable zones anywhere on your screen. Tap a zone to open an app, run a quick action, or use an app shortcut, without opening the app drawer.
GESTURES
* Single tap, double tap, triple tap and long press, each with its own app, action or app shortcut
* Four independent tap zones, each with its own position, size and gestures
* Swipe gestures for adjusting volume and brightness
ACTIONS
* Open any installed app or app shortcut
* 75+ quick actions: flashlight, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Do Not Disturb, battery, sound, location, data usage, screenshot, power menu and more
CUSTOMIZATION
* Customize the position and size of each tap zone
* Edit numeric values directly
* Supports both portrait and landscape layouts
SMART BEHAVIOR
* Pause Tapbar in the apps you choose, with a searchable filter list
* Optional start on boot
* Haptic feedback: buzz on every tap, or when the action runs
* Light and dark themes
* Reset all settings with one slide
LANGUAGES
* English, German, Spanish, French, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Nepali, Portuguese, Russian and Chinese
PRIVACY
* Works completely offline. Tapbar has no internet permission, no ads, no trackers and no analytics.
* The optional accessibility service is only used to place the tap zone over the status bar and to know which app is in front, so Tapbar can pause in apps you block. It does not read screen content.
* Without the accessibility service, Tapbar uses the overlay permission instead.
PERMISSIONS
* Display over other apps: Draws the tap zone
* Accessibility service: Places the zone on the status bar and detects the foreground app
* Notifications: Shows the service notification
* Do Not Disturb access and Modify system settings: Only for the actions that need them
* See all apps: Lists your apps in the app picker
* Start at boot: Optional auto start
Tapbar is free and open source under the MIT license.

fdroid:com.newsrssreader.name: Lenta Reader
fdroid:com.newsrssreader.summary: Unofficial reader for the Lenta.ru news RSS feeds
fdroid:com.newsrssreader.description:
A news reader for the public RSS feeds of Lenta.ru, a Russian news site. This is an unofficial app: it is not affiliated with or endorsed by Lenta.ru.
It only reads the news — no accounts, no comments, no recommendations. The interface and the news themselves are in Russian only; there is no English translation.
 Features 
* Three feeds: top stories, latest, and everything
* A drawer with all 15 sections, from sport to economics
* Full article view: paragraphs, subheadings, photos, pull quotes, info boxes and author bylines
* Read articles are dimmed in the list automatically
* Bookmarks save an article's text and photos for offline reading
* Photos open full screen, with pinch-zoom, and can be sent on through the system share sheet
* Pull past the end of an article to open the next one
 Privacy 
The app collects nothing about you. There is no analytics SDK, no crash reporter, no ads and no trackers — it uses the network only to fetch the feed, the article text and its images.
Free software under the GPLv3; the source is open.

fdroid:com.porter.tvremote.name: TV Remote
fdroid:com.porter.tvremote.summary: Install on your Android TV, then use any phone's browser as the remote
fdroid:com.porter.tvremote.description:
Install this app on your Android TV or Google TV, not on your phone. Your phone needs no app at all: it just opens the TV's address in its browser.
TV Remote turns your Android TV into a self-hosted web remote that any device on your local network can control — phone, tablet, laptop — without installing any app on the controller device.
HOW IT WORKS
The app runs a tiny HTTP server (port 8080) directly on your TV. Open http://<tv-ip>:8080 in any browser and you get a full remote control interface; the TV shows the exact address once you press Start Server. Input is injected via ADB loopback — the app connects to the TV's own ADB daemon at 127.0.0.1:5555, so no root is required.
FEATURES
• D-pad navigation (up, down, left, right, OK/Enter)
• Back, Home, Menu buttons
• Volume up / down / mute
• Power / sleep toggle
• Channel up / down rocker + numeric keypad (0–9)
• Keyboard text input — type into any focused field on the TV
• Google Assistant launch
• Works from any browser on the same LAN — no app needed on the controller
PRIVACY
Completely local. No data leaves your network. No accounts, no telemetry, no analytics, no ads.
REQUIREMENTS
• Android TV or Google TV device (Android 8.0+), with this app installed on the TV
• Developer Options enabled on the TV
• ADB over network enabled (TCP/IP mode, port 5555)
• Both the TV and the controller must be on the same LAN
The app starts automatically on boot and runs as a foreground service to stay alive when the TV is in use.
Open source (MIT) — source code at https://github.com/Legvan/tv-remote

fdroid:com.sidhant.oneline.name: One Line Puzzle
fdroid:com.sidhant.oneline.summary: Draw a single continuous line to connect numbers and completely fill the grid!
fdroid:com.sidhant.oneline.description:
Unleash your logic with One Line, the ultimate daily brain-training puzzle game! 🧠
Looking for a satisfying mental workout? Inspired by classic path-finding mechanics, One Line challenges you to solve intricate grid puzzles using just a single, continuous stroke. It is the perfect game to sharpen your mind during your morning commute, lunch break, or evening wind-down.
How to Play:
1. Start at the number one.
2. Draw a continuous line connecting the sequential numbers in order.
3. The Ultimate Challenge: You must fill every single square on the grid without crossing your own path!

fdroid:com.tacticmaster.name: TacticMaster
fdroid:com.tacticmaster.summary: Chess tactic trainer based on https://database.lichess.org/#puzzles.
fdroid:com.tacticmaster.description:
Tactic Trainer 
 Tactic Trainer is an advanced chess training application designed to help players of all levels improve their tactical skills. With a comprehensive set of features, Tactic Trainer offers an engaging and effective way to practice and master chess tactics.
 Key Features: 
 Interactive Chessboard: The app features an interactive chessboard that allows users to solve puzzles and practice moves directly on the board.
 Extensive Puzzle Library: Access a vast library (100k puzzles) of chess puzzles ranging from 1600 to 3000 levels. Each puzzle is designed to challenge and improve your tactical thinking.
 Puzzle Categories: Puzzles are categorized by themes such as openings, middlegame tactics, and endgames.
 Detailed Puzzle Information: Each puzzle comes with detailed information, including the position, moves, rating, and tags, providing context and helping users understand the tactical themes.
 Performance Tracking: Track your progress with detailed statistics and performance metrics. See how you improve over time and identify areas that need more practice.
 User-Friendly Interface: The app features a clean and intuitive interface, making it easy to navigate and use for players of all ages.
 Offline Access: Puzzles can be practiced offline, ensuring you can train your tactics anytime, anywhere.
 Regular Updates: The app is regularly updated with new puzzles and features, ensuring a fresh and engaging experience.
 Whether you are a beginner looking to learn the basics or an advanced player aiming to sharpen your skills, Tactic Trainer provides the tools and resources you need to become a better chess player. Download Tactic Trainer today and start your journey to mastering chess tactics!

fdroid:com.tuyafeng.watt.name: Watt
fdroid:com.tuyafeng.watt.description:
Watt is an open source Android component management application. It uses pm command to disable or enable components, requires root permissions.
 Features: 
* Disable or enable components(receivers/services/activities) easily
* Block a broadcast so that no app can receive it to wake itself
* Block the bad Keep-Alive services of some apps without errors
* No data collection
* Efficient and simple interface
 Why not IFW? 
In version 2.0, Watt has completely abandoned disabling components through the Intent Firewall, because ifw will cause android10+ devices to keep restarting. In view of this poor performance, Watt 2.0 uses pm commands to refactor the entire application.

fdroid:dev.rubec.otoscope.name: Otoscope
fdroid:dev.rubec.otoscope.summary: Ad-free viewer for WiFi otoscope cameras.
fdroid:dev.rubec.otoscope.description:
Otoscope is a clean, ad-free replacement for the proprietary apps shipped with cheap Wi-Fi otoscope cameras.
The stock companion apps generally bundle lots of ad and analytics SDKs (AdMob, AppLovin, IronSource, MBridge, Vungle, Pangle, Mintegral, etc.) and in-app tracking.
Otoscope reimplements essential connection and viewer functionalities, with nothing else.
Features:
• Discover the camera over Bluetooth Low Energy or Wi-Fi.
• Join the camera's Wi-Fi access point in a one-process scope, so the rest of your traffic isn't affected.
• Live video stream, decoded in-app over the camera's protocol (UDP or RTSP). Pure Kotlin, no FFmpeg, no native blobs.
• Auto-rotation driven by the camera's on-board accelerometer / gyro.
• Horizontal-mirror toggle for self-examination.
• Circular mask matching the otoscope lens.
• Photo and video capture with a built-in gallery to review, share and delete them.
• Optional caption burnt into the corner of each capture to tell what's being recorded.
Supported hardware families:
• Xylla — SSID `Enjoy-XXXXXX` or `JesHome-XXXX`.
• iTiMO — SSID `iTiMO-XXXXXX` or `jetion_XXXX`.
• JEGOAT — SSID `softish-XXXXXX`.
• EarFairy — SSID `Cooleer_XXXXXX`.
• Soulear (i4season) — SSID `Soulear-XXXXX`.
• Y38 — SSID `AIR-ES-XXXXXX`.
Otoscope is GPL-3.0-or-later and contains no third-party trackers, ad SDKs, or proprietary native libraries.

fdroid:godau.fynn.usagedirect.system.name: Museum of a broken API
fdroid:godau.fynn.usagedirect.system.summary: Warns against using a system usage stats API
fdroid:godau.fynn.usagedirect.system.description:
Please install usageDirect instead of this app if you are interested in system usage statistics. 
 This app reflects my experience with the usagae statistics API from a few Android versions ago. It may no longer be current and this app is no longer being maintained. 
The Android system collects app usage statistics in the background; however, native Android contains no way to read out this data properly. That is why I wanted to create a tool to display it. Unfortunately, I had to learn that this data source was riddled with bugs and highly unreliable.
Thus, I converted this application into a museum. It exhibits aggregated usage statistics per day for usually the past ten days, per week for the past four weeks, per month for the past six months as well as data aggregated by year. As a special exhibition, it can display this data as charts.
Design-wise, the app comes in the style of the settings app to highlight that this API is a part of the Android system.
An included Guide to the exhibition names some of the issues you can expect to find on your tour.

fdroid:io.github.iverlein.zanshin.name: Zanshin Calendar
fdroid:io.github.iverlein.zanshin.summary: Tibetan and Japanese calendars with almanac readings, and a meditation timer
fdroid:io.github.iverlein.zanshin.description:
Zanshin Calendar opens on today and shows it as a Tibetan almanac or the old Japanese calendar (旧暦) would: the lunar date, what the day is good for, what to put off, and when the sun rises, stands at noon and sets where you are. Tap a line and it tells you what it means. There is also a meditation timer, a mindfulness bell and a prayer wheel.
 Tibetan calendar, Phugpa (ཕུག་པ, phug pa) 
 The date: lunar day, month and year, including the days the calendar skips or doubles and the leap months.
 Festivals: Losar (ལོ་གསར, lo gsar), Chötrul Düchen (ཆོ་འཕྲུལ་དུས་ཆེན, cho 'phrul dus chen), Saga Dawa Düchen (ས་ག་ཟླ་བའི་དུས་ཆེན, sa ga zla ba'i dus chen), Chökhor Düchen (ཆོས་འཁོར་དུས་ཆེན, chos 'khor dus chen), Lhabab Düchen (ལྷ་བབས་དུས་ཆེན, lha babs dus chen) and others.
 Practice days: the 8th, 10th, 15th, 25th, 29th and the new moon stand in an aureole on a lotus seat, painted as in a thangka, and the 9th and 24th are small days of the Dharma protectors (ཆོས་སྐྱོང, chos skyong). Tap the day's name to see who comes that day, how far merit is multiplied and what to practise.
 A day in brief: the day's factors are weighed in the order the texts rank them, with the hours above the day. You get the tone of the day, the one factor that settles it, and what the lists call good or say to avoid. On today's page the answer follows the present hour.
 Choose a day: pick a wedding, a journey, a haircut or any other work, then a span of one to twelve months. The best days come ranked, with the good hours of each month.
 Your works: the ones you pin come first on the page, each with what the day makes of it. The haircut sits next to them with its good and bad days and hours, and your birth year adds your personal days.
 The hours: a round dial of the day. It marks each hour's combination period, Jupiter's nectar periods, the earth lords of the hour and the black hours. It also says what each hour suits, where the sun's four rough times fall and which works an hour turns against the day.
 The day's signs: lunar mansion, yoga, karaṇa, the element pair of weekday and mansion, and the animal, trigram (སྤར་ཁ, spar kha) and number of the lunar day. All of them have readings, and so do the special days, Rāhu's course, the earth lords and the direction of the astrologer spirit (བླ་མཁྱེན, bla mkhyen).
 Changes within the day: a second mansion, a skipped yoga or the span of Viṣṭi, each with its time, as the almanac of the White Beryl (བཻཌཱུར་དཀར་པོ, bai DUr dkar po) writes them.
 Mewa and links: the date's mewa (སྨེ་བ, sme ba) and what the activity lists hold it good or bad for. The twelve links (རྟེན་འབྲེལ, rten 'brel) are counted from the month's middle term, and each day's link comes with its works, directions and remedy.
 The hundred feet (རྐང་བརྒྱ, rkang brgya): the fangs of the moon, the sun, the five planets and Rāhu when they land on your birth mansion, and the spear and great spear on the moon's mansion.
 Month headings: the almanac opens each month by saying if it is long or short and which planet rises. It goes on to the black months, the seven days of the sage (དྲང་སྲོང, drang srong) and of the pig, and any comet its count marks.
 Eclipses: lunar and solar, found by the karaṇa reckoning (བྱེད་རྩིས, byed rtsis) of the Kālacakra (དུས་འཁོར, dus 'khor) as the almanac does it. They appear on their day with the merit they multiply.

fdroid:io.github.valnesfjord.tgwsproxyrs.name: TG WS Proxy
fdroid:io.github.valnesfjord.tgwsproxyrs.description:
Telegram MTProto WebSocket Bridge Proxy — a Rust vibecoded port of
 Flowseal/tg-ws-proxy .
 Listens for Telegram Desktop's MTProto connections on a local port and
tunnels them through WebSocket (TLS) connections to Telegram's DC servers.
 Telegram channel: @tg ws proxy_rs .
 Telegram Desktop → MTProto (TCP 1443) → tg-ws-proxy-rs → WS (TLS 443) → Telegram DC
 ↘ CF proxy (kws{N}.{cf-domain}) → Telegram DC (WS via Cloudflare)
 ↘ CF Worker (*.workers.dev) → Telegram DC (TCP tunnel via Cloudflare)
 ↘ upstream MTProto proxy → Telegram DC (WS fallback)
 ↘ direct TCP :443 → Telegram DC (last resort)
 Android app
 A minimal Jetpack Compose wrapper around the same core the CLI runs. Type the
flags you would pass to tg-ws-proxy , tap Start , and when the tg://proxy 
link appears tap it (or let the app open it) to add the proxy in Telegram.
 The listen address should be 127.0.0.1 so Telegram on the same phone can
connect.
 Add --secret <32 hex chars> if you want the link to stay the same across
restarts. --log-file is ignored; logs go to the on-screen view and logcat
( tg-ws-proxy ).
 The default arguments carry --quiet , so the on-screen Log panel stays
empty until you remove it. That is the default and not a failed start: drop
 --quiet (or swap it for --verbose ) before tapping Start to see log
lines. The tg:// link appears either way — it reaches the UI from the listen
callback rather than by scraping the log, so --quiet never hides it.

fdroid:rocks.poopjournal.morse.description:
Decipher Morse code to text or text to Morse code
Turn any text into Morse code, or translate Morse code to text and hear the results.
• Clean, modern app design and interface.
• Made to be simple to use for everyone.
• Realtime translation: type in the word or code and have it translated immediately.
• Decode from Morse to text, or text to Morse.
• Press the speaker button to hear the code.
• Copy the text by pressing the "Copy" button.
• Type in dot and dash using our built-in Morse keyboard. 
• Libre software (https://github.com/Crazy-Marvin/Morse)
+ More features planned.
Don’t let the special characters or dots and dashes befuddle you.
Morse code is a system to encode letters and numbers to dash and dot signs.
The duration of the dash is three times the duration of a dot.
Each dot or dash is followed by period of signal absence, called a space, equal to the dot duration.
Morse code was first used for communicating via telegraph.
The most well-known Morse code is SOS, which is used to signal an emergency.
Aside from typing dots and dashed, you can also signal Morse code by turning light on and off, sounding a horn or tapping, etc.
All means of transmitting Mores code require the recipient understands it.
If not, our app may be used to find out the message, password, secret number, or any info you want to relay. 
Nowadays, even though the use of the telegraph has been widely superseded by other communication technologies, Morse code still finds its place in the lives of various individuals. Due to its presence in popular culture, Morse code has been featured in movies, games, and other medias as a simple way to encode messages, inspiring fans to research and explore the language as part of fun, puzzle-solving activities. This makes it useful even in cryptography or cryptogram events as a handy encoding tool.
1. Tell others when you are in a dangerous situation (SOS).
2. Hide your secret number or password via dots and dashes.
3. Cipher or decipher hidden clues in games.
4. Learn cryptography or cryptogram through learning Morse codes.
5. Become a codebreaker by breaking secret codes in real time translation.
6. Create a secret number.
+ Many more 
---
It really helps to leave a review or to star the project in the source code repsitory, and it means the world to us.
If you have problems using the app, please write an e-mail or open an issue on GitHub.
Responses are most often immediate, and bugs are fixed as soon as possible.

Families, speech and language therapists, special education teachers, and rehabilitation clinics working with autism, apraxia of speech, aphasia, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, stroke and traumatic brain injury.

flathub:com.abdownloadmanager.abdownload.description:
AB Download Manager is a desktop application that helps you manage and organize your downloads
 more efficiently than ever before.
 Key Features:
 ⚡️ Faster Download Speed
 ⏰ Queues and Schedulers
 🌐 Browser Extensions
 💻 Multiplatform (Windows / Linux / Mac)
 🌙 Multiple Themes (Dark/Light) with modern UI
 ❤️ Free and Open Source
 ⏸️ Pause, resume, and retry downloads
 📊 Download progress and statistics

flathub:com.cloudchewie.cloudotp.name: CloudOTP
flathub:com.cloudchewie.cloudotp.description:
CloudOTP is a secure two-factor authenticator supporting TOTP, HOTP, MOTP protocols with cloud backup capabilities.
 Note: Screenshot feature is temporarily unavailable in the flatpak version
 Highlights: 
 Support TOTP, HOTP, MOTP, Steam, Yandex
 Supports scanning QR code to add, identify pictures, and manually enter keys
 Supports custom icons and categories, supports sorting and multiple token layouts(Simple, Compact, List, Spotlight)
 Supports dark mode, multiple languages, and multiple themes
 Supports local backup and automatic backup, supports WebDav, Onedrive, Dropbox, S3 storage and other cloud backup methods
 Supports import/export of encrypted files and URI lists
 Supports importing data from Aegis, andOTP, Bitwarden, EntAuth, FreeOTP+, Google Authenticator, 2FAS, TOTP Authenticator, Winauth
 Supports database encryption and gesture password

flathub:com.core447.StreamController.name: StreamController
flathub:com.core447.StreamController.summary: Control your Elgato Stream Decks with plugin support
flathub:com.core447.StreamController.description:
An elegant Linux app for the Elgato Stream Deck featuring advanced features like plugins and
 automatic page changing.
 App Features:
 Elegant GTK4 Interface
 Plugin support with built-in store
 Multi-deck support
 Set background images & videos
 Set custom icons
 Automatic page switching (Gnome, Hyprland, Sway, KDE & X11)
 Multiple states per key
 Sticky actions available on all pages
 Auto-Lock your deck when your system is locked
 Command line & D-Bus API for scripting
 Official Plugin Features:
 Execute commands
 Press hotkeys (X11 and Wayland)
 Move mouse (X11 and Wayland)
 Control OBS Studio
 Control your music
 Mix the volume of different apps
 Switch between audio outputs
 Mute your microphone
 Display the current time
 Send network requests
 Supported devices
 Stream Deck Original
 Stream Deck Mini
 Stream Deck Mini Discord Edition
 Stream Deck XL
 Stream Deck Pedal
 Stream Deck Plus
 Stream Deck Plus XL
 Stream Deck Neo
 Stream Deck Studio
 Stream Deck Modules
 Experimental support for devices from other manufacturers
 Mirabox Stream Dock 293S (no hotplug support yet)
 Ulanzi Stream Controller D200 (no hotplug support yet)

flathub:com.github.Rosalie241.RMG.name: Rosalie's Mupen GUI
flathub:com.github.Rosalie241.RMG.description:
Rosalie's Mupen GUI is an easy to use yet customizable mupen64plus front-end, allowing you to
 easily play Nintendo 64 games.

flathub:de.flose.Kochbuch.name: Cookbook
flathub:de.flose.Kochbuch.summary: The easy to use electronic cookbook
flathub:de.flose.Kochbuch.description:
Unite your recipes in one central place and access them from all the places you might need them
 such as your PC, your Andoid devices, or any browser. Keep your recipe collection nicely organized
 by choosing your own categories. Add an arbitrary amount of photos to showcase your creations.
 All the functionality is for free; only the automatic synchronization costs a small fee.

flathub:de.mediathekview.MediathekView.name: MediathekView
flathub:de.mediathekview.MediathekView.description:
MediathekView searches the online media libraries of German public broadcasting stations
 (ARD, ZDF, Arte, 3Sat, SWR, BR, MDR, NDR, WDR, HR, RBB, ORF, SRF) and lists available
 shows and movies.
 It supports filtering this list for specific broadcasts, and allows viewing and
 downloading videos.
 It also enables subscriptions and automatically downloads new episodes.
 Viewing videos requires the "org.videolan.VLC" flatpak.

flathub:io.github.falldaemon.engplayer.name: EngPlayer
flathub:io.github.falldaemon.engplayer.description:
EngPlayer is a modern, fast, and lightweight media player developed with Python and GTK4 for Linux desktops.
 It serves as a user-friendly entertainment hub that brings your local media library, VOD content, Podcasts, and live streams under one roof.
 Key Features:
 IPTV Support: Seamless integration with Xtream Codes API and M3U playlists.
 Smart EPG & Catch-up: Real-time program guides and archive playback support.
 Recorder (PVR): Record live streams or schedule recordings for later.
 Podcast Integration: Manage library, listen to episodes, and smart resume support.
 External Stream: Direct playback support for external video and audio URLs.
 Cinematic VOD: Automatic metadata fetching (Posters, Cast, Plot) via TMDb integration.
 Trakt.tv Sync: Automatically tracks what you're watching (Scrobbling).
 Local Library: Manage your Video, Music, and Picture collections with album art support.
 Advanced Player: Video Settings (Brightness/Contrast), 10-Band Equalizer, Subtitle download, and PiP mode.

flathub:io.github.mrgilfy.leggio.name: Leggio
flathub:io.github.mrgilfy.leggio.description:
Leggio shows your sheet music PDFs on screen, so you can put a laptop or tablet on a music stand
 and play from it instead of from paper.
 It keeps a library of your scores, which you can search by title, composer or tag and group
 into setlists. Scores open fullscreen with nothing else in the way, and pages turn instantly.
 What it does:
 Cuts off the white margins, so the notes fill the screen
 Turn pages by tap, swipe, keyboard or Bluetooth pedal, also half a page at a time
 Two pages side by side on a wide screen, one page on a tall one
 Add jump links to a D.S., D.C. or To Coda, then follow them with one tap
 Bookmarks and a page overview, for finding your way in long scores
 Draw on a score with a pen, highlighter, eraser and musical symbols
 Export a score or a setlist as a PDF with your annotations drawn in
 Night mode turns pages white-on-black for dark stages
 A setlist reads as one long document, several scores in a row
 Remembers where you stopped in each score, and keeps the screen from going to sleep while
 you play
 Your PDF files are never changed. Everything Leggio saves is kept in its own library. The Flatpak
 only sees the folders you choose.

flathub:io.github.nokse22.asciidraw.name: ASCII Draw
flathub:io.github.nokse22.asciidraw.description:
Draw diagrams, tables, tree view, art and more using only characters.
There are many tools and features available such as:
 Rectangle using multiple line styles
 Filled Rectangle using border and fill characters
 Cartesian, Freehand and Stepped line, also with arrows
 Freehand Brush
 Text with FIGlet fonts
 Table
 Tree View
 Eraser
 Character Picker
 Move and Rotate selection
 Flood Fill
 You can also organize characters into custom palettes.

flathub:io.gitlab.gjwu.pdf-tinkerer.name: PDF Tinkerer
flathub:io.gitlab.gjwu.pdf-tinkerer.description:
This desktop app reads and writes PDF documents. It was created for a small copy shop in Germany. Features of this application are:
 Clone two or more PDF pages on one PDF page
 Extract images from a PDF file
 Export PDF pages to JPG and PNG images
 Glue two PDF pages together to print them with a plotter
 Add, move and delete pages in a PDF document
 Create a booklet of a PDF document, that you can print later
 Create a PDF document from JPG and PNG images, with one new page per image
 Available in the following languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, and Italian

flathub:net.charlesschaefer.addictiontra.name: Addiction tracker
flathub:net.charlesschaefer.addictiontra.summary: Addiction Tracker - An app for tracking substance addiction and habits
flathub:net.charlesschaefer.addictiontra.description:
Your journey to recovery starts here. Track your progress, identify triggers, and celebrate milestones on your path to a healthier life. 
 ✔ Understand Your Triggers - Feeling blindsided by sudden urges? Identify patterns and triggers that lead to substance use, so you can prepare and respond effectively.
 ✔ See the Financial Impact - Shocked by how much money disappears? Track your spending on substances and visualize what you could save for things that truly matter.
 ✔ Remember Your Why - Struggling to stay motivated? Store personal motivations and access them instantly when cravings hit to strengthen your resolve.

flathub:net.hhoney.tinycrate.name: Tiny Crate
flathub:net.hhoney.tinycrate.description:
Tiny Crate is a cute little precision platformer with puzzle elements!
 Lift and toss crates to traverse over spike pits and reach higher ground!
 Weigh down buttons to create platforms and solve the puzzle!
 Push yourself and make tight jumps! You got this! <3 (:
 Controls:
 Arrows - Move
 X - Jump / Select
 C - Lift & Toss / Back
 Enter - Menu

flathub:net.jenyay.Outwiker.name: OutWiker
flathub:net.jenyay.Outwiker.description: OutWiker is designed to store notes in a tree. Such programs are called "outliner", personal wiki, or tree-like editors. OutWiker's main difference from the other similar programs is keeping the tree of notes in the form of directories on disk, and encouraging changing the base by external sources and programs.

flathub:net.labymod.LabyMod.name: Laby Launcher
flathub:net.labymod.LabyMod.description:
Laby Launcher delivers LabyMod, the ultimate free all-in-one client for Minecraft: Java Edition,
 bundling 300+ mods, 3D voice chat, cosmetics and a modern launcher into a single download for Windows,
 macOS and Linux. Beyond LabyMod, the launcher also lets you create and run instances for Vanilla,
 Fabric, Forge and Quilt, so everything you play lives in one place.
 What you get:
 Incredible performance - Freezes, lags and poor FPS are a thing of the past. With
 doubled performance your game feels smoother than ever before.
 Your game, your style - Switch at any time between a stunning, high-resolution modern
 theme and the classic, iconic Minecraft look.
 Built-in VoiceChat - Free in-game voice chat with 3D surround sound and proximity
 audio on every multiplayer server - no plugins, no setup required.
 Cosmetics with character - Handcrafted, passionately animated and highly customizable
 cosmetics, plus a skin and cape library with 3D preview and support for your own uploads.
 Reinvented screenshots - Capture and share 3D screenshots with automatic player
 tagging.
 Stay connected - A server-independent friends chat with tabs and a freely movable
 chat window keeps you in touch wherever you play.
 One launcher for everything - Create instances for Vanilla, Fabric, Forge and Quilt,
 each with its own mods and configuration, and import existing setups from launchers like MultiMC
 or Prism.
 Note: LabyMod is not an official Minecraft product. It is not approved by or associated with
 Mojang or Microsoft.

flathub:net.odamex.Odamex.name: Odamex
flathub:net.odamex.Odamex.summary: Fast, faithful Classic DOOM action — solo or online
flathub:net.odamex.Odamex.description:
Odamex is a multiplayer-oriented DOOM port with a focus on classic DOOM gameplay. Perfect for playing with friends or alone,
 Odamex is faithful to the original DOOM games. It has the ability to play back vanilla demos,
 while also providing an enhanced experience with modern quality-of-life features and expanded modding capabilities.
 Features include:
 General Improvements on the Original Games:
 Can play many DOOM engine games, including Ultimate DOOM, DOOM II, Final DOOM, Freedoom, Chex Quest, Hacx, and REKKR
 Supports many modern editing features, such as “limit removing”, Boom, MBF, MBF21, and ID24
 Supports Hexen format and older ZDoom format maps
 Uncapped framerate
 High resolutions
 Widescreen support up to 32:9 ratio (ultra widescreen)
 32-bit color renderer
 Multiple ways to playback MIDI music, including an FM Synth emulator to rekindle those 1990s memories
 Supports MOD and other tracker music, MP3, and OGG in custom wads
 Quake-style console and key bindings
 Crosshairs
 Extended HUD
 Mouselook, jumping, swimming, and flying
 Walk over/under monsters and other things
 Unmatched Online Experience:
 Support for up to 255 players at once
 Top tier network code. Play with your friends on the other side of the world!
 Unlagged - Odamex will compensate for poor network conditions
 In-game wad downloading
 On-the-fly wad loading (servers can run hundreds of wads without you disconnecting!)
 Vote to change server settings such as fraglimit, timelimit, map, and more (must be enabled on server)
 Custom player colors
 Exciting Multiplayer Gamemodes:
 Cooperative & Survival
 Deathmatch / Team Deathmatch
 Last Man Standing / Team Last Man Standing
 Capture the Flag
 The Cacoward winning Horde mode
 And more!
 To use your own Timidity config file, use this command: flatpak override net.odamex.Odamex --env=TIMIDITY_CFG=<config location> 
 Note: The included version of Timidity does NOT support soundfonts, only GUS patches. 
 A copy of DOOM, DOOM II, Final DOOM, Freedoom, Hacx, REKKR, or Chex Quest is required. If you do not own DOOM, it can be purchased on GOG or Steam.

flathub:org.easyrpg.player.name: EasyRPG Player
flathub:org.easyrpg.player.description:
EasyRPG Player is a program that allows to play games created with RPG Maker 2000 and 2003.
 It aims to be a free (as in freedom) cross-platform RPG Maker 2000/2003 interpreter.
 The main goal is to play all games created with them as the original game interpreter (RPG_RT) does.

flathub:org.gnome.Mahjongg.name: Mahjongg
flathub:org.gnome.Mahjongg.summary: Match tiles and clear the board
flathub:org.gnome.Mahjongg.description:
Single-player tile-matching game, commonly known as Mahjong solitaire.
 Tiles are stacked on the board at the start of the game. The goal is to
 remove all the tiles in as little time as possible.
 Select two matching tiles and they will disappear from the board, but
 you can only select a tile if there is an empty space to its left or
 right at the same level. Be careful: tiles that look alike may actually
 be slightly different.
 You can choose from a variety of starting layouts, some easy and some
 difficult. If you get stuck, you can ask for a hint, but this adds a
 large time penalty.

flathub:org.kde.kcalc.name: KCalc
flathub:org.kde.kcalc.description:
KCalc has everything you would expect from a scientific calculator, plus:
 Trigonometric functions, logic operations and statistical calculations
 A results stack which enables convenient recall of previous calculation results
 Precision is user-definable
 The display allows cut and paste of numbers
 The display colors and font are configurable, aiding usability
 The use of key-bindings make it easy to use without a pointing device

flathub:tw.ddnet.ddnet.name: DDNet
flathub:tw.ddnet.ddnet.description:
DDraceNetwork (DDNet) is an actively maintained version of DDRace, a Teeworlds modification
 with a unique cooperative gameplay. Help each other play through custom maps with up to 64 players,
 compete against the best in international tournaments, design your own maps, or run your own server.
 The official servers are around the world. All ranks made on official servers are available worldwide
 and you can collect points!

fedora-packages:catch22/catch22.name: catch22
fedora-packages:catch22/catch22.description: catch22 is a collection of 22 time-series features coded in C that can be run from Python, R, Matlab, and Julia. The catch22 features are a high-performing subset of the over 7000 features in hctsa. Features were selected based on their classification performance across a collection of 93 real-world time-series classification problems, as described in our open-access paper: - Lubba et al. (2019). catch22: CAnonical Time-series CHaracteristics (https://doi.org/10.1007/s10618-019-00647-x) The computational pipeline used to generate the catch22 feature set is in the op_importance (https://github.com/chlubba/op_importance) repository. For catch22-related information and resources, including a list of publications using catch22, see the catch22 wiki (https://github.com/chlubba/catch22/wiki). This package contains the command-line tool run_features.

fedora-packages:golang-github-cactus-sta.name: compat-golang-github-cactus-statsd-client-5-devel

The scaffolded functions are usually much faster than OCaml's `Stdlib.compare` and `Stdlib.(=)`. Scaffolding functions also give more flexibility by allowing them to be overridden for a specific type, and more safety by making sure that only comparable values are compared.

It creates the environment to send PUBLISH requests for user location records, on specific events (e.g., when new record is added in usrloc, a PUBLISH with status open (online) is issued; when expires, it sends closed (offline)). It doesn't require any capabilities or privileges, and it can be used as a simple replacement for Slirp. pasta (same binary as passt, different command) offers equivalent functionality, for network namespaces: traffic is forwarded using a tap interface inside the namespace, without the need to create further interfaces on the host, hence not requiring any capabilities or privileges.

fedora-packages:perl-Class-Loader/perl-C.name: perl-Class-Loader
fedora-packages:perl-Class-Loader/perl-C.summary: Load modules and create objects on demand
fedora-packages:perl-Class-Loader/perl-C.description: Certain applications like to defer the decision to use a particular module till runtime. This is possible in perl, and is a useful trick in situations where the type of data is not known at compile time and the application doesn't wish to pre-compile modules to handle all types of data it can work with. Loading modules at runtime can also provide flexible interfaces for perl modules. Modules can let the programmer decide what modules will be used by it instead of hard-coding their names. Class::Loader is an inheritable class that provides a method, _load(), to load a module from disk and construct an object by calling its constructor. It also provides a way to map modules' names and associated metadata with symbolic names that can be used in place of module names at _load().

fedora-packages:perl-Config-Auto/perl-Co.description: This module was written after having to write Yet Another Config File Parser for some variety of colon-separated config. It searches the filesystem for the program's configuration file, basing itself on the program's name and returns a data structure based on the file's contents.

It can act as a centralized log collector for local or remote systems, or as a simple log analyzer (such as swatch). It can run as a network server listening on a syslog port or analyze log files. It includes routines for multiplying sparse matrices by dense matrices, solving block diagonal systems with triangular diagonal entries, preprocessing sparse matrices, and contains additional routines for dense matrix operations. The current implementation of PSBLAS addresses a distributed memory execution model operating with message passing. This is a PSBLAS version for long-integer (8-byte) data.

fedora-packages:python3.13/python3.13-de.description: python3-debug provides a version of the Python runtime with numerous debugging features enabled, aimed at advanced Python users such as developers of Python extension modules. This version uses more memory and will be slower than the regular Python build, but is useful for tracking down reference-counting issues and other bugs. The debug build shares installation directories with the standard Python runtime. Python modules -- source (.py), bytecode (.pyc), and C-API extensions (.cpython*.so) -- are compatible between this and the standard version of Python. The debug runtime additionally supports debug builds of C-API extensions (with the "d" ABI flag) for debugging issues in those extensions.

fedora-packages:qd/qd.name: qd

Due to features such as operator and function overloading, these facilities can be utilized with only minor modifications to conventional C++ and Fortran-90 programs. In addition to the basic arithmetic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide, square root), common transcendental functions such as the exponential, logarithm, trigonometric and hyperbolic functions are also included.

Since it uses the same back-end for all output, copying across formats is WYSIWYG. Files are created without the dependence on X11 or other external programs. This device supports alpha channel (semi-transparent drawing) and resulting images can contain transparent and semi-transparent regions. It is ideal for use in server environments (file output) and as a replacement for other devices that don't have Cairo's capabilities such as alpha support or anti-aliasing. firefox-addons:2641932.name: Swisscows.VPN
firefox-addons:2641932.summary: This browser extension simplifies access to the Swisscows.VPN server.
firefox-addons:2641932.description: Swisscows.VPN extension simplifies access to the Swisscows proxy server. A proxy server works like a firewall located between the end user and the website visited. The browse request from the user arrives at the proxy server, the proxy server sends the request from the user to the desired website, then receives the information and sends it to the user. This means that the user remains undetected for the website operator, i.e. anonymous.

firefox-addons:523652.name: PassFF
firefox-addons:523652.summary: Add-on that allows users of the unix password manager 'pass' to access their password store from Firefox
firefox-addons:523652.description:
PassFF allows users of the unix password manager pass (see below) to access their password repository directly from Firefox. PassFF can be configured to auto-fill and auto-submit login forms when a matching password entry is found.
To install the add-on, you will need the following:
 You need pass installed on your computer and have your password repository already set up.
 You'll also need to install our native host application so that the plugin can access your passwords. In order to do so, please follow the instructions on the project homepage .
For more information, visit the project's homepage and read our README there.
 Not a user of pass ? 
pass is a unix password manager written by Jason A. Donenfeld of zx2c4.com . It's beyond the scope of this extension to introduce new users to the dis-/advantages and to the usage of pass. Learn more about pass on the project homepage . If you don't know this password manager or don't know how to set it up, this extension won't be of any help for you.

bluejetty:00124159:ios.description:
Step into the world of Puzzle & Dragons, an addictive, FREE match-3 puzzle game with classic monster-collecting RPG fun!
-　INTUITIVE AND ENGAGING
Assemble a powerful team of monsters and take on fierce foes in the depths of thrilling dungeons! Attacking is simple--just match 3 orbs of the same color to trigger an attack from the corresponding monster on your team. Chain multiple combos and colors to increase your damage and unleash devastating attacks from other monsters in your team!
- ENDLESS MONSTER COMBINATIONS, LIMITLESS POWER
With over 10,000 unique monsters to collect—from the cutest to the fiercest—the possibilities for team combinations are simply endless! Monsters can synergize with each other to enhance each other's abilities and make your teams more effective in battle. Build the team that suits your playstyle!
-　RECIPES FOR EVOLUTION
Monsters can unlock greater potential by evolving into new, more powerful forms. Choose from various evolution paths and optimize your monster collection to your liking.
-　BRING YOUR FRIENDS INTO BATTLE
Exchange IDs with friends to recruit their monsters for support in battle and strengthen your lineup! Stay connected with the Puzzle & Dragons community with in-game messaging and social features designed to enhance your adventure.
-　MULTIPLAYER DUNGEONS!
Puzzle & Dragons becomes even more fun with Multiplayer Mode! Team up with your friends and tackle enemies by challenging Multiplayer Dungeons in the ultimate test of teamwork!
-　LEGENDS UNFOLD IN STORY DUNGEONS!
Venture into Story Dungeons and experience epic tales featuring powerful leaders and legendary dragons! Each dungeon brings a unique story, challenging battles, and rewarding adventures. Discover all the legends of Puzzle & Dragons!
The world of Puzzle & Dragons is ever-expanding, thanks to its thriving community and regular events and updates. It's also completely FREE to play, so start building your dream team of dragons and monsters today!
Note: Puzzle & Dragons is free to download and play. In-app purchases are also available to enhance your gameplay experience. 
In-app purchases are available via the “Shop” tab within the app.
Please refer to In-App Purchases for prices.
*A network connection is required to play.

bluejetty:00100604:ios.summary:
Welcome to Arrows ASMR Melody Touch, a mesmerizing puzzle game that combines strategic gameplay with soothing ASMR sound experiences!
Tap colorful arrows to guide them off the screen. Each arrow moves in its direction, creating a beautiful
bluejetty:00100604:ios.description:
Welcome to Arrows ASMR Melody Touch, a mesmerizing puzzle game that combines strategic gameplay with soothing ASMR sound experiences!
Tap colorful arrows to guide them off the screen. Each arrow moves in its direction, creating a beautiful dance of motion. But beware - collisions will bounce lines back, so plan your moves carefully!
The magic happens as lines glide: musical notes dance along their paths, and each line length plays a unique melody when it starts moving. Longer lines create richer harmonies, transforming your gameplay into a symphony of sounds.
Experience the perfect blend of puzzle-solving and audio relaxation. Clear all lines to complete each level while enjoying the therapeutic ASMR soundscape. Every move creates music, every level a new melody!
Immerse yourself in this musical puzzle adventure where strategy meets serenity!
Key Features:
• Intuitive tap-to-move gameplay
• Unique sound effects for different line lengths (2-8 segments)
• Beautiful musical note particles that follow moving lines
• Soothing ASMR audio experience
• Challenging puzzle levels with increasing difficulty
• Colorful, vibrant visuals with smooth animations
• Eraser tool to remove lines strategically
• Power-ups to enhance your gameplay
Perfect for players who love puzzle games and enjoy relaxing, therapeutic sound experiences!

bluejetty:00180536:ios.description:
Type and translate instantly in 60 various languages with one smart and instant translator keyboard.
Translator Keyboard is your all-in-one language translator keyboard. Type in your native language and instantly translate messages and texts in real time across more than 60 languages. Whether you’re chatting, emailing, or posting on social media, Translator Keyboard enables seamless multilingual communication directly from your keyboard.
▶ How does Translator Keyboard work?
Get instant translations as you type. Write in your native language and see your message instantly translated into your chosen language. Live translation works automatically, with no copy-paste and no app switching.
▶ How to setup Translator Keyboard?
With smart language translator integration, you can easily install Translator Keyboard as an additional keyboard and use it directly within any messaging, email, or social app. 
▶ How many languages are supported?
Over 60 languages are available. Type, translate, and chat in English, Spanish, Japanese, Italian, French, Chinese, Korean, Thai, German, Portuguese, Arabic, Vietnamese, Hebrew, and many more.
▶ How can I switch between languages easily?
With one-tap language selection, you can pick quickly from over 60 languages and start your multilingual chats effortlessly.
▶ Want to make your messages more expressive?
With the built-in Emoji Keyboard, you can enhance your conversations with a wide range of emojis. Express, react, and personalize every message while using the language translator keyboard.
▶ Where can I use Translator Keyboard?
Chat with friends, update your status, or email a client abroad in all your favorite messaging & social apps. Translator Keyboard works seamlessly across apps like WhatsApp, Instagram, Gmail, and more. Your keyboard becomes a smart translator wherever you go.
Download Translator Keyboard today and experience the power of language translation at your fingertips! Type, translate, and chat now!

bluejetty:00168516:ios.description:
Embark on a fun and challenging merging experience!
Color Hexa Sort Puzzle Game provides amazing challenge with satisfying color matches and clever puzzle solving experience. You can build your own structures with organizing hexagon tile stacks as the rewards after passing each level. This game is designed to stimulate the intellect, offering a series of brain-engaging challenges that require puzzle-solving skills and logical strategies. HOW TO PLAY
- Tap to put stack of hexagon into the giant hexagon and they can merge with the stack beside if they have match color
- When the stack is enough, It will disappear
- Remeber, the position in big hexagon is limited
- Think carefully before making any moves, because you can't jump back
- Successfully gain aim to advance to the next and more challenges
- Stuck? Activate a booster for a smooth win
- Master the game and sail through levels booster-free! 
FEATURES:
- Easy to play, fun and relaxing hexa sort puzzle
- One-finger control
- Creative gameplay, a novel twist on sort puzzle
- Brilliant colors
- ASMR sounds that are perfect for relaxing
- 1000+ levels, different challenges to explore 
- Play at your leisure, anytime, anywhere
Ready to embark on a colorful puzzle adventure? Enjoy Color Hexa Sort Puzzle Game and experience the joy of strategic sorting! Challenge your mind, unleash your creativity, and immerse yourself in the world of hexagonal bliss!

bluejetty:00131752:ios.summary: Photomator is the most powerful photo editing app ever designed for a mobile device. It includes an extensive collection of cutting-edge color adjustments, automatic selections powered by AI, support for over 750 RAW image formats, a magica
bluejetty:00131752:ios.description:
Photomator is the most powerful photo editing app ever designed for a mobile device. It includes an extensive collection of cutting-edge color adjustments, automatic selections powered by AI, support for over 750 RAW image formats, a magical Repair tool for removing unwanted objects, and many more powerful features, letting you enjoy pro photo editing anyplace, anytime.
Everything you need to make your photos look incredible
• Edit photos using a wide collection of powerful, nondestructive color adjustments
• Quickly make precise subject, sky, and background selections in photos using AI, add gradient masks, and easily make selections using a brush
• Effortlessly remove unwanted objects using an incredible object removal tool
• Crop, straighten, rotate, and adjust the perspective of photos with an easy-to-use Crop tool
• Instantly increase the resolution of photos using AI
• Remove camera noise and image compression artifacts with the powerful Denoise feature
• Magically remove color banding and increase color depth in photos with the AI-powered Smart Deband feature
• Make your photos stand out with photographer-designed presets for landscape, black and white, and other photography styles
• Easily copy and paste edits between photos or batch edit even hundreds of photographs at a time
• Open and edit over 750 RAW image formats, including Apple ProRAW and compressed Fujifilm RAWs
• Follow all the changes you make in the beautiful live histogram
Tools powered by AI
• Select the subject, sky, or background in a photo with just a tap
• Improve the quality of photos by reducing camera noise with the AI-powered Denoise feature, intelligently upscale photos with Super Resolution, or magically remove color banding and increase color depth using Smart Deband
• Automatically enhance shots using a machine learning algorithm trained on 20 million pro photos, or fine-tune individual adjustments, like White Balance, Selective Color, or Color Balance with a single tap
• Intelligently crop photos using the AI-powered auto-cropping
• Copy the look of any photo to another using the incredible Match Colors feature
State-of-the-art color adjustments
• Enjoy powerful tools for effortlessly adjusting the temperature, tint, exposure, contrast, brightness, hue, saturation, and vibrance in your photos
• Recover incredible amounts of detail in the highlights and shadows of photos
• Magically enhance fine details and structure in photos using powerful Clarity and Texture adjustments, or adjust textures in the highlights, midtones, and shadows separately
• Selectively edit individual color ranges with Selective Color, or improve the balance of colors in the shadows, midtones, and highlights with Color Balance
• Adjust lighting and colors with full precision using Levels and Curves adjustments
• Mix the balance of the red, green, and blue color channels to create intense color effects in your images
• Replace any color with any other using the Replace Color adjustment
• Create beautiful black and whites even from your color photos
• Use a range of additional adjustments, like Sharpen, Fade, Grain, Color Monochrome, Sepia, and Invert to make your photos stand out
• Instantly change the look of photos with LUTs or export custom LUTs to use in other apps
Compatibility
• Automatically sync every change back to your Photos or Files browser
• With the support for iCloud Drive, enjoy seamless edit syncing across Mac, iPhone, and iPad
• Photomator is built from the ground up for iPhone and iPad with a native design that blends seamlessly with the sleek and modern look of iOS and iPadOS 18
• Photomator uses powerful Apple technologies like Metal, Core ML, and Core Image to deliver staggeringly fast performance, even when editing large RAW photos or batch editing multiple images at a time
• Privacy policy: https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/en-ww/

bluejetty:00121363:ios.description:
Gametime is the app that helps *you* score deals to all your favorite events! Now featuring Gametime Ticket Coverage, the most comprehensive service and protection policy in ticketing - included free with all purchases. Gametime is the top app for deals on last minute tickets to sports, concerts, and theater. Gametime is a resale market, not the main provider of tickets. Resellers may list tickets above or below face value
Did you know ticket prices for your favorite events - sports, music, and theater - actually go down the closer you get to showtime? Get the best deals, see the view from your seats, and utilize Gametime’s super-simple checkout process to get into events even after they have started. Mobile ticket delivery helps save paper and printing headaches. Easy mobile ticket sharing lets you send tickets to all your friends so they can join you in the fun.
SCORE GREAT DEALS
- Take advantage of falling ticket prices as you get closer to the event time. 
- Buy tickets up to 90-minutes after the start of the event.
- Special Zone Deals provide added discounts that can help you save even more! 
GAMETIME TICKET COVERAGE - INCLUDED FREE
Buy with confidence with the most comprehensive service policy in ticketing, included free with all purchases. You get:
- Lowest Price Guaranteed - or get 110% of the difference
- Lightning Refunds - refunds for canceled events within days, not weeks (or longer) and no forced credits like some other companies
- Job Loss Protection - in the event you lose your job and need some cash we will provide you with a refund
Plus more! Restrictions apply.
EASY TICKET BUYING
- The best seats at the lowest prices = big savings!
- Utilize venue maps to make easy seat and price comparisons to find the exact seat you want. 
- Panoramic photos show the exact view from any section. 
- 2-Click checkout process.
- Mobile delivery allows you to buy and walk into the event without missing a step. 
NO HIDDEN FEES
Gametime always displays prices with fees included, which means less guesswork for you and more time enjoying the thrill of a game, concert or show.
ENVIRONMENTALLY FRIENDLY
- Mobile ticket delivery saves paper & ink. 
- Send tickets to friends directly to their mobile phones, they don’t need to print anything either!
EASILY SELL TICKETS 
- List and price tickets with just a few taps.

bluejetty:00030271:ios.summary: The NBC South Florida app is your trusted source for local news, NBC 6 First Alert Weather forecasts and breaking alerts. Stay connected with live coverage, Doppler radar, hurricane tracking, traffic updates and 24/7 news streaming tailored
bluejetty:00030271:ios.description:
The NBC South Florida app is your trusted source for local news, NBC 6 First Alert Weather forecasts and breaking alerts. Stay connected with live coverage, Doppler radar, hurricane tracking, traffic updates and 24/7 news streaming tailored for Miami, Fort Lauderdale and South Florida.
Get trusted local reporting, real-time weather updates and live coverage from NBC 6 in one app. Follow stories across Miami, Fort Lauderdale and South Florida, including breaking news, politics, elections, public safety, severe weather, hurricanes, traffic, transit, entertainment and urgent updates that affect your day.
Why use the NBC 6 South Florida app?
If you live or work in Miami, Fort Lauderdale or South Florida, the NBC 6 South Florida app offers live local coverage, investigative reporting and real-time alerts to keep you informed throughout the day.
What can you do with the NBC 6 South Florida app?
Follow Miami and South Florida local news and community
* Get instant push notifications for local, national and world headlines
* Read exclusive articles and watch video reports from NBC 6 journalists
* Catch up on stories you missed in the integrated Alerts Center
* Follow key topics including local economy, public safety, transit and education
Follow elections and politics
* Follow complete coverage of electoral races in Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach County, the Florida Keys and Florida contests
* Track primary and general election results, ballot measures and local proposals
* Watch live election debates and analysis with NBC 6 anchors
Stay ahead of the weather and hurricanes with live radar
* Check current conditions, hourly forecasts, 10-day projections, air quality and UV index
* Access NBC 6 First Alert Weather live Doppler radar to track rain, tropical storms, severe weather, coastal flooding and hurricane paths
* Add custom weather widgets to your Home Screen to quickly check forecasts for your area
24/7 live streaming and special coverage
* Watch live NBC 6 South Florida newscasts and special coverage on demand
* Follow investigative journalism from NBC 6 Investigates and consumer guidance from NBC 6 Responds
Personalize your NBC 6 experience
* Sign in with an NBCUniversal Profile to save articles and videos to watch later
* Manage alert preferences and newsletter subscriptions all in one place
Who is the NBC 6 South Florida app for?
It is designed for residents and commuters across Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Broward County, Miami-Dade County, the Florida Keys and South Florida who need real-time weather tracking, hurricane updates, traffic and local news coverage.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I customize news, election, weather and hurricane alerts?
Yes. You can filter push notifications by topic and location, receiving only the severe weather alerts, hurricane tracking, breaking news, election updates or community notices you choose.
Can I watch NBC 6 live in the app?
Yes. You can stream NBC South Florida News 24/7, live NBC 6 newscasts, press conferences and special breaking coverage from anywhere.
NBC 6 South Florida provides local news, NBC 6 First Alert Weather forecasts, live radar, hurricane tracking, traffic and 24/7 streaming for Miami, Fort Lauderdale and South Florida.

bluejetty:00079576:ios.description:
-Do you want to have a perfect posture? What if we tell you that you can have it? With simple exercises and stretches and no need for equipment! Text Neck App will guide you to the perfect posture! With enough practice, the correct posture will replace your old posture.
- We would like to advise you to seek a doctor’s advice in addition to using this app before making any medical decisions.
-Neck pain relief exercises with simple neck workout.
- Forward Head Posture is the anterior positioning of the head to the body. The main causes of Forward Head Posture are prolonged computer use - tech neck, studying while keeping your head forward, looking down on smartphone for a long time - text neck, or any other postures that make your head lean forward or bend down.
- Being aware of the problem is the first step in fixing bad posture. We will help you determine what the problem is and how to fix forward head posture. Neck stretches and neck exercises will help you regain control of your neck position and good posture overall. Download it now and start improving your posture!
- Correct posture is important for your overall health and well-being. Correct posture aligns everything in your body in the proper position. Your body can only function optimally if you have a proper head position and overall good posture.
- Proper head posture will reduce neck pain. Our app is great as a neck pain treatment with specific exercises and stretches to improve posture.
-Back pain prevention with spine exercises, you can do it with a guided 5 min workout.
- Corrective exercises combined with stretches will help reverse forward head posture, neck pain, and back pain.
- The biggest problem with Forward Head Posture is that when your head is pulled forward, the additional pressure on your neck, shoulders, and back rise dramatically, causing serious tissue damage. For every inch your head is thrust forward from its natural position, it adds another 10-12 Lbs of stress to your neck, shoulder, back, and ultimately spine.
Forward Head Posture Symptoms:
+Back Pain
+Neck Pain
+Chronic Neck Pain
+Restricted Breathing
+Headaches and migraines
+Insomnia
+Chronic Fatigue
+Mood Swings
+Numbness and tingling in the arms, hands, and fingers
+Hunchback
+A pinched nerve in the neck
+Bad shoulder posture.
Back pain relief exercises - with a simple back workout!
-Back pain prevention and neck pain prevention with guided 5 min workouts.
-Neck workout for better head posture and healthy back posture.
- This application is created based on years of scientific research in Medicine and Physiology.
- Our training program is optimal for your health and your Forward Head Posture Correction. Start it as soon as possible, and enjoy all the benefits that good posture provides.

bluejetty:00042386:ios.description:
MOVE by Love Sweat Fitness is the top-ranked exercise app for women created by Personal Trainer Katie Dunlop. Join the TEAM LSF community and start your daily at-home workouts to lose weight, tone up, get stronger, and most importantly, feel good every day.
After her own 45 pound weight loss journey, Katie has spent the past 10+ years helping thousands of women transform their bodies through her proven weight loss system, the 3:1 Method. Get ready to burn fat and build strength with motivating at home daily workouts for every level.
Stay motivated, get encouragement and connect with our inspirational women’s fitness community #TEAMLSF.
Start your first sweat sesh with Katie today and get ready to MOVE!
MOVE membership gets you access to:
Katie’s Personal Training Program
With over 500+ days of brand new workouts including; Legs & Booty, Abs & Arms, Full Body, Cardio & more, the perfect workout for any day is waiting for you. Each workout combines 3 strength based exercises with a cardio burst to deliver your optimal, full body results. No gym? Good! You won’t need it. Every MOVE workout can be done at home with minimal to no equipment.
On-Demand Video Workouts:
Ready to mix it up? Join Katie for a fully guided workout in your video library. Whether it's a quick 15 minute ab blaster, or a 45 minute barre bootcamp -- get the in-person studio experience right from home with over 150+ workout videos to choose from.
- Strength & Circuit Training
- HIIT (high-intensity interval training)
- Yoga
- Barre
- MISS (Moderate-Intensity-Steady-State)
- LISS (Low-Intensity-Steady-State)
- Body Part Targeted
- Warm Up + Mobility
- Recovery
- Stretching
Track and Celebrate Your Progress
Set and crush your goals with a personalized weight, hydration and workout tracker. Stay consistent and build your MOVE Sweat Streak, a daily reminder to keep going. Don’t forget, each workout is a reason to celebrate and remember how far you have come. Track your self-care habits, add your progress photos, and earn motivational trophies for reaching your goals.
- Daily Accomplishment Tracker
- Workout Journal
- Motivational Trophies
- Sweat Streak Progress Tracker
- Side by Side Transformation Photo Builder
- Weight, Water & Self Care
Subscription Details and Terms
MOVE is free to download. In order to access all features and workouts in the app requires a MOVE membership, available on a monthly, quarterly and yearly basis. First time customers will be eligible for a 7 day free trial period, you will be billed at the end of the trial. Yearly subscriptions are billed in the total annual amount after a trial period or upfront for existing customers.
You may change your payment method at any time in your iTunes account. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled prior to the date of the charge. Payment will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account once you confirm the purchase.
Subscriptions can be managed or canceled in your iTunes account. We are not able to provide refunds for unused portions of your subscription term. If you cancel prior to the end of your term, you will retain access to your membership until the end.
NEED HELP? Email us anytime!
support@lovesweatfitness.com
------

At Interstate Credit Union, we don’t sell products, we build relationships. From major milestones like home buying and retirement to everyday transactions like bread and milk, your financial institution plays an important role behind the scenes of your life. This is why our focus is about enhancing the quality of life.
We serve anyone that lives, works, worships or is a student in Wayne, Appling, Liberty, Long, Jeff Davis or Bacon counties (Georgia, USA).
Interstate Credit Union was chartered in 1968 by a group of employees from Interstate Paper LLC in Riceboro, Georgia. Our company was only able to serve employees of Interstate Paper LLC and we did so from a shoebox at John and Emma Jean Boatwright’s house in Jesup, Georgia.
Since then, we have merged with Appling Citizens Federal Credit Union and Wayne Teachers Credit Union and have opened four branch locations, Jesup, Baxley, Midway, and Hazlehurst.

bluejetty:00119733:ios.description:
With VakıfBank Mobile Banking application, easy and fast banking is in your pocket.
You can perform your banking transactions easily and securely.
With VakıfBank Mobile Banking, you can become a customer with your ID card easily, safely and quickly, without having to visit the branch.
Download the application, follow the activation steps, create your personal application password and start enjoying easy banking.
Our commercial customers can easily view and approve their transactions from the Approval Transactions menu in VakıfBank Mobile, in line with their account access and authorization levels. They can follow the transactions pending for approval from a single screen, and manage their processes quickly and practically
With Mobile Banking application, you can view your account balance, information and statements, or make money transfer, investment, credit card transactions and payments.
With our investment menu, you can open an investment account, trade various investment products such as stocks, funds, eurobonds, treasury bills, and bonds from a single screen, and manage your investment portfolio.
You can track the Credit card and Debit card expenditures from VakıfBank Mobile, split your credit card transactions into installments, and make transactions such as card application and debt payment. Thanks to the card settings menu, you can quickly make your password change, payment date modification etc. transactions.
For your money transfer transactions, you can use our “Find from Past Transactions” menu in VakıfBank Mobile to quickly find all the money transfers within the last 1 year, and repeat them.
With the Share Payment feature in VakıfBank Mobile, you can easily share your subscription payments, money transfers, bill payments and other expenditures with your family or friends.
With the Cepte Kazan menu in VakıfBank Mobile, you can stay informed about the latest campaigns and participate in them.
With ViBi, you can make your banking transactions by both speaking and writing. With Financial Consultant feature, you can get advises for your banking products.
With Benim Yerim menu, you can add your home and vehicle information to VakıfBank Mobile, and make the tax, motor vehicles tax, billing and money transfer transactions for your home or vehicles from a single channel.
You can track your accounts and cards in other banks from a single screen; and with All Transactions feature, you can view your transactions in detail. You can create single, future-dated or regular money transfer orders from your accounts in other banks.
By using our smart watch application, you can follow real-time market information, view the closest VakıfBank branches and ATMs, and quickly access our customer contact center.

bluejetty:00028760:ios.description:
Human: Fall Flat+ is a hilarious, light-hearted physics platformer set in floating dreamscapes that can be played solo or with up to 4 players. Free new levels keep its vibrant community rewarded. Each dream level provides a new environment to navigate, from mansions, castles and Aztec adventures to snowy mountains, eerie nightscapes and industrial locations. Multiple routes through each level, and perfectly playful puzzles ensure exploration and ingenuity are rewarded. 
MORE HUMANS, MORE MAYHEM - Need a hand getting that boulder on to a catapult, or need someone to break that wall? Online multiplayer for up to 4 players transforms the way Human: Fall Flat+ is played. 
MIND BENDING PUZZLES - Explore open-ended levels full of challenging puzzles and hilarious distractions. Try new paths and discover all the secrets! 
A BLANK CANVAS - Your Human is yours to customize. With outfits from builder to chef, skydiver, miner, astronaut and ninja. Choose your head, upper and lower body and get creative with the colors! 
FREE GREAT CONTENT - Since launch more than four brand new levels have launched free of charge with even more on the horizon. What could the next dreamscape have in store? 
A VIBRANT COMMUNITY - Streamers and YouTubers flock to Human: Fall Flat+ for its unique, hilarious gameplay. Fans have watched these videos more than 3 Billion times!
