bluejetty:00041233:ios.description:
*** วิธีการอัพเดทแอพเวอร์ชั่นใหม่ ให้กดปุ่ม "อัพเดท" บนหน้า App Store เท่านั้น เพื่อไม่ให้ข้อมูลที่บันทึกไว้หายไป ***
*** หากลบแอพแล้วลงใหม่ ข้อมูลรายรับ-รายจ่ายที่บันทึกไว้ จะถูกลบไปด้วย *** 
[ รายรับรายจ่าย Save Money ] คือ แอปบันทึกรายรับรายจ่ายและจัดการเงินส่วนตัว ที่ช่วยให้คุณรู้ว่าเงินเข้าเท่าไหร่ เงินออกไปกับอะไร และเหลือเงินจริงๆ เท่าไหร่ในแต่ละวัน
เหมาะสำหรับคนที่อยากคุมค่าใช้จ่าย วางแผนการออม จัดการเงินเดือน ติดตามหนี้บัตรเครดิต บันทึกค่าใช้จ่ายประจำ หรืออยากเห็นภาพรวมการใช้เงินแบบไม่ต้องเปิดสมุดจดให้ชีวิตยุ่งยากกว่าเดิม
[ ฟีเจอร์เด่นของแอป ]
- สแกนสลิปธนาคารด้วย OCR :
ช่วยอ่านข้อมูลจากสลิปธนาคาร สแกนได้หลายใบพร้อมกัน ลดเวลาพิมพ์รายการเอง เหมาะกับคนที่ซื้อของบ่อย จ่ายหลายรายการ หรืออยากเก็บข้อมูลค่าใช้จ่ายให้ครบกว่าเดิม 
- บันทึกรายรับรายจ่ายได้ง่าย :
เพิ่มรายการรายรับ รายจ่าย และจัดหมวดหมู่ได้หลากหลาย ใช้งานง่าย เหมาะกับการบันทึกค่าอาหาร ค่าเดินทาง ค่าช้อปปิ้ง ค่าบ้าน ค่ารถ ค่าโทรศัพท์ ค่าบัตรเครดิต เงินเดือน รายได้เสริม และค่าใช้จ่ายอื่นๆ
- ดูสรุปรายรับรายจ่ายหลายช่วงเวลา :
ตรวจสอบภาพรวมการเงินได้ทั้งรายวัน รายสัปดาห์ รายเดือน และรายปี ช่วยให้เห็นพฤติกรรมการใช้เงินชัดขึ้น ไม่ต้องมานั่งเดาว่าเงินหายไปไหน
- สรุปค่าใช้จ่ายตามหมวดหมู่ :
ดูได้ทันทีว่าเงินส่วนใหญ่หมดไปกับหมวดไหน เช่น อาหาร เดินทาง ช้อปปิ้ง สุขภาพ บันเทิง หรือค่าใช้จ่ายประจำ ทำให้รู้จุดที่ควรลดได้ง่ายขึ้น
- กราฟเปรียบเทียบรายรับ-รายจ่ายรายปี :
ดูรายรับและรายจ่ายเทียบกันได้ทุกเดือน เห็นแนวโน้มการใช้เงินตลอดปี เหมาะกับคนที่อยากวางแผนเก็บเงินแบบจริงจัง ไม่ใช่แค่ตั้งใจแล้วลืมเหมือนทุกปีที่ผ่านมา
- ตั้งค่ารายรับรายจ่ายประจำ :
บันทึกรายการที่เกิดซ้ำได้ เช่น เงินเดือน ค่าเช่า ค่าน้ำ ค่าไฟ ค่าโทรศัพท์ ค่าบัตรเครดิต ค่าผ่อนของ หรือค่าใช้จ่ายคงที่อื่นๆ ช่วยลดงานซ้ำและทำให้ข้อมูลครบขึ้น
- ส่งออกข้อมูลเป็นไฟล์ CSV :
ดาวน์โหลดข้อมูลรายรับรายจ่ายออกมาเป็นไฟล์ CSV เพื่อนำไปเปิดต่อ จัดเก็บ วิเคราะห์ หรือสำรองข้อมูลได้สะดวก และสามารถแชร์รายการรายรับ-รายจ่ายเป็นไฟล์ pdf
- ฟรี! ระบบสำรองข้อมูล (Backup) / ระบบนำเข้าข้อมูล (Restore) ได้ด้วยตนเอง 
สำรองผ่านระบบ iCloud Drive ไม่ต้องกลัวว่าข้อมูลจะสูญหาย หรือจะเก็บไว้ในมือถือผ่านแอพ Files ก็ได้
- ข่าวสารอัปเดตหลากหลาย
ติดตามข่าวล่าสุดได้ในแอปเดียว ทั้งข่าวทั่วไป เศรษฐกิจ การเงิน อื่นๆ เหมาะกับคนที่อยากเช็กข่าวไปพร้อมกับจัดการเงินประจำวัน
-------------------
[ รายรับรายจ่าย Save Money ช่วยอะไรได้บ้าง ]
- รู้ว่าแต่ละเดือนใช้เงินไปกับอะไร
- คุมรายจ่ายและลดค่าใช้จ่ายฟุ่มเฟือย
- วางแผนออมเงินได้ง่ายขึ้น
- ดูยอดเงินคงเหลือและประวัติย้อนหลัง
- แยกรายรับรายจ่ายตามหมวดหมู่
- ตรวจสอบพฤติกรรมการใช้เงินรายวัน รายเดือน และรายปี
- เก็บข้อมูลค่าใช้จ่ายจากสลิปโอนได้สะดวกขึ้น
- จัดการค่าใช้จ่ายประจำ เช่น เงินเดือน บัตรเครดิต และบิลต่างๆ
-------------------
[ แอปนี้เหมาะกับใคร ]
- คนทำงานที่อยากคุมเงินเดือน
- ผู้ที่อยากเริ่มบันทึกค่าใช้จ่าย
- เจ้าของร้านหรือฟรีแลนซ์ที่อยากจดรายรับรายจ่ายเบื้องต้น
- คนที่อยากลดรายจ่ายและเริ่มออมเงิน

*** หากลบแอพแล้วลงใหม่ ข้อมูลรายรับ-รายจ่ายที่บันทึกไว้ จะถูกลบไปด้วย *** 

[ รายรับรายจ่าย Save Money ] คือ แอปบันทึกรายรับรายจ่ายและจัดการเงินส่วนตัว ที่ช่วยให้คุณรู้ว่าเงินเข้าเท่าไหร่ เงินออกไปกับอะไร และเหลือเงินจริงๆ เท่าไหร่ในแต่ละวัน

เหมาะสำหรับคนที่อยากคุมค่าใช้จ่าย วางแผนการออม จัดการเงินเดือน ติดตามหนี้บัตรเครดิต บันทึกค่าใช้จ่ายประจำ หรืออยากเห็นภาพรวมการใช้เงินแบบไม่ต้องเปิดสมุดจดให้ชีวิตยุ่งยากกว่าเดิม

[ ฟีเจอร์เด่นของแอป ]

- สแกนสลิปธนาคารด้วย OCR :
ช่วยอ่านข้อมูลจากสลิปธนาคาร สแกนได้หลายใบพร้อมกัน ลดเวลาพิมพ์รายการเอง เหมาะกับคนที่ซื้อของบ่อย จ่ายหลายรายการ หรืออยากเก็บข้อมูลค่าใช้จ่ายให้ครบกว่าเดิม 

- บันทึกรายรับรายจ่ายได้ง่าย :
เพิ่มรายการรายรับ รายจ่าย และจัดหมวดหมู่ได้หลากหลาย ใช้งานง่าย เหมาะกับการบันทึกค่าอาหาร ค่าเดินทาง ค่าช้อปปิ้ง ค่าบ้าน ค่ารถ ค่าโทรศัพท์ ค่าบัตรเครดิต เงินเดือน รายได้เสริม และค่าใช้จ่ายอื่นๆ

- ดูสรุปรายรับรายจ่ายหลายช่วงเวลา :
ตรวจสอบภาพรวมการเงินได้ทั้งรายวัน รายสัปดาห์ รายเดือน และรายปี ช่วยให้เห็นพฤติกรรมการใช้เงินชัดขึ้น ไม่ต้องมานั่งเดาว่าเงินหายไปไหน

- สรุปค่าใช้จ่ายตามหมวดหมู่ :
ดูได้ทันทีว่าเงินส่วนใหญ่หมดไปกับหมวดไหน เช่น อาหาร เดินทาง ช้อปปิ้ง สุขภาพ บันเทิง หรือค่าใช้จ่ายประจำ ทำให้รู้จุดที่ควรลดได้ง่ายขึ้น

- กราฟเปรียบเทียบรายรับ-รายจ่ายรายปี :
ดูรายรับและรายจ่ายเทียบกันได้ทุกเดือน เห็นแนวโน้มการใช้เงินตลอดปี เหมาะกับคนที่อยากวางแผนเก็บเงินแบบจริงจัง ไม่ใช่แค่ตั้งใจแล้วลืมเหมือนทุกปีที่ผ่านมา

- ตั้งค่ารายรับรายจ่ายประจำ :
บันทึกรายการที่เกิดซ้ำได้ เช่น เงินเดือน ค่าเช่า ค่าน้ำ ค่าไฟ ค่าโทรศัพท์ ค่าบัตรเครดิต ค่าผ่อนของ หรือค่าใช้จ่ายคงที่อื่นๆ ช่วยลดงานซ้ำและทำให้ข้อมูลครบขึ้น

- ส่งออกข้อมูลเป็นไฟล์ CSV :
ดาวน์โหลดข้อมูลรายรับรายจ่ายออกมาเป็นไฟล์ CSV เพื่อนำไปเปิดต่อ จัดเก็บ วิเคราะห์ หรือสำรองข้อมูลได้สะดวก และสามารถแชร์รายการรายรับ-รายจ่ายเป็นไฟล์ pdf

- ฟรี! ระบบสำรองข้อมูล (Backup) / ระบบนำเข้าข้อมูล (Restore) ได้ด้วยตนเอง 
สำรองผ่านระบบ iCloud Drive ไม่ต้องกลัวว่าข้อมูลจะสูญหาย หรือจะเก็บไว้ในมือถือผ่านแอพ Files ก็ได้

ติดตามข่าวล่าสุดได้ในแอปเดียว ทั้งข่าวทั่วไป เศรษฐกิจ การเงิน อื่นๆ เหมาะกับคนที่อยากเช็กข่าวไปพร้อมกับจัดการเงินประจำวัน

bluejetty:00128514:ios.description:
TV Mirror+ for Chromecast is the easy screen sharing tool to mirror your iPhone or iPad screen and sound on Chromecast in Full HD Quality.
Mirror photos, videos, games, websites, apps, presentations, documents and spreadsheets on Chromecast.
* Supported Chromecasts: Chromecast, Chromecast Ultra and all generations of the Chromecast family
* Supported TVs and other devices: Xiaomi MI Box, NVIDIA Shield TV and all TVs with Google Cast or Chromecast built-in, e.g. Sony, TCL, Vizio, Sharp, Philips, Hisense, Skyworth, Soniq
* Your iPhone/iPad and your Chromecast must be connected to the same wifi to enable screen mirroring. Please do not use VPN, Proxy, VLANS and Subnets.
* Latency is supreme (below 1 second) when you have good wifi network conditions
* No hidden subscriptions or costs
* If a third party app, for example Spotify, does not mirror sound correctly, please FORCE CLOSE and restart Spotify while the mirroring session is active. Please check the Apple Support page to learn how to FORCE CLOSE an app: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT201330
* Black screen issues: Some third party apps prevent screen mirroring. When you try to mirror them, you will just see a black screen on your TV, for example with Netflix and Disney+. This is a restriction chosen by Netflix and others, so we cannot fix it at the moment.
If you like the app and our constant work on it, please give the app a positive rating on the App Store. Many thanks in advance from the development & support team.
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with Google or any other trademark mentioned here. Chromecast is a trademark of Google LLC.

bluejetty:00080057:ios.description:
Crochet Studio is the ultimate app for crafting enthusiasts. With powerful tools and yarn AI, you can design stunning granny squares and stripe blankets in no time. Our tools are intuitive, easy to use and even calculate yarn usage in real time. Plus, you can generate a written pattern for your finished design.
Easily find the perfect yarn colours for your project with our yarn AI feature. Simply upload an image, and the app will suggest palettes that match. You can even save your favourite palettes to your library for future use. Create custom yarn palettes with thousands of virtual yarn options and see how different colours work together before buying yarn for your next project.
Explore a curated collection of crochet patterns, colour palettes, and interviews with crochet experts from around the world. The Discover screen will always highlight the best crochet allowing you to see some incredible crafters that you may have never seen before. Regular updates mean you'll always have something new to see or read about.
We believe that Crochet Studio is a must-have for anyone interested in crochet and we are very excited to share it with you. We have many more ideas for extra features and functionality that we want to add to this app in future updates. So please check it out, let us know what you think and look forward to future updates as we continue to work hard to make this app even better.

Privacy Policy: https://crochetstudio.co.uk/privacy
Don't wait, download Crochet Studio now and take your crafting to the next level!

bluejetty:00166526:ios.description:
Struggling with Full Storage on Your iPhone? Can’t Take New Pictures?…
Introducing CLEANUP AI photo storage cleaner – Free Up Your iPhone Storage Effortlessly!
CLEAN FAST WITH CLEANUP AI:
Delete blurry photos, delete duplicates, delete similar photos, delete social media photos, and clean up junk from your phone! Our AI-powered iPhone cleaner ensures a swift and efficient cleanup.
DELETE THE LARGEST FILES FIRST:
Start by deleting that 5GB video that’s been sitting in your gallery forever. Free up storage efficiently—your ultimate iPhone storage cleaner.
EASY PHOTO LIBRARY CLEANUP:
We all know our iPhone photo gallery is full of unnecessary photos—we’re all photo hoarders! Cleanup AI makes the process easy, memorable, and safe (proudly made in the USA).
A SECRET PHOTO VAULT:
Securely store your private photos in our secret photo vault, ensuring they remain safe and inaccessible to others.
DELETE FILES FROM YOUR IPHONE:
Not just photos—we can also delete files from your iPhone, helping you reclaim valuable storage space quickly and easily.
CLEAN UP YOUR GALLERY FAST!
Swipe left to get rid of unwanted photos and duplicates.
Swipe right to keep the memories that truly matter to you.
You’ll be surprised at how many unnecessary pictures you’ve been keeping!
ONLY KEEP THE BEST PHOTOS:
In a group of similar photos, we will suggest the best one to keep:
 • Directly looking at the camera
 • Looking your best
 • Good focus
 • Edited or a favorite
You decide which ones to keep. We don’t delete any photos without your permission.
THE ULTIMATE CLEANER KIT:
An AI cleaner! Your own guru to clean your storage. A phone cleaner that acts as a photo cleaner, photo organizer, and storage cleaner.
YOU HAVE THE FINAL SAY:
Cleanup AI sends the deleted photos to the recently deleted folder in your iPhone. After you’re done deleting, Cleanup AI prompts you for a final review to ensure no photos are accidentally deleted.
RELIVE MEMORIES WHILE STAYING PRODUCTIVE:
Our biggest competitors are cute kittens, pimple-popping videos, and your favorite puzzle game. But here’s what’s unique about Cleanup AI: after using our app, you’ll have a clean and organized photo gallery—not a guilt-provoking waste of time!
MOST SECURE WAY TO CLEAN UP YOUR LIBRARY:
Unlike other apps, you don’t need an internet connection to use Cleanup AI. It works locally (offline) on your phone, ensuring your photos are secure and private.
CLEAN AND ORGANIZE YOUR IPHONE WITH CONFIDENCE:
Don’t trust fake gurus or apps made in a foreign land; Cleanup AI is made in the USA. Enjoy free credits, and swipe and wipe those photos away!
Clean or not clean, that’s the dilemma—but after all, you’ll have a cleaner phone. Don’t struggle with the Photos app; swiping through your photos is so much easier!
Privacy policy: https://thephotonator.com
Terms of service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula
App subscription: $4.99 a week for unlimited photo/video deletion.

bluejetty:00186787:ios.summary: Christmas is the most important holiday for most kids all over the world. With huge excitement, boys and girls decorate the Christmas tree, make sweets, deck out the house and look forward to their presents. These coloring pages depict your
bluejetty:00186787:ios.description:
Christmas is the most important holiday for most kids all over the world. With huge excitement, boys and girls decorate the Christmas tree, make sweets, deck out the house and look forward to their presents. These coloring pages depict your favorite Christmas characters and the main symbols of the festive season. The coloring process gives every kid the feeling of the Christmas holidays drawing near.
Benefits: 
◦ Teaching children simple arithmetic. Addition and subtraction
◦ Coloring by geometrical figures and pictograms
◦ Coloring by letters
◦ Very simple program interface that any child can master 
◦ Easy-to-use palette that allows you to put together your own unique set of colors
◦ High-quality drawings of all pictures 
◦ Visual effects and sound effects 
◦ Pleasing background music 
◦ Colored pictures automatically saved on closing the program
◦ And many other useful features that make coloring entertaining
Paint by numbers - an interactive coloring book for children. This mathematical game teaches children to recognize numbers and solve simple mathematical examples. In addition, this program develops memory, attention, imagination, and logical abilities.
Boys and girls of all ages love to color. The simple coloring mode is suitable for the smallest of children, including those of kindergarten and preschool age. These include simple and recognizable images that are easy to color. If the child selects the wrong shape, then they will be prompted with the correct number. Therefore, the picture will always be colored correctly, and the child will quickly memorize the numbers. Children can choose to color by geometrical figures and pictograms in addition to numbers. A child can easily distinguish a square from a circle, diamond, and triangle.
School-age children will enjoy the complex coloring mode. Here the picture is divided into a large number of elements, thus making it difficult at first to determine what it depicts. Older children can complicate the task by adding addition and subtraction tasks. Now children will need to solve the examples and choose the correct answers in order to color the picture. This will teach the child how to quickly do arithmetic in their mind.
Those who are learning the alphabet can choose to color by letter. Coloring by letters will be useful for children preparing to enter primary school.
To make the coloring process more interesting and fun, you can change any of the preset colors. To do this, press and hold the jar of paint and a palette will open. Then you can choose your favorite color. Thus, all the shaded areas of the image can be changed in the coloring by number mode. You can have fun by changing the color scheme to suit your taste. Try the program right now!

bluejetty:00156349:ios.description:
Nuj is the FIRST alarm clock that uses money to motivate you to get out of bed!
Featured in FastCompany:
"There’s nothing quite like a little financially motivated fear to get you moving in the morning"
— from "These 5 alarm apps are sure to wake you up"
Featured on local NBC and CBS TV stations:
"...might be just what you need to finally break the snooze button habit"
— from "What the Tech: App of the Day"
→ How it works:
1. Set an alarm time, and a get up time
2. Add a challenge to prove you got up, e.g. a barcode you have to scan
3. Set a penalty
4. If you don't prove you got up by completing the challenge, e.g. scanning one of the barcodes, by the get up time, you get charged the penalty
For example:
1. Set an alarm for 7:00am with a get up time of 7:05am
2. Add the toothpaste and shampoo barcodes
3. Add a $10 penalty
4. Alarm goes off at 7:00am
5. Get up and scan the toothpaste barcode before 7:05am. Or, don't, and lose $10 (goes to charity)
→ Have you ever turned your phone off to avoid getting up from a different alarm clock app? Nuj is the ONLY alarm clock that includes cheat detection by storing alarms in the cloud! No more cheap tricks!
↓ Wondering if it really works? Just read some of our reviews from ecstatic users! ↓

bluejetty:00029903:ios.description:
StayFree: the ONLY app to find the most beautiful camping & vanlife spots all around the world - fast, easy and for free! 
Whether you travel with a campervan, RV, rooftop tent, 4x4, trailer or offroad vehicle - StayFree helps you find the most beautiful camping spots all around the world, fast, easy and for free.
● Time to go on camping! 
Search in 150.000+ wild-camping locations, parking areas, RV-Parks, motorhome sites, overnight parking, and campsites added by app users or StayFree team - public or shared only with friends.
Where will you camp tonight?
Wake up to breathtaking views in Yosemite, park under the stars in Utah’s desert, or find a cozy lakeside spot in Michigan.
→ Use 50+ filters to find the perfect site, check reviews, and plan your ultimate road trip.
● Decided?! -> Start the navigation with only one click and let us guide you to the chosen destination! 
● Already on a vanlife road trip? 
Track all your campng roadtrips and make your adventures unforgettable with our travel tracker. 
StayFree Vanlife App for all campervan & caravan travelers:
-> Browse huge base of wild camping, parking spots, RV-Parks, and campsites - find all kinds of spots for your motorhome trip
-> Add new camper spots 
-> Filter all vanlife camping spots with 50+ filters
-> Easily share camping spots with your friends 
-> Create spot lists & plan your perfect road trip
-> Track all your camping road trips
-> Find service points near you
-> Review all campsites you were staying at and help other campers find the perfect place for a night
-> Protect the best wild camping spots & nature in the UK by sharing them only with your friends and not public 
-> Clean up the wild camping spots
● STAYFREE COMMUNITY 
StayFree it's not only the database with campgrounds or wild stopovers for motorhome holidays.
- Meet other vanlife & camper road trip enthusiasts
- Create your profile, and describe yourself and your camper. Meet other camper lovers, watch their moments, and share your camping experiences with them. 
- Share your camping passion, make new friends, and share your best wild camping spots only with them. 
- Earn the latest badges in our vanlife app by discovering places, creating journeys, and making check-ins – be a true Explorer, Globetrotter, or Scout.
● CLEAN-UP 
Let's make the world a little bit a better place by living the camper lifestyle with the most possible responsibility! 
No matter where you spend the night with your campervan, always take care of your closest area - do not leave any trash, and always leave wild camping spots better than you found them. 
How the Clean-up works? 
-> Take a bag and collect the trash you see & share a photo of it in StayFree to inspire other motorhome travelers to do the same. 
● JOIN STAYFREE PREMIUM:
-> Create camping spots lists
-> Add private spots 
-> Travel Tracker: follow your all your road trips
-> Create wishlists
-> Explorer 600 Premium Spots
-> Enjoy special discount for selected partners (camping online shops)
-> No ads
-> Translator
● CAMPER TEAM:
We started StayFree because we needed it. We knew there must be a way to connect all wildness lovers who love to travel and believe in a green present and future. 
If you have any questions or comments contact us: support@stayfree.app
We wish you many beautiful vanlife moments!
StayFree Team

bluejetty:00128861:ios.name: Rugby League 22
bluejetty:00128861:ios.summary:
Claim glory for YOUR team as you take on the might of the World’s best Rugby League teams!
Showcasing all new player and stadium visuals, a completely redesigned team training system and, overall, a much richer gaming experience; Rugby Lea
bluejetty:00128861:ios.description:
Claim glory for YOUR team as you take on the might of the World’s best Rugby League teams!
Showcasing all new player and stadium visuals, a completely redesigned team training system and, overall, a much richer gaming experience; Rugby League 22 is the only game that delivers the power, speed and intensity of one of the World’s most enthralling sports.
Also, for the first time, the Women’s game is fully represented - with complete parity to the Men’s game so you can enjoy the game equally no matter which option you choose.
Choose your favourite team from the national leagues of England or Australia or build your own custom team, train them up and dominate the leagues - as you build a team for the ages. Alternatively, take home the ultimate trophy in the Rugby League World Cup.
Regardless of what you play, one thing is for sure, this game will keep delivering your daily dose of Rugby League action for the weeks and months ahead.
Download for FREE today.
WOMEN’S RUGBY
Women’s Rugby is one of the fastest growing team sports in the World so it’s clear that no Rugby game would be complete without inclusion of the women’s game.
ALL NEW VISUALS
The player visuals have been recreated and brand new animations added to bring the game closer to reality. On top of that, all of the stadium environments have been recreated with vastly more detail and a greater sense of scale.
NATIONAL LEAGUES
Take part in the English or Australian Leagues and crush the local opposition in style. Earn exclusive rewards including highly skilled International players to boost up your own team!
WORLD CUP ACTION
Starting in the group stages of the competition you take direct control of your team’s every move, where every pass and tackle has to be executed with precision in order to overcome the opposition. Progressing to the knock-out stages means an even higher level of concentration is required but every hard-fought try takes you closer to your goal of taking home the silverware.
BUILD YOUR OWN TEAM
Are you up to the challenge of building the World’s greatest Rugby League team? Collect and build a team of players that you can train up to take on the very best opposition. Design your kit, create your team name and upgrade your stadium to fill it to capacity with crowds of adoring Rugby League fans. Then, win the league to earn promotion and get ready to take on the next level of opposition. Can you become champions of the All Star league?
FEATURES
- Women’s Rugby is fully represented for the first time.
- All new player visuals for both male and female players.
- Beautiful stadium environments.
- Major improvements to game-play.
- Enhanced crowd rendering.
- Referee and linesmen.
- And, much much more!
IMPORTANT
This game is free-to-play but does include optional in-app purchases, which can be purchased with real money.
FIND US
WEB: www.distinctivegames.com
FACEBOOK: facebook.com/distinctivegames
TWITTER: twitter/distinctivegame
YOUTUBE: youtube.com/distinctivegame

bluejetty:00175930:ios.description:
Dive headfirst into the fantastical realm of Slime Village and unleash a slimetastic hero production extravaganza in your very own slimy factories! Get ready to take on mind-bogglingly powerful bosses and show them who's the boss!
Dispatch your slimy heroes straight outta those factories and send 'em on an epic slime-hunting spree! Collect more gold than you can shake a stick at and become stinking rich, all while expanding your slimetastic hero production lines to unimaginable heights!
Gear up your heroes with a jaw-dropping array of slimetastic weapons and helmets! Collect super unique items and discover wicked gear combinations to create a hero style that'll leave everyone green with envy!
Merge some enchanted slime stones and level up your gear to make it even more epic and mind-blowingly powerful for your heroes! They'll be slimin' their way through enemies like there's no tomorrow!
Grab all that sweet gold from those slimy monsters and upgrade your hero factories to create an army of unstoppable slimy heroes! These heroes will be so tough, they'll make other heroes quiver in their boots!
Let your creativity run wild and customize your heroes with slimetastic skins. Merge 'em together to create a united force of slimy goodness that'll make your enemies quiver in their slimy boots!
Slime Village is the ultimate idle tycoon RPG that'll have you grinning from ear to ear. Manage your heroes and factories like a slimy genius and take on enemies like the slimy boss you are! Upgrade your heroes and factories with enchanted slime stones and gold to create an army so slimetastically powerful, it'll leave your rivals green with envy! Get your slimy adventure started today by downloading for free and create the slimiest heroes and factories the world has ever seen!
Slime Village Features
* A mind-boggling variety of slimy heroes from different slimy factories! 
Slime Knight, Slime Sorcerer, Slime Archer, Slime Ninja, Slime Warrior, and a whole bunch of other slimetastic heroes!
* Strategize your way to victory on the slimy battlefield! 
Choose your moves wisely and unleash slimy skills that'll make your enemies green with envy!
* Manage and upgrade your slimy heroes and factories to the max!

bluejetty:00062873:ios.description:
An express route to your study abroad journey, Yocket is India's largest study abroad platform catering to 800K+ study abroad candidates; with a 95% VISA success rate! Yocket brings together free tools, resources, and counselling, all in one place to make your study abroad journey easier and faster!
Reliable, useful and trusted - Yocket has 1500+ Google reviews and 1100+ Trustpilot reviews, hence a perfect place to start your research and understand the study abroad process for countries like the USA, UK, Australia, Canada, Germany, and more! 
Why 800K+ students LOVE Yocket: Features and Services of Yocket App
Yocket Premium 
Yocket Premium is all about interacting with our experienced, and trust-worthy study abroad experts. Over 1,000 students have got admission in top 100 universities globally like Harvard University, MIT, UCBerkeley, among lots others! If you are lost in the sea of options, we have curated services like loan assistance, health and travel insurance, and more that benefit you the most - right in your app.
Explore 
Through Explore you can find universities and courses personalised to your preferences with ease! Navigate through top study abroad countries, and even prioritise your choices with the help of university rankings! 
College Finder
Through the College Finder Tool, data is categorised as per your admit chances based on past admission trends of similar profiles. You just need to input a couple details, and you are ready with your very own dream university. Intriguing, right? 
University Research with Deadlines
Precise and refined reviews about the university, much beyond just the infrastructure. Find all necessary information like deadlines, infrastructure, courses offered, fees, financial aid; add and manage applications, documents, tasks and finances anywhere, and anytime! 
Groups and Chats
Chat with fellow study abroad aspirants, who are interested in the same university or course as you, through official Yocket Groups! Discuss your plan. Ask for advice. (Chat feature available only on the App).
Yocket Feed
Experience how the community's collective knowledge can be tapped to get answers to any question you have about your prep. Start a discussion and as they say, when in doubt ASK! Currently Yocket is catering to more than 282K feed members, through more than 5K posts created every month! 
My Profile
Every experience on Yocket begins with your Profile! Boast all your Scores, achievements and skills - tell everyone your dream university - and add interesting courses so that we can start running our magic recommendations engine. 
Yocket Connect 
Through Yocket Connect you can connect with fellow study abroad aspirants interested in the same colleges/universities, intakes, target countries, application status, previous college attended; as yourself! 
Student Profiles
Seniors on Yocket offer you vast amounts of information in the form of their profiles and application details. Access their profiles and study the trends across various universities & countries!
Events
Expert events- online and offline with University admission officers, Counsellors, Senior Students & US VISA officers. 
All events are FREE to attend!
Yocket Prep
Rated 4.4+ from our very own GRE aspirants, Yocket Prep is a gateway to your personalised GRE prep strategy! With over 40K+ questions attempted till date, Yocket Prep gives a detailed analysis of your section wise strengths and weakness; and even offers you with 40+ personalised test topics for focused training! 
Trusted by thousands of aspirants every year, Yocket has helped submit umpteen applications, and assisted for 13+ countries! 
So, Download the Yocket app, and experience one of the largest community-driven online platforms for international education! 
We would also love to hear from you, write to us on support@yocket.com

 - No Ads

bluejetty:00014850:ios.description:
VesselFinder is the most popular vessel tracking app, providing real-time data on the positions and movements of vessels, utilising a large network of terrestrial AIS receivers.
VesselFinder Pro features include:
 - No Ads
 - Port Calls - arrival and departure information for recently visited ports
 - Real time tracking of over 200,000 ships every day
 - Ship search by Name, IMO number or MMSI number
 - Ship movement history - follow the track of vessels for the past 7 days
 - Ship details - name, flag, type, IMO, MMSI, destination, ETA, draught, course, speed, gross tonnage, year of built, size
 - My Fleet - add your favorite vessels to "My Fleet" list. It is synced with VesselFinder.com, so any change of vessels in My Fleet list will reflect on either the mobile App or the website.
 - Filter vessels on map according to their type
 - Ship photos contributed by VesselFinder users
 - Simple, Detailed, Dark and Satellite maps
 - Weather layers (temperature, wind, waves)
 - Distance Measure tool
 - See Your Location feature
Coverage - near-shore coverage, same as the web-based application VesselFinder.com and the Free version of VesselFinder available at https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/vesselfinder-free/id918080862?mt=8
IMPORTANT: 
If you experience any problem with the App, please fill out this form to contact us http://www.vesselfinder.com/contact instead of writing a review here. We will do our best to solve it. Thanks!
Visibility of vessels in the App depends on AIS signal availability. If a particular vessel is out of our AIS coverage zone, VesselFinder displays her last reported position and updates it as soon as the vessel comes into range. Completeness and accuracy of the information provided cannot be guaranteed.
Connect with VesselFinder
- on Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/vesselfinder
- on Twitter http://www.twitter.com/vesselfinder
For any help and support, please visit the VesselFinder forum: http://forum.vesselfinder.com/forum/6-vesselfinder/

bluejetty:00120545:ios.description:
Meditation has ancient roots – and so does bliss.
Authentic, deeply profound, and rooted in Vedic principles of meditation that millions of people have benefitted from for thousands of years, bliss brings together meditation, sacred sounds, music, breathwork, and wisdom to support your inner journey.
At the heart of bliss is renowned humanitarian and spiritual teacher Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar, a thought leader in yoga and meditation who has guided millions of people around the world toward effortless meditation and deeper self-awareness.
If you’re new to meditation, you’ll find simple yet profound practices starting from just six minutes, along with routines, goals, and reminders to help you build a consistent practice.
For seasoned meditators, explore 300+ Guided Meditations, Sacred Sounds, Vedic chants and mantras, meditation music, breathwork, binaural beats, and powerful tools to deepen your practice. Set challenges, reach milestones, earn trophies, and track your meditation journey with in-depth stats.
bliss offers curated collections and playlists to take the guesswork out of meditation, so you can simply close your eyes and practice according to your mood, feeling, or time of day.
Explore the Wisdom Library from Gurudev, featuring videos, transcripts, and timeless insights to help you learn, reflect, and grow. You can also Ask Gurudev, connect with others through Circles, join live events, and discover new ways to bring meditation into your everyday life.
Discover, explore, immerse, and unwind with bliss - where ancient wisdom meets modern technology, right in the palm of your hand.
WHAT’S INCLUDED:
• Guided Meditations
• Sacred Sounds – Vedic mantras and chants
• Breathwork
• Binaural Beats
• Meditation Music

• Ask Gurudev
• Mudra Meditations

• Personalized Reminders – set your own notifications
• Mood Tracker – track how you feel before and after meditation
• In-depth Stats – track your progress and consistency
• Challenges – set milestones and stay on track
• Trophies – unlock achievements as you progress
• Meditation Community – connect, communicate, motivate, and meditate together
• Wisdom Quotes – discover and share inspiring insights
• Heart Rate Monitor
• Location – see the places where you’ve meditated on a map
• Surprises – leave post-meditation tokens of love for your friends

Your task: group them by meaning, category, or association.

Don’t wait — start playing Connect Word today and train your brain with this free word challenge!

bluejetty:00085731:ios.description:
Unlimited fitness, yoga, and Pilates for your home workouts, anytime and anywhere, all in one app.
Short on time, changing schedules, and no desire to juggle travel and rigid routines? With Buddyfit, you can work out at home (or wherever you are), choosing when, how long, and how: based on your level, the time you have, and your current goal.
Get access to over 80 structured programs and more than 1,000 guided workouts, including Fat Burning, Yoga, Abs, Legs & Glutes, HIIT, Pilates, Functional Training, Stretching, and much more. You will also find programs focused on mobility, menopause, and dedicated plans for every stage of pregnancy. Each program is created by professional trainers who guide you step by step, so you can focus entirely on movement.
Discover fresh content all the time to keep things varied, stay motivated, and never get bored. And if you enjoy training with others, you can also join live classes.
Choose sessions from 7 to 60 minutes, suitable for all levels, from beginners to those looking to increase intensity and consistency. You can follow multi-week programs with progressive difficulty or pick the home workouts that suit you best each day.
Guided programs to help you work on:
- Weight loss
- Pre- and post-pregnancy
- Toning and strength
- Stress reduction
- Flexibility and posture
- Endurance and cardio fitness
All you need is a smartphone, tablet, PC, or Smart TV to start working out at home.
Your Apple account will be charged for the full amount of the selected membership period. After the chosen term ends, your membership can be cancelled on a monthly basis. Otherwise, your membership will renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the initial term.
To deactivate the automatic renewal, visit the settings of your Apple account. Unused portions of the free trial period will be forfeited once a paid membership is activated.

JUDOKAI — Your Kodokan Judo Reference
Study the traditional techniques of Kodokan Judo through detailed, high-quality demonstrations. Explore Kata performed by respected Judo practitioners, study techniques from multiple angles, and keep y
bluejetty:00084738:ios.description:
JUDOKAI — Your Kodokan Judo Reference
Study the traditional techniques of Kodokan Judo through detailed, high-quality demonstrations. Explore Kata performed by respected Judo practitioners, study techniques from multiple angles, and keep your entire Judo reference library available wherever you train.
EVERY KODOKAN TECHNIQUE
Every traditional Kodokan Judo technique is demonstrated by César Nicola, 6th Dan, World Veterans Champion and National Judo Shiai & Kata Champion.
Study the complete execution of each technique and replay it whenever you want to examine the movement, positioning and technical details.
SEE THE TECHNIQUE FROM MULTIPLE ANGLES
Carefully selected camera angles give you different perspectives of each technique, helping you observe the complete movement and focus on the details that matter.
EXPLORE JUDO KATA
Study dedicated Kata modules performed by respected Judo practitioners.
Explore each Kata technique in detail and return to the demonstrations whenever you want to review and refine your understanding.
STUDY OFFLINE
Every Judo technique and Kata video can be saved for offline playback.
Study at the dojo, at home, while traveling, or anywhere without an internet connection.
BUILD YOUR PERSONAL REFERENCE
• Bookmark techniques for quick access
• Save techniques for offline playback
• Revisit your favorite techniques whenever you need
• Keep your Judo reference with you wherever you train
FOR JUDOKAS WHO WANT TO STUDY THE DETAILS
Whether you're learning a technique, reviewing what you practiced at the dojo, studying for a grading, working on Kata, or simply looking for a reliable technical reference, JUDOKAI puts traditional Kodokan Judo at your fingertips.
JUDOKAI isn't a replacement for the dojo.
It's the technical reference you can use alongside your training to watch, review and study Judo techniques in greater detail.
Study the technique. Review the details. Strive for perfection.

bluejetty:00096933:ios.summary: Daily Stocks: Market Scanner is a focused stock market technical analysis tool designed for traders who want fast, accurate, and meaningful market scans. The app analyzes the entire U.S. stock market after every market close and instantly s
bluejetty:00096933:ios.description:
Daily Stocks: Market Scanner is a focused stock market technical analysis tool designed for traders who want fast, accurate, and meaningful market scans. The app analyzes the entire U.S. stock market after every market close and instantly surfaces the stocks that match important technical conditions.
Daily Stocks is not a portfolio tracker and not a charting app. It does one thing, and it does it better than most tools available: it scans the market using powerful technical events and highlights the opportunities that matter.
The app includes a wide range of common technical events as well as rare, high-value setups that help you filter thousands of stocks in seconds. These events include price action signals, trend conditions, candlestick patterns, volume behavior, reversals, breakouts, and more. Prime setups combine multiple technical factors to identify unique trading situations that are often overlooked by typical scanners.
Features:
• Daily market scans after each market close
• Technical events such as RSI, MACD, momentum shifts, breakouts, volume spikes, gaps, and candlestick patterns
• Rare prime setups that highlight unusual and potentially actionable conditions
• Clean, simple lists designed for fast analysis
• Focused experience with no distractions and no unnecessary tools
• Ideal for traders who rely on technical analysis to discover ideas and improve decision-making
Daily Stocks is built for traders who want clarity. Instead of overwhelming dashboards, complicated menus, or chart-heavy screens, the app focuses on surfacing the right information at the right time. The goal is to help you find opportunities faster, with less noise, and with more confidence.
Important note: Daily Stocks does not provide investment advice. It presents technical analysis and market scan results for informational purposes only. Always conduct your own research before making trading decisions.

bluejetty:00161688:ios.description:
Progress without the guesswork. Gains keeps you moving forward by making every workout easier to plan, faster to log, and clearer to analyze.
Why lifters choose it
→ Know what to lift next — your last sets and weights are always right there.
→ Switch without starting over — Gains supports importing from Strong or Hevy. 
→ Stay focused — fast, minimal design that reduces taps and distractions.
→ Keep time, even from the lock screen – customizable rest timer with Live Activities support.
→ None of what you don't need – you don't have to start a workout session to quickly log your lifts.
→ Build momentum — personal records are captured automatically so wins are visible. (Hint: Look for the lightning bolt!)
→ Train your way — use the built‑in exercise catalog or create your own to match any program.
→ Share your progress — share your day's lifts, a routine, or progress on an individual exercise.
→ Reliable anywhere — works 100% offline, even in basement gyms.
→ Travel without friction — switch between pounds and kilograms instantly.
→ See real progress — clear charts turn history into actionable insights.
→ Save time every session — create routines once, then log entire workouts quickly.
Lift smarter. Make every session count with Gains.
Gains+ supercharges your workout tracking with features that are available via subscription
→ Unlimited routine creation — The only limit is your imagination
→ Advanced routines — Copy/paste rep schemes, select alternate exercises, organize routines into folders, and more
→ Drag and drop — Drag to reorder your routines within an individual day, or move them to a different day!
→ Set tagging — Tag sets as "warmup", "cooldown", or whatever else you may want
→ Multi-metric logging — Log weight, reps, AND time all in one log. Or log cardio by distance and energy or any other combination
→ Full data export — Export your entire Gains archive as a CSV
→ iCloud Backup — Back up your Gains database redundantly in iCloud
→ Custom accent colors — Choose from one of 10 color themes
→ Custom 1 Rep Max algorithm — Choose from one of many algorithms to estimate your 1 rep max
→ Many more features coming soon!
Download Gains and make every session count.
Follow Gains on X: @GainsHQ
Follow Gains on Instagram or Threads: @GainsTheApp

I'm always looking to improve Gains. If you have any questions, comments, or feature requests, feel free to email me at hi@gains.la

bluejetty:00151072:ios.description:
The ARC Print app empowers you to easily:
• Order prints
• Share files up to 3GB
• Receive quotes
• Track print orders 
• Request service
• Order supplies
ARC makes ordering prints simple, fast, and convenient! Simply send your print files to ARC or schedule a time and location for our concierge service to collect them from you. Once your prints are complete, pick them up from one of our 170+ print centers worldwide or we’ll deliver your materials wherever you need them. 
ARC Print app full features:
• Order the latest health related graphics – Choose from our large collection of protection barriers, signages & decals – Ideal for schools, offices, jobsites, restaurants, retail stores, hospitals, fitness centers, and more. 
• Send files – Share and send files as large as 3GB to any ARC location for print or quotation.
• Receive real-time job updates – As your order progresses through production, track when your file is downloaded, when it enters production, and as it is shipped and delivered.
• Schedule a pick-up – Choose a time and location for ARC to pick up any original materials you need to print, scan, or archive.
• Custom delivery options – Submit your delivery address, request a hold for will-call, or designate a print center closest to your destination to avoid customs, excess delivery charges, or traveling with physical documents.
• Request service and order supplies – Managed Print Services customers can place service and supply orders via our QR code scanner and get real-time status updates.
• Stay connected with us – Users have full access to ARC’s library of current and past newsletters.
• Find our print centers – Quickly access 170+ individual ARC locations.
• Touchless print retrieval – Securely and safely release your documents to your office printers.
ARC is a full-service print and document management provider that has delighted customers for over 100 years. We produce dazzling prints and graphics for any application you can dream of while helping organizations to seamlessly manage their information and documents. We proudly serve businesses and consumers throughout the world and fulfill over 30,000 print orders each week. When you need results, choose ARC.

The Mech Warrior Robot Game is a real-life version of the popular video game called Real Steel. The game features robot designs from the movie and other popular sci-fi movies.
In this game, you can play as any one of these robots or even create your own. You start off by choosing which type of robot you want to be: tank, fighter plane or deer. Then you have to choose your weapon: machine gun or missile launcher (which can be upgraded later on). You also have to choose your opponent; whether they are human or alien depends on which type of robot you choose!
Once everything has been decided upon, it's time for battle! You'll need to fight against other players in order to gain rank points which will allow you to upgrade your robot further down the road.
Mech fighting game Robot battles are fought with fly bot and give a new dimension to robot transformation. This game of the week Police robot games or Air robot for flying robot transforming plane will give you an adventurous fly robot superhero aspect of the jet robot games or future robot games. In this air robot battles survival of mankind is in the hands of transform robots who will lead the generation of robot squad and future robot jet plane. Monster robot have attacked the city and your combat action skills with flying bots abilities will help you destroy enemy jet bots. The airplane robot simulator keeps you entrenched in the flying robot games and the adrenaline rush for transform robots is the best in this robot hero games. This mech wars best robot games includes fly airplane, fight with bots, destroy ships, destroy tanks with the transforming jets capabilities. The hero robot league of jet bots gives you immense jet transform powers for the air robot. The airplane robot is the best robot games for flying, combat action and rescue. The best robot game is flying robot grand city rescue mission with open environment. The mech warriors police transform hero games is the most epic battle of present times. Save the world from evil robots with the help of flying and shooting robot games.
The city is under attack by evil robots and this future robot games with jet robot simulator has a super robot transformation in the air with mech warriors. The terrifying destruction of the mafia has to be curtailed by transforming jet game of the week. The futuristic battle of airline police is here with super robots

bluejetty:00115591:ios.description:
Meet your AI Baby Generator for fun, realistic future baby photos. Upload parent pictures, try Future Baby AI, and see what your baby could look like in just a few taps.
Use the future baby generator to create a possible baby face from two parent photos. Choose girl, boy, or surprise, and let the baby face generator create a natural-looking AI baby portrait for entertainment, sharing, and fun.
Explore more AI baby and family features:
AI Baby Generator
Upload photos of both parents and generate a cute future baby portrait inspired by their features. Use it as a playful future baby predictor, baby maker, and baby from parents photo tool to imagine what your future child could look like. Save favorites and share results with your partner, family, or friends.
Baby Photo Presets
Try ready-made AI photo presets and themed scenes. Create baby portraits, family moments, birthday looks, fairy-tale photos, baby bump themes, and more. Pick a style and let AI turn it into a shareable image.
Baby Age Progression
Imagine how a baby or child could look at different ages. Upload a photo, choose an age, and create a future-style portrait from childhood to adulthood.
Parent & Child Similarity
Wonder who your child looks like more? Upload your photo and a child’s photo to compare eyes, nose, lips, face shape, and brows. Get an overall similarity score and see which feature matches the most.
Couple Match
Upload two photos and get a playful compatibility result based on face harmony, smile energy, and baby potential. See your couple score, read a short AI insight, and jump into creating your future baby.
Face Insights
Upload a selfie to discover AI-powered face insights, including face symmetry, face shape, mood, dominant features, and a fun dominant gene-style insight.
Baby Name Ideas
Swipe through baby names for boys and girls, discover name meanings, and save the names you love. Build your own list and come back anytime.
Why you’ll love this baby maker app:
- AI baby generator from parent photos
- Future baby photos in just a few taps
- Future baby predictor for fun
- Baby prediction from two parent photos
- Baby face generator with girl, boy, and surprise options
- Baby from parents photo generation
- AI baby photo presets and themed scenes
- Baby age progression and grow-up effects
- Parent and child similarity comparison
- Couple compatibility and baby potential insights
- Face analysis with symmetry and feature insights
- Baby name picker with meanings
- Save and share your favorite results
This AI Baby Generator is made for entertainment, creativity, and fun with your partner, family, or friends. Results are AI-generated and are not scientific, genetic, medical, or parenting advice.
Create your future baby, explore family-inspired AI photos, and imagine the cutest possibilities today.
More information about subscriptions:
- The app has three types of subscriptions: weekly, monthly and yearly.
- Weekly subscriptions have a 3-day free trial period. At the end of the 3-day trial period, the subscription will be automatically renewed according to the rate, unless canceled before the end of the 3-day trial period.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- You will be billed for the subscription renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period with the renewal fee.
- You can manage subscriptions and disable auto-renewal after purchase by going to your App Store account settings.
- Subscriptions can be canceled at any time in your Apple ID settings. All prices include applicable local sales taxes.
- The unused portion of the free trial, if offered, will be canceled upon subscription purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://banautapp.com/policy.html
Terms of Use: https://banautapp.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00136844:ios.description:
FIBA BASKETBALL – Your Home for International Basketball
Get closer to the game with the official FIBA BASKETBALL app – your ultimate destination for international basketball and FIBA club competitions.
Follow your favourite teams, discover the latest basketball stories, track live scores, explore in-depth statistics and relive the best moments. From the biggest international tournaments to top club competitions, everything you love about basketball is just one tap away.
FOLLOW THE BIGGEST INTERNATIONAL COMPETITIONS
Experience the excitement of men's and women's basketball throughout the year, including:
• FIBA Basketball World Cup & Qualifiers
• FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup & Qualifying Tournaments
• FIBA AfroBasket & FIBA Women's AfroBasket
• FIBA AmeriCup & FIBA Women's AmeriCup
• FIBA Asia Cup & FIBA Women's Asia Cups
• FIBA EuroBasket & FIBA Women's EuroBasket
DISCOVER TOP CLUB COMPETITIONS
Follow the action beyond national teams with coverage of FIBA's leading club competitions, including:
• Basketball Champions League
• EuroLeague Women
New competitions are regularly added, so there's always more basketball to discover.
GET CLOSER TO THE ACTION
Stay informed with comprehensive editorial coverage tailored to your favourite teams. From game previews and breaking stories to post-game recap and exclusive insights, never miss the stories that matter.
FOLLOW EVERY STEP OF THE JOURNEY
Stay on top of every competition with the latest matchups, game schedules, results and standings. Track your favourite teams as they battle their way through each event.
NEVER MISS A MOMENT
Get real-time push notifications for your favourite teams and stay connected with the action through lock screen updates.
WATCH THE BEST OF BASKETBALL
Relive the excitement with the best plays and highlights from every game. Enjoy extended highlights, full-game videos and more unforgettable basketball moments.
EXPLORE THE GAME IN DEPTH
Go beyond the score with detailed statistics, team form guides, dedicated team pages and player profiles. Discover the numbers, performances and stories behind every game.
EXPERIENCE THE ENHANCED GAMECENTER
Follow every game as it happens with live scores, comprehensive box scores, play-by-play, lead trackers and advanced statistics.
TEST YOUR BASKETBALL KNOWLEDGE
Connect with your FIBA BASKETBALL account and take part in predictor games. Make your predictions and put your basketball knowledge to the test.
MAKE IT YOUR BASKETBALL EXPERIENCE
Choose your favourite teams and personalise your news feed, videos and notifications. Get the content you care about, all in one place.
Download the official FIBA BASKETBALL app and never miss a moment of FIBA competitions.

bluejetty:00022179:ios.name: SongSheet Pro: Setlist helper
bluejetty:00022179:ios.summary:
Lose the heavy binder. SongSheet Pro turns your iPad or iPhone into a stage-ready songbook: chord charts you can read at a glance, setlists ready for every gig or service, and any song in any key with one tap.
Built for guitarists, keyboar
bluejetty:00022179:ios.description:
Lose the heavy binder. SongSheet Pro turns your iPad or iPhone into a stage-ready songbook: chord charts you can read at a glance, setlists ready for every gig or service, and any song in any key with one tap.
Built for guitarists, keyboard players, singers, bands, worship teams and music teachers, SongSheet Pro replaces folders of paper with one organized library that goes with you to every rehearsal, gig and Sunday service.
PERFORM WITH CONFIDENCE
• Crisp, beautifully typeset chord charts and lyrics
• Auto-scroll, timed arrangements and backing tracks keep the music moving
• Turn songs hands-free with a Bluetooth pedal or the free SongSheet Remote app for iPhone
• Built-in metronome
• Themes for bright rooms, dark stages and projection, or design your own
SETLISTS FOR EVERY GIG AND SERVICE
• Group songs into sets, with each set's duration and the total running time
• Reorder with drag and drop, and swipe from song to song on stage
• Duplicate setlists to plan the next one in seconds
ANY KEY, INSTANTLY
• Transpose a whole song with one tap; chords are spelled naturally in the new key
• No key set? SongSheet suggests one from your chords, and changing the capo updates the chords for you
• Optional jazz chord notation
A REAL CHORD CHART EDITOR
SongSheet Pro is a true editor for lyrics and chords, not just a PDF viewer.
• Place chords exactly where they belong, from a palette that follows your key
• Rearrange verses and choruses by dragging them
• Add comments, guitar tabs and song notes
• Turn PDFs, Word and RTF documents, photos and paper scans into editable chord charts, with OCR for images
YOUR LIBRARY, SORTED
• Unlimited songs and setlists
• Tags, favorites and flags, with sorting by title, artist, key, tempo, time signature and more
• Search across titles, artists and tags
• Split View, Stage Manager, multiple windows and keyboard shortcuts on iPad
HELP THE ROOM SING
• Project lyrics to a TV or projector over AirPlay or a cable: ideal for worship, classrooms and sing-alongs
• Tap a verse to put it on the big screen, or blank the screen between songs
PRINT BEAUTIFULLY
• Full-screen live preview for printing and PDF export
• One- or two-column song layouts with control over fonts, colors, spacing and which details appear
• Setlist PDFs with set titles, durations and page numbering
BRING YOUR SONGS IN, TAKE THEM ANYWHERE
• Import from OnSong archives and backups, ChordPro, PDF, Word, RTF, plain text and WorshipReady.com
• Import via AirDrop, Files, iCloud Drive, Dropbox or other apps
• Export to ChordPro, PDF, OnSong and DSBsoft Song Sheet formats, plus CSV song lists
• Back up your whole library (songs, setlists, tags and themes) to a single file, and restore it any time
FREE TO VIEW AND EXPORT
Viewing and exporting your songs and setlists is always available, so your music is never locked in.
SongSheet Pro is updated regularly, shaped by feedback from working musicians. Got an idea? We'd love to hear it.
Email: support@songsheetapp.com
Web: https://songsheetapp.com
Terms: https://songsheetapp.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00179707:ios.description:
Reebok Fitness App 
Track, plan and analyse your training with the Reebok Fitness app. 
Whether you’re a fitness novice or seasoned pro, the app allows you to tailor, track and breakdown your workouts to get the most from your regime. Compatible with select Reebok Treadmills, Bikes and Cross Trainers; the app accurately monitors your progress to keep you motivated and on track. 
How it Works 
- Selected Reebok Treadmills, Bikes and Cross Trainers connect with the app via Bluetooth; allowing you to monitor your training without the need for GPS or internet connectivity. 
Track and Monitor 
- Record key stats such as speed, distance, time, cadence, watts and calories burned for live feedback and post-workout analysis. 
Analyse Workouts and View Progress 
- Keep tabs on your training and analyse the stats to improve performance and highlight your progress.
- Monitor weekly calorie burn and workout duration to stay on track and reach your fitness targets. 
- Gain in-depth insights by tracking your data and reviewing previous workouts. 
Customise Your Session
- Create unlimited custom training sessions for variety within your regime. 
- Capable of monitoring both steady state and interval training you’re free to tailor your workouts to suit your goals. 
Stay Connected
- Share your training successes instantly via Facebook, Twitter and Google+.
- Compare results and stats with friends online to stay motivated and up-to-date.
Integrated with Apple Watch.
WIth application on Apple Watch, you may have Apple Watch as your Heart Rate Monitor and view workout data while running app at background, the app will use HealthKit for fetching your Heart-Rate recording from Apple watch.

想弄清最近的收益来自哪里，或者回头看看某次买卖，可以直接问账本精灵。它会结合您授权的账户、持仓和交易记录来分析，也会记住您确认的偏好。想定期回顾账户变化，可以和它约定复盘时间。
【牛人交割单】
查看投资高手公开的交割单、持仓和历史表现。看看他们买了什么、什么时候调仓，再对照后续表现，了解不同投资者遇到相同市场

查看基金底层资产的重仓方向和行业分布，也可以结合基金经理与机构的持仓，了解不同组合的配置风格。

bluejetty:00069137:ios.description:
Let's be honest, not everyone has their own photographer at the rate, but everyone wants to have the perfect photo of yourself to share it on social media, send to parents or use on dating apps and you don't want to bother someone every time to help with it. Just ask the app to do it, it never gets tired :)
App provides custom camera to take photos with the specified interval. You can handle device in your hand and use different angles or put it somewhere to be focused on you and app will make as many photos as you want automatically. This makes it possible to take a picture of yourself on your own and choose only the perfect photos from the many taken. 
All photos are initially saved in internal app's memory and grouped into photosets to not get mixed with your device gallery photos. Photosets and photos can be conveniently managed such as save to gallery, delete, share etc. 
Camera has all needed features to take the perfect selfie: autofocus, configuration of photos interval in seconds and minutes, lock of screen sleep when camera is active, maximum image quality, disable or enable shutter sound, you can switch between all camera lens direction (for example between back and front cameras), flash mode.
UI is easy to use, built using material design and has support of dark mode to provide nice looking and convenient interface.

bluejetty:00023683:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00023683:ios.description:
Do you think you have what it takes to be a Turbo Star? Then hop on your skateboard and speed down the track in this wild and fast-paced racing game!
►HEART-POUNDING HIGH-SPEED RACING
Zoom through a wide variety of exhilarating tracks and defeat your opponents in a competitive skateboarding game that puts a fresh spin on the karting genre. The short tracks and rapid pace means that every move you make counts! Will you be the first racer to cross the finish line, or will you crash into a revolving wall and allow your rivals to get ahead of you?
Watch out: you’ll need more than just high velocity to succeed! While you’re racing, you’ll have to think fast to pick up items that will help you gain an advantage — or even pick up and throw your competitors if they get too close to you! Just make sure to dodge quickly enough to avoid any obstacles that will slow you down.
Don’t forget to snatch coins and keys to unlock a whole bunch of awesome items, including power-ups, new objects to ride on, and gear for your character. You can even perform impressive tricks during jumps to score some extra coins! Or take it to the next level and defy gravity in tunnels by doing loop-the-loops or riding upside-down on the ceiling!
► GAME FEATURES
• Win first place to unlock the next track, earn rubies, and wear the crown. Compete against up to 11 opponents.
• While racing, collect coins and keys to get access to new stuff. You can launch yourself into the air on the edges of pipes or over ramps to perform wild tricks for an extra boost of coins — not to mention speed!
• Grab helpful items that can give you the upper hand over your rivals like in traditional karting games. Snatch a protective ring of spinning swords, a magnet that attracts coins, or a bolt of lightning that strikes the track. Plus, toss your opponents in the air to get ahead!
• As you level-up, you can increase your overall speed, coin bonuses, and starting boost to maintain the edge over your rivals. Don’t miss opportunities to play the bonus mini-game, where you can open treasure chests to find the best reward!
• Save up coins and rubies and earn rewards. Get new skateboards and other objects to ride on, like hoverboards, rocket packs, scooters, unicycles, roller skates, beach balls, and more.
• Customize your character with plenty of cool skins, emotes, and tricks! Choose looks and accessories to match your skate style.
• Enjoy fun sound effects and wacky graphics with colorful race tracks and beautiful backgrounds.
Are you feeling bored? Then jump on a board! Download Turbo Stars and start racing right now!

Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00046912:ios.name: Pipe Fitting
bluejetty:00046912:ios.summary: Pipe Fitting is a pipe fitting calculator for offsets, rolling offsets and elbow cuts. Enter the offset and the fitting angle, and it gives you the travel, the take-out of each elbow and the length to cut, with the welder's gap already allo
bluejetty:00046912:ios.description:
Pipe Fitting is a pipe fitting calculator for offsets, rolling offsets and elbow cuts. Enter the offset and the fitting angle, and it gives you the travel, the take-out of each elbow and the length to cut, with the welder's gap already allowed for.
Example: a 12" offset with two 2" long-radius 45° elbows and a 1/16" gap. The travel is 16.97", each elbow takes out 1.24", and you cut the pipe at 14.36".
• Basic offset: any two of run, offset and angle give the travel and the cut length, with or without gaps.
• Rolling offset calculator: offset, roll and run (or the angle) give the travel and the cut length.
• Parallel offsets: the cutback for pipes running side by side.
• Back-to-back elbows: X° + Y° and 90° + X° fittings from a center-to-center distance, with the angle to cut.
• Elbow miter cut: cut any angle from a standard 90 and mark it, with the outside (heel), inside (throat) and centerline arcs and the chords.
• Take-outs for short-radius, long-radius and 3R elbows, from 1/8" to 48" NPS and DN6 to DN1200.
• Triangle solver: any three sides or angles give the rest, plus perimeter and area.
• Feet, inches and fractions down to 1/16", or meters, centimeters and millimeters: pick the unit on the keypad.
• Results update as you type, and each calculator keeps your last numbers.
• Siri: say "Rolling offset with Pipe Fitting" to open it hands-free.
• On iPhone and iPad.
HOW TO CALCULATE A ROLLING OFFSET
True offset = √(offset² + roll²), and travel = √(offset² + roll² + run²). With 45° fittings the run equals the true offset, so the travel is the true offset × 1.414, the 45° offset multiplier. For a 12" offset with an 8" roll: true offset 14.42", travel 20.40". Take off two 1.24" elbows and two 1/16" gaps, and the cut is 17.79". Pipe Fitting does every step for you.
Built for pipefitters, steamfitters, pipe welders, plumbers and apprentices, in the shop or on the job site. All seven calculators are free to use with ads; Premium removes them.
Made by xNeat, the team behind Calculator+ and Conduit Bending.

bluejetty:00115206:ios.description:
AI Transcribe: Note Taker – Record, Transcribe, Summarize & Learn Smarter
Never miss an important detail again. AI Transcribe: Note Taker is your all-in-one AI-powered productivity assistant for transcribing audio, summarizing meetings, creating study aids, and even generating presentations—all in over 90+ languages.
Whether you’re in a business meeting, attending a lecture, conducting a sales call, or working on research, AI Transcribe helps you capture, organize, and act on your conversations in seconds.
Key Features for Maximum Productivity
Transcribe Audio & Meetings
- Record and convert your audio into highly accurate transcriptions.
- Works for in-person meetings, lectures, interviews, and personal dictations.
Summarize & Simplify
- Turn long conversations into concise summaries, key points, or actionable meeting minutes.
- Get ready-made speech scripts, sales call breakdowns, or medical reports with just one tap.
90+ Languages Supported
- Transcribe and translate in real-time across 90+ languages.
- Perfect for global teams, international students, and multilingual workflows.
AI Chat with Your Transcript
- Ask questions directly from your transcript to find insights fast.
- No more searching through hours of text—just ask and get answers instantly.
Smart Learning Tools
- Mind Maps & Flashcards for visual learning—ideal for students.
- Create a custom study plan or quiz test from your notes.
Advanced AI Use Cases
- Create PowerPoint presentation outlines instantly.
- Draft a custom tone summary—write like any famous author or speaker.
- Summarize into clear, action-ready meeting minutes for teams.
Who Is It For?
Professionals – Take accurate meeting minutes, analyze sales calls, and prepare reports.
Students & Educators – Record lectures, create flashcards, and design study plans in minutes.
Medical & Research Fields – Generate reports from recorded notes with ease.
Content Creators & Speakers – Turn transcripts into ready-to-use scripts or presentations.
Why Choose AI Transcribe?
Save hours of manual note-taking.
Stay organized with searchable transcriptions and AI summaries.
Boost productivity by focusing on the conversation, not the notes.
Easy Sharing & Organization
Export your notes and summaries as PDF, text, or shareable links. Organize them into categories for quick access and collaboration.

bluejetty:00014996:ios.summary: Bring your dream spaces to life with ARki, the ultimate 3D Home Design & Room Planner App that blends simplicity with professional-grade power. Whether you’re a DIYer refreshing a bedroom, a homeowner planning a renovation, or an architect
bluejetty:00014996:ios.description:
Bring your dream spaces to life with ARki, the ultimate 3D Home Design & Room Planner App that blends simplicity with professional-grade power. Whether you’re a DIYer refreshing a bedroom, a homeowner planning a renovation, or an architect crafting a client’s vision, ARki makes interior design, house design, and architecture drawing accessible, fun, and precise.
Design My Room in Minutes - No Expertise Required!
ARki’s Smart Draw tools and LiDAR scanning let you create room layouts effortlessly. Skip the tape measure - capture room dimensions instantly or sketch floor plans freehand. Dive into a library of 1,000+ 3D furniture models to design homes or decorate house spaces with confidence. Test paint colors, swap flooring textures, and experiment with home decor styles in real time. Visualize every detail in stunning 3D or step into life-sized AR to “walk through” your 3D house design before making real-world changes.
Homeowner-Friendly Features:
- Floor Plan Creator: Generate accurate room layouts, multi level plans, with LiDAR or 2D drawing.
- 3D Room Planner Library: Choose sofas, lighting, rugs, and decor to design room spaces that reflect your style.
- Ai image: Generate realistic views of your project from your 3d scene. 
- AR Visualization: See furniture scale and home decor choices in augmented reality 
- Sync & Share: Collaborate with partners or contractors via 2D snapshots, videos, or interactive plans.
- Drag-and-Drop Simplicity: Rearrange furniture, adjust wall colors, and test layouts in seconds.
For Architects & Design Pros: Precision Meets Creativity
ARki Pro elevates architecture design and interior decorating with tools tailored for professionals:
- Import 3D Models: Use FBX/GLB files from SketchUp, Revit, Blender, 3Dsmax or AutoCAD to build layered projects.
- Mixed Reality Mode: Overlay 3D house designs onto real-world sites for immersive client presentations.
- 1:1 Scale Accuracy: Position objects, apply real-time shadows, and animate models for flawless architectural drawing.
- Material Palettes & Explode Tool: Showcase texture options and deconstruct designs to highlight details.
- Unlimited Projects: Save, edit, and share unlimited architectural projects.
Why ARki Wins Over Home Lovers
- Room Designer Made Easy: Just intuitive tools to decorate house spaces like a pro.
- Budget-Smart Planning: Test bold room decor ideas risk-free. Love that emerald green wall? Preview it in AR first.
- Flexible Home Planner: Perfect for studio apartments, sprawling homes, or virtual staging.
- Cross-Device Freedom: Start on your iPhone, refine on your iPad, and present on your Mac - seamlessly.
Transform Your Space Today
ARki isn’t just a floor plan creator—it’s your pocket designer. Redesign a single room or reimagine an entire property with tools that empower everyone, from interior decorating novices to architecture design experts.
Perfect For:
- Homeowners craving a home design 3D makeover.
- Renters wanting to visualize room decor before moving in.
- Pros presenting 3D house designs or buildings in jaw-dropping AR.
- Compatibility: For floor scanning use LiDAR-enabled iOS devices
Unlock ARki Personal subscription to gain access to the full catalogue of 3d interior models, as well as accurate edit and draw features, which help you create designs faster. 
Upgrade to ARki Professional Subscription to explore the full toolkit for professional designers.
Explore tutorials and inspiration: http://www.darfdesign.com/arki.html
Subscription Prices are set by Apple's App Store Matrix in $USD. Subscriptions are charged to your iTunes account at purchase and renewal. Free trials auto-renew to paid plans unless cancelled 24 hours before expiry in iTunes settings. Cancellations take effect after the current period, downgrading to free. Unused trial time is forfeited if you subscribe before it ends.
Privacy Policy: https://www.darfdesign.com/privacypolicy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.darfdesign.com/termsofuse.html

bluejetty:00039245:ios.description:
Exercise from home or wherever you want. Access live and On Demand classes for Indoor Cycling, Box, Cardio, Yoga, Barre and Functional.
More than 50 new weekly classes for you to train and exercise every day. Live Fitness classes so you can exercise your body and do gymnastics at home.
If you already know Síclo, it is your opportunity to bring the intensity of study to your home. Access live classes with your favorite instructors from Síclo, BALA, Kentro, Erre Barré and YO from the same platform.
Classes, training and exercise routines for men and women.
Síclo is a fun cardiovascular exercise where you roll to the beat of music and work different muscles in the body.
We have classes of 15, 30, 45 and 60 minutes so you can choose the one that best suits you and through which you can:
- Transform your state of physical and mental well-being.
- Get out of your comfort zone
- Release energy
- Make exercise a habit in your life.
- Work on your condition and resistance.
- Start or end your day in the best way.
BALA is a combination of box and functional.
Each class is designed to reach your highest level. It doesn't matter if it's your first time or if you're an expert, at BALA you work every muscle in your body.
- Change your body
- Real results
- Improve your cardiovascular capacity
- Increase your physical performance
- Increase your muscle mass
- Tone your entire body
- Create a healthy habit in your life
YO is Yoga and meditation designed for everyone. It doesn't matter if you are a complete yogi or a beginner, find your space of calm in the midst of chaos while you work your body and mind.
- Calm your mind
- Reduces stress
- Improve your flexibility
- Tone your body
- Stretch deep
- Yoga for all levels
- Meditations with intention
Erre Barre is barre training to the beat of music. We combine the magic of ballet, yoga and pilates to create a complete method that will change your body forever. We take care of your body while you strengthen all your muscles. Sing, dance and flow, Let's go beyond the bar!
- Have fun while you exercise
- Ideal for pregnant women or people with injuries
- Tone your body
- Decrease your body fat percentage
- Lengthen your muscles
- Improve your posture
- Strengthens your entire body
- Mark your muscles
- Improve your flexibility
Síclo uses HealthKit to collect information about your health, such as the calories and heart rate you have when doing a workout in our disciplines. To improve your experience of our app, we recommend that you activate this function.

bluejetty:00122053:ios.description:
Send custom hologram messages to friends and family and appear right in their home. Share your holograms from the app and the recipient gets the message with the full AR experience. Try the HoloBot theme and beam your message just like the rebels did a long time ago in a galaxy far, far away... Wishing someone Happy Birthday? Use the birthday theme and your hologram will include dancing presents and balloons! Unlike other message apps, Reflo uses the video you capture and makes it appear in the room along with your selected theme. Record your child singing Happy Birthday with Reflo, then share it and they will see them singing right in the room with them. Through the magic of Augmented Reality (AR), connect with friends and family in a new and exciting way.
Reflo makes sharing easy. Using a text, or your favorite messaging service, share a hologram with your friends and family, all from within the app. Privacy is important for these kinds of memories, so all Reflo holograms are shared privately, and you are always in control of who has access. Simply remove someone from the share list and your hologram message will be removed from their list.
Reflo is free to download, and includes one theme for free. Additional themes are available through a subscription to Reflo Premium. Reflo premium will also fund future development of themes and features.

Turrit is a messenger built to deliver a superior messaging experience while maintaining strong security and privacy standards. As an enhanced messaging platform based on the latest Telegram technology, Turrit combines familiar communication features with exclusive upgrades designed to give you more control, efficiency, and flexibility in everyday conversations.
More than just a messenger, Turrit offers a Plus experience — empowering users with premium tools, refined performance, and smarter message management across chats, groups, and channels.
Key Features
Video Page
Discover a TikTok-style video feed tailored to your interests. Customise video content from your favourite channels and groups, all in one immersive viewing experience.
Premium User Experience & Advanced Management
Enjoy higher limits, enhanced chat organisation, and powerful tools designed for users who value control and productivity. From smarter chat folders to improved navigation, Turrit helps you manage conversations with ease.
Text, Voice & Video Communication
Stay connected through fast and reliable messaging, crystal-clear voice calls, and high-quality video calls — whether you’re chatting one-on-one or in groups.
Fast & Reliable File Transfers
