Mindsera is an AI journal that reflects back: it asks the right questions, remembers what you've written, and shows you the patterns in how you think and feel.
Featured by Apple in Apps We Love. Covered by The New Yorker, Forbes and Psyche. Used by 80,000+ people.
“A lot of the feedback I receive from Mindsera is as good as, if not better than, what I could give my clients.” — Dr. Amy Van Buren, Clinical Psychologist
LOVED BY PEOPLE, PRESS, MENTAL HEALTH PROS
• Dr. David Barry, Clinical Psychologist: “I am a clinical psychologist based in London and really like what you're doing!”
• Michael, journaler: “I am really enjoying Mindsera. It’s one of the most bang for your buck purchases I’ve ever made.”
• Anonymous, journaler: “I have a pretty strong ADHD, and I’ve just hit a 21-day streak with Mindsera which might be the longest I’ve ever consistently stuck with a habit overnight. That’s a real testament to how well the platform is designed. Thank you for creating something that’s genuinely improving my life.”
• Marie, journaler: “Mindsera is transformative. I have built up knowledge about my trauma and how it affects my relationships currently. I’ve come to understand some of my core wounds and where they came from. It is there 24/7 and can really help pull someone through a bad time so it does not end up as a crisis."
JOURNAL THAT REFLECTS BACK
• Thoughtful companion who knows you and asks just the right questions
• Reflect more deeply, explore new perspectives, and uncover fresh insights
• Fully customisable tone, personality & spirituality
INNOVATIVE GROUP REFLECTION
• Invite AI “Minds” to highlight passages and add insightful comments
• Built-in ‘Minds’ like Alternative Perspectives, Thinking Traps, Stoic Principles, Past Memories
• Create custom ‘Minds’ for any topic, personality, or therapy style
UNCOVER HIDDEN PATTERNS
• Analyze single entries or your whole journal over any timeframe
• Connect thoughts and emotions to uncover hidden thinking patterns
• Automatic emotion analysis (Plutchik's model) that shows how your feelings shift over time
• Big Five personality snapshot, recurring topics detection, and personalized suggestions for improvement
• Chat with your journal: “When do I feel most anxious?” or “What are my blind spots”, etc.
VOICE JOURNALING & SCAN
• Speak and auto-transcribe for hands free reflection
• Scan handwritten journals for automatic text extraction
PRIVACY FOCUSED, HUMAN CENTRIC
• Encrypted, private, and secure by design
• From independent, user-funded team (no ads or data resale)
• Data never used to train or improve AI models
• Passcode for extra layer of security
• AI that enhances your mind, but doesn’t try to replace it
CUSTOMIZE TO MAKE IT YOURS
• Light & dark modes + seven colour themes
• Turn entries into original artworks in the style you choose
• Minimal, distraction-free editor to boost clarity of thought
JOURNALING TEMPLATES & COURSES
• 50+ guided frameworks: CBT, anxiety, overthinking, gratitude journal, productivity, decision-making, problem-solving, and more
• Courses like the ‘7-Day Journaling Challenge’ introduce core methods and expand your thinking
HELPS TO STAY CONSISTENT
• Morning / evening prompts for easy habit building
• Streak tracking and smart reminders
• Weekly targets keep your cognitive-fitness habit on track
YOUR WEEK WRAPPED
• Automated email recap: entry count, streaks, writing time
• Overview of thoughts, mindset analysis & tailored suggestions
Journaling is one of the most impactful mental health and cognitive fitness habits you can have. Start today.
–––
Disclaimer: Mindsera is a self reflection tool and not a substitute for professional mental-health care. For medical advice or crisis support, please consult a qualified provider.

bluejetty:00090367:ios.description:
Stop guessing what your skin needs.
Skan is a skincare and beauty app that helps you scan your skin, check skincare products, find product matches, and build a routine around your skin.
Take a selfie to understand visible skin concerns like acne, redness, pores, pigmentation, wrinkles, eye bags, and more. Then use Skan to review skincare products, explore ingredient insights, and track your skin progress.
Some product matching and product scanning features require a Skan Premium subscription purchased separately.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE SKAN
1. Scan your skin in minutes
2. Find skincare products that match you — Requires Skan Premium
3. Track your routine and skin progress
4. Check products before you buy or use them
SKIN SCAN & ANALYSIS
• Take a selfie and get personalized skin insights
• Understand concerns like acne, pores, redness, dark spots, pigmentation, wrinkles, and eye bags
• See what your skin may need to focus on next
• Track changes over time instead of guessing from mirror selfies
PRODUCT FINDER — REQUIRES SKAN PREMIUM
• Find cleansers, serums, moisturizers, sunscreen, exfoliants, toners, masks, and more
• Compare product matches based on your skin type, goals, concerns, and preferences
• Discover skincare products that fit your routine
• Search products before you buy, switch, or add another step
PRODUCT SCANNER — REQUIRES SKAN PREMIUM
• Scan or search skincare products before using them
• Check ingredient information and product details in one place
• See whether a product may be a better fit for your skin
• Check viral TikTok skincare, trending serums, and confusing claims
ROUTINE BUILDER
• Build a skincare routine around your skin
• Keep track of products you use morning and night
• Make your routine simpler and easier to follow
• Avoid stacking random products that do not match your goals
PROGRESS TRACKING
• Save skin scans and compare your progress over time
• Track changes in acne, redness, pores, pigmentation, and other visible concerns
• See whether your routine is helping before switching products
• Stay consistent with a skincare plan you understand
INGREDIENT INSIGHTS
• Learn what is inside your skincare products
• Review ingredient information without opening 20 tabs
• Understand why a product may or may not fit your skin
• Make more confident skincare decisions
SKAN CAN HELP WITH
• Acne routines
• Redness-prone skin
• Clogged pores
• Dark spots and pigmentation
• Wrinkles and fine lines
• Eye bags and under-eye concerns
• Dry skin routines
• Oily skin routines
• Sensitive skin routines
• Product matching
• Ingredient research
• Skin progress tracking
• Makeup prep product checks
• Sunscreen, cleanser, serum, and moisturizer matching
BEFORE YOU BUY ANOTHER PRODUCT
Skincare is confusing. One serum goes viral. A cleanser has perfect reviews. Someone on Reddit says a product saved their skin. Someone on TikTok says it ruined theirs.
But their skin is not your skin.
Use Skan to check products with your skin in mind. Whether you are shopping for a cleanser, serum, moisturizer, sunscreen, acne treatment, exfoliant, toner, or face mask, Skan helps you compare options with more context.
BEFORE YOU CHANGE YOUR ROUTINE
Sometimes your skin does not need another random product. Sometimes it needs fewer products, better matches, and more consistency.
Skan helps you scan your skin, understand what is changing, check your products, and build a routine that makes sense for you.
SKINCARE THAT STARTS WITH YOU
Not TikTok’s skin. Not ChatGPT’s answer. Not a stranger’s Sephora review. Your skin.
Start with a skin scan. Check your skincare products. Find what matches you.
IMPORTANT
Skan provides skincare insights and product information to help you make informed decisions. Skan is not a medical device and does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment. For medical concerns, severe acne, irritation, allergic reactions, or skin conditions, talk to a licensed healthcare professional.

bluejetty:00074035:ios.summary: UV Index Widget - Worldwide brings one of the most useful pieces of weather data, the UV Index, front and center. Use this app to track your UV exposure, help plan your day outside, and avoid burning. Perfect for planning your tanning routi
bluejetty:00074035:ios.description:
UV Index Widget - Worldwide brings one of the most useful pieces of weather data, the UV Index, front and center. Use this app to track your UV exposure, help plan your day outside, and avoid burning. Perfect for planning your tanning routine.
UV Index Widget - Worldwide is a convenient app that lets you monitor the Sun’s radiation levels anywhere on Earth. It shows the current UV Index, today’s peak forecast, and a 7-day UV forecast. You can add the UV Index to your Home Screen via widgets, receive alerts when UV Index reaches specific levels, and automatically log the data to your Apple Health app.
The app instantly displays your current UV Index (UVI) in an easy-to-understand format. Just tap and hold to view today's highest UVI reading. You can also check the sunrise and sunset times, along with the moment when the UV Index peaks. 
7-day hour-by-hour forecast:
The Forecast tab provides an hour-by-hour UVI prediction for the next 7 days.
My Skin:
In the My Skin section, select your skin type for tailored safety tips and recommendations. You can also monitor your sun exposure and receive alerts when there’s a high risk of sunburn. Additionally, the app tracks your Vitamin D production from sunlight and automatically syncs the data to your Apple Health app.
Places:
In the Places tab, you can select any location around the world to see its current UV radiation and a 7-day forecast. It's a great tool for checking the UV levels at your travel destination before you head out.
Widget:
The app offers a variety of Home Screen widgets and Lock Screen Widgets, designed for both your iPhone and Apple Watch. Choose from multiple options to customize your experience on the Home Screen, Today view and Apple Watch.
Notifications:
The app alerts you when the UV Index exceeds your specified threshold, sending a notification whenever your area's UV levels surpass that mark. It also warns you when you're at high risk of sunburn and reminds you to reapply sunscreen.
Apple Health app:
The app automatically logs your location's hourly UV Index and the vitamin D generated from sun exposure into the Apple Health app. Open Apple Health to review your UV exposure history and vitamin D data.
Apple Watch:
Monitor the UV Index directly from your watch. Tap and hold to view today's peak UVI, just like in the iOS app. The watch app also features a My Skin section and a 7-day hourly forecast. Additionally, you can always check the UVI right on your favorite watch face using the included UVI complications.
The app will work anywhere in the world, and is a perfect companion whether you are at home or travelling.

Get the world's most popular pregnancy & baby tracker app, and discover what to expect on a week-by-week basis with all the pregnancy information you need!

WeMoms offers you an all-in-one experience with medical expert content, daily personalized articles, and interactive 3D experience to track your baby’s development. 

Chosen by millions of pregnant mothers, learn everything you need to know, with fresh personalized content every day - from getting pregnant through the first years of your baby. 
Join our global community today filled with welcoming moms-to-be - you’ll feel supported along your pregnancy journey. 

Track Your Baby’s Development
- Discover your 3D baby to track his/her evolution week by week
- Visualize your baby's size using the Baby Size Guide
- Explore our Week-by-Week Guides explain what to expect during each stage
- Stay informed with a Pregnancy Timeline highlighting important milestones and countdown until the big day! 

Explore Personalized Pregnancy Guides & Tips
- Comprehensive Pregnancy and Maternity Guides covering topics tailored to your needs: pregnancy complications, childbirth preparation, breastfeeding, first or second pregnancy, mental health, exercise, food, and more
- Daily articles and tips to track and manage your symptoms and find if it’s normal 
- Personalized Pregnancy Articles based on your pregnancy stage
- Valuable tips, tricks, and advice from other pregnant moms, thanks to our community

Pregnancy Tools to Track Each Aspect of Your Journey to Motherhood
- Use the Pregnancy Due Date Calculator to determine when your bundle of joy will arrive
- Track your baby's movements and activity with the Kick Counter
- Keep an eye on your weight changes with the Pregnancy Weight Log
- Measure contractions throughout your labor with the Contraction Timer

Organize & Plan
- Plan and document your prenatal appointments with the Pregnancy Calendar
- Prepare for your hospital visit with the Hospital Bag checklist for Mother

Pregnancy Features
- Personalized advice and support throughout your pregnancy journey
- Community of over 1 million moms to connect with
- Track your baby's growth in 3D imagery
- Information and advice on a wide range of pregnancy and motherhood topics
- Available in multiple languages

Birth Partner & Baby
- Stay organized with the To-Do List and Baby Shopping List
- Find inspiration and share your favorite Baby Names from a vast collection

Our 3D Models
Immerse yourself in our exclusive 3D models that depict the week-by-week development of your pregnancy, from blastocyst to fetus to baby. These realistic models allow you to truly connect with your growing baby.
- Choose from multiple ethnicities to personalize your experience
- Zoom in, zoom out, and rotate to view intricate details of your baby
- Watch guided pregnancy week-by-week walk-throughs for a deeper understanding
- Tap to witness the baby's movements in action

All subjects on WeMoms:
Pregnancy, pregnant, childbirth, childbearing, fetus, motherhood, prenatal, baby, fetal, birth, maternity, contraception, womb, fertility, contraceptive, unborn, Pregnancy, Due Date, Calculator Labor & Delivery, Pregnancy Week by Week, Pregnancy Symptoms, Morning Sickness, Pregnancy Weight Gain Calculator, New Fetal Development, Screenings & Tests, Pregnancy Complications, Preparing for Baby, Baby Names, Top Baby Names for Boys, Top Baby Names, Getting Pregnant, Fertility, Ovulation Calculator, Ovulation Symptoms, Preparing for Pregnancy, Bleeding, Interpreting Pregnancy Test, Postpartum Recovery, Newborn Care, Breastfeeding, Baby Sleep, Gassy Baby Relief, Pregnant, Getting Pregnant, Pregnancy, First Year, Toddler, Family, Baby Products, Maternity, Nursing & Feeding, Pregnancy Pillows, WeMoms app, Baby Tracker

bluejetty:00046243:ios.description:
Note: This app is exclusively for participants of the Seniors Farmers Market Nutrition Program (SFMNP) in the following states and requires a valid eSFMNP card number to access benefit balance information and purchase history:
WASHINGTON
More states will be added soon, so please be sure to check back if you don’t see your state!
Welcome to the SFMNP Benefits Tracker & Farmers Market Guide, the ultimate companion app for participants of the Seniors Farmers Market Nutrition Program (SFMNP). Whether you're looking to check your benefit balance, find local farmers markets, or view your purchase history, the SFMNP app has you covered.
Key Features:
Benefit Balance Tracking:
Effortlessly keep track of your SFMNP benefit balance. The app allows you to conveniently check your remaining benefits at any time, so you can plan your shopping trips accordingly.
Display Code for Purchases:
Ready to make a purchase? Use the “QR Code” button to show the farmer the QR code they need to make the purchase happen. After the farmer scans your code and the sale is complete, your new balance will available in the app within minutes.
View Your Purchase History:
Use the app to view the last 90 of purchases with your SFMNP benefits.
Farmers Market Locator:
Discover nearby farmers markets that accept SFMNP payments. Utilize the app's intuitive map feature to explore a wide selection of markets in your area. Get detailed information about market locations and the days and times that they are active.
Reminders and Notifications:
Stay up-to-date with important SFMNP program updates, recall notifications, and alerts when your benefits are expiring with customizable notifications and reminders. 
User-Friendly Interface:
Enjoy a user-friendly and intuitive interface that caters to seniors' needs. The app's design ensures clear navigation and readability, making it easy for you to access the features you need with minimal effort.
Nutrition Education:
Depending on your state program, you may have access to a wealth of nutrition education resources tailored specifically for seniors. Learn about healthy eating habits, meal planning, and the nutritional benefits of various fruits, vegetables, and other produce commonly found at farmers markets.
The SFMNP Benefits Tracker & Farmers Market Guide is your one-stop solution for managing your SFMNP benefits, exploring local farmers markets, and expanding your nutrition knowledge. Empower yourself to make healthy food choices and support local farmers with this comprehensive app.
Download the app now and embark on a journey towards healthier living and supporting local farmers!

bluejetty:00077286:ios.summary: Uncover the mystery of Chichen Itza with this ultimate self-guided audio tour. Walk through one of the Seven Wonders of the World and explore its stunning Mayan ruins, including the famous El Castillo step pyramid. Learn the fascinating his
bluejetty:00077286:ios.description:
Uncover the mystery of Chichen Itza with this ultimate self-guided audio tour. Walk through one of the Seven Wonders of the World and explore its stunning Mayan ruins, including the famous El Castillo step pyramid. Learn the fascinating history of the ancient Mayan civilization, including their culture, architecture, and secrets, all narrated by local experts. Available in English and Spanish.
Discover Chichen Itza:
Immerse yourself in the rich history and mystical culture of the Mayan Empire as you explore this world-renowned archaeological site. Journey through the ruins of this ancient city, and learn about the Jaguar Warriors, human sacrifices, and the significance of El Castillo, the Pyramid of Kukulkan. Our app will guide you seamlessly through Chichen Itza’s most famous sites, from the Great Ball Court to the Sacred Cenote.
Tour Highlights:
▶El Castillo: The Pyramid of Kukulkan
▶The Great Ball Court
▶Tzompantli: The Wall of Skulls
▶Sacred Cenote: The Sacrificial Waters
▶Temple of the Warriors
▶El Caracol: The Observatory
▶The Nunnery Complex
And more! With stories written by historians and narrated by professionals, this app ensures you won’t miss a single detail during your journey through Chichen Itza.
Key Features:
▶ Self-Guided Flexibility
Explore at your own pace with total freedom. No tour schedules or crowded groups. Pause, skip, or linger at any stop you wish.
▶ GPS-Enabled Audio
Automatic, GPS-triggered audio stories play as you approach each point of interest. Simply follow the route, and the app does the rest!
▶ Works Offline
Download the tour in advance and enjoy uninterrupted access even when there’s no cell service. Perfect for remote areas.
▶ Lifetime Access
Pay once, and access the tour forever. No subscriptions, no time limits, and no restrictions on usage.
▶ Award-Winning Technology
This app, featured on Thrillist and WBZ, won the Laurel Award for Technology. Used for over a million tours annually, it's trusted by travelers worldwide.
Free Demo Available!
Curious about the tour? Try the free demo version and see how the app works. Upgrade to unlock the full experience and explore Chichen Itza in-depth.
New Tours Available!
■ Tulum Ruins
Discover the ancient coastal city of Tulum and learn about its rise to power, port significance, and unique hurricane warning system.
■ Ek Balam
Walk through the less-traveled ruins of Ek Balam, where impressive architecture and secrets await.
■ Coba Ruins
Explore Coba, the ancient Mayan city with towering pyramids and scenic jungle paths.
Important Notes:
Download in Advance: Ensure you download the tour over Wi-Fi or data before entering the park.
Battery Tips: Bring a fully charged phone or an external battery pack for uninterrupted use.
Enable Location Services: Allow GPS access so the app can automatically trigger audio stories during the tour.
T&C - https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Suddenly, some of the celebrities faced traumas
The cases showed that their biorhythms weren't good. Was it a coincidence?
◉ What is biorhythm?
Biorhythm is the physiological cycle of a physical, emotional, and Intellectual. These three cycles are repeated in a uniform pattern based on your birthdays, and there is a difference in activity efficiency or ability depending on the combination of these patterns.
The four rhythm cycles and calculations are as follows.
d = number of days of living
Physical rhythm: sin (2π d / 23)
Emotional rhythm: sin (2π d / 28)
Intellectual rhythm: sin (2π d / 33)
Intuitive rhythm: sin (2π d / 38)
Each rhythm has a value from -100 to +100, and this value indicates the status.
Low stage: -100 to -1
High stage: +1 to +100
Dangerous Days: 0 (at the time of transition from + value to - value or from - value to + value)

– Immersive sound effects for a fun-filled escape experience

– Exciting hide & seek escape gameplay
– Cute hamster customization and unlockable skins
– Challenging puzzle mazes to master
– Mystery boxes and hidden rewards
– New levels and escape challenges added regularly

Dear users, 
Because we want to accompany every athlete during their training, we have created the Domyos E Connected application.

Built-in advanced scanning algorithms allow image enhancement, shadow and noise removing, automatic perspective correction, and more. With all its features, this app is sure to become an indispensable fax tool.

- What it feels like outside right now
- When rain starts and stops, minute by minute

bluejetty:00073652:ios.description:
Umbrella or not? Jacket or T-shirt? Leave now or in ten minutes? Weather + answers the questions you ask every morning, so you step outside ready.
- What it feels like outside right now
- When rain starts and stops, minute by minute
- The next hours and the next 16 days
- Alerts before rain, frost, heat, or strong wind
- Live radar for your area
KNOW WHEN THE RAIN STARTS
A minute-by-minute chart of the next hour shows when rain starts, peaks, and stops. You know if you have time to walk the dog or if you should wait ten minutes.
FORECASTS FOR YOUR DAY AND YOUR WEEK
Hour by hour: temperature, feels-like temperature, rain chance, wind, and UV index. You choose which details appear and how many hours ahead you see. Day by day: highs and lows up to 16 days ahead. Today's sunrise and sunset times are there too.
ALERTS BEFORE THE WEATHER CHANGES
Choose what you want to hear about: rain one hour before it starts, rain ending, snow, heat, frost, strong wind, high UV, or a sharp change in temperature. Add a morning or evening summary at the time you pick. Official severe weather alerts for your area appear with your forecast.
LIVE WEATHER MAPS
Watch rain move on the live radar and play the timeline. Switch to another layer when you need it: wind, temperature, cloud cover, lightning, tropical cyclones, air quality, wildfires, ocean, or earthquakes.
AIR QUALITY AND UV
See the air quality index with PM2.5, PM10, ozone, NO2, SO2, and CO, and clear advice on whether it is a good time to be outdoors. The UV index comes with sun protection advice.
WHAT TO WEAR
On devices with Apple Intelligence, Weather + suggests what to wear for the current conditions.
A SKY THAT MATCHES YOURS
The animated background follows the real sky: clear, cloudy, rain, snow, fog, or thunderstorm, by day and by night.
WIDGETS
Put the forecast on your Home Screen in three sizes. Add temperature, rain chance, UV index, or wind to your Lock Screen. Each widget follows your location or a city you choose.
ALL YOUR PLACES
Home, work, your next trip. Search any city in the world, save your favorites, and switch between them quickly.
SIRI AND SHORTCUTS
Ask Siri "Will it rain today in Weather +?" or get the forecast for any saved place, hands-free.
MADE FOR YOU
Choose your units for temperature, rain, and wind, and a 12-hour or 24-hour clock.
RELIABLE DATA
Forecasts come from Vaisala Xweather, a professional weather data provider.
Download Weather + and know what to expect before you open the door.
Some features are available with a paid subscription.

Independent Bank Mobile Banking—a better way of banking.
Manage your finances wherever and whenever you want. Independent Bank Mobile Banking allows easy access to your accounts directly from your mobile device.
All you need to do is enter your Independent Bank Online Banking ID and password and log in. If you forget your online ID or password, simply call 1-888-716-9293 ext. 298 for assistance.
Use your mobile device to:
• CHECK BALANCES—See current online banking account balances.
• PAY BILLS—Submit payments to registered billing accounts in your Independent Bank Bill Pay system.
• TRANSFER FUNDS—Transfer funds between your eligible i-bank accounts.
• DEPOSIT CHECKS—Snap a picture of your check and deposit it from practically any location.
• LOCATE—Find the nearest i-Bank branch or ATM using your GPS-enabled device.
To ensure all your accounts and transactions are secure, Independent Bank has implemented the following security measures:
• No account numbers are used with this app—we only use aliases that mask your account and biller info.
• All transmitted information is sent and received using state-of-the-art encryption methods.
• A password is required each and every time you sign in to Independent Bank Mobile Banking.
• Only transfers between existing accounts can be made—you cannot add a new account using the app.
• Bill payments can only be made to existing billing accounts—you cannot add a new billing account using the app.
• Plus, we’ve made sure that our Mobile Banking Guarantee provides you with 100% coverage.**
Data service charges may apply through your wireless carrier.

You can be assured that the transactions performed using Independent Bank Mobile Banking will be secure and completed correctly, provided that you adhere to the terms and conditions of the End User License Agreement. In the unlikely event that someone establishes unauthorized access to your accounts through Independent Bank Mobile Banking, you are 100% covered ($0 liability) for any funds removed from those accounts (including loss of interest, insufficient funds and overdraft charges). Simply contact us within 60 days of receiving your statement containing the unauthorized activity.

bluejetty:00042259:ios.name: Block Spam Texts | Dont Text
bluejetty:00042259:ios.summary:
Block. Spam. Texts.
Dont Text creates a junk folder in your messages app and sends spam texts to the junk folder for you. With Dont Text installed and enabled on your device, you never get notifications from annoying spam texts and spam is
bluejetty:00042259:ios.description:
Block. Spam. Texts.
Dont Text creates a junk folder in your messages app and sends spam texts to the junk folder for you. With Dont Text installed and enabled on your device, you never get notifications from annoying spam texts and spam is automatically sent to your junk folder. Dont Text makes it easy for you to block spam texts on your device by getting started it in minutes.
Block Spam Texts from Email Addresses
Start blocking all spam text messages that come from email addresses. Turn on the toggle to Filter Email Senders in the app and Dont Text will block all incoming spam texts from email addresses.
Customize Filtering
Dont Text allows you to customize how you block spam texts. Inside the app, you can create keywords to filter text messages from unknown senders. Create a blocking keyword to filter any text containing that keyword and send the text to junk. Use allow keywords to prevent important texts from accidentally ending up in junk and make sure you never miss an important text.
Block Texts By Phone Number Area Code
Block unwanted texts by filtering by area code. Add an area code to the app and all texts from that area code will be sent to your junk folder.
Privacy
Dont Text does not save your contacts or texts. Dont Text only checks text messages from unknown senders to filter spam. Dont Text cannot access text messages between you and your contacts, or any texts that you send. Dont Text can only check incoming messages from a number not saved in your contacts and this information is never stored. When a text is filtered, Apple restricts the information Dont Text uses to block spam and your phone number or personal information is never shared with us.

View and manage all your crypto, tokens, NFTs, and RWA holdings in one unified portfolio. Track real-time balances across 130+ blockchains including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Base, Arbitrum, and more — all from a single, intuitive dashboard. Whether you hold 1 token or 1,000, OKX Wallet keeps your entire portfolio organized and accessible.

No seed phrase? No problem. OKX Wallet supports sign-in with your Google account, Apple ID, or email address — making it easier than ever to create and access your Web3 wallet. Perfect for newcomers and crypto veterans alike, social login removes the complexity of traditional wallet setup while maintaining full self-custody security. Your keys, your crypto — with a familiar login experience.
◆ DISCOVER TRENDING ON-CHAIN ASSETS
Stay ahead of the market with OKX Wallet's Explore page. Track real-time trending narratives, browse full asset rankings, and discover the hottest meme coins, RWA tokens, and emerging projects — all in one place. From market trends to breakout signals, never miss what's moving on-chain.
◆ RWA: REAL-WORLD ASSETS, ON-CHAIN
Access the future of finance with tokenized Real-World Assets (RWA) directly in your wallet. Trade and hold tokenized US stocks, precious metals like gold, and commodities — all on-chain with full transparency and 24/7 availability. OKX Wallet bridges traditional finance and DeFi, letting you diversify your portfolio beyond crypto into real-world value. No brokerage account needed — buy, sell, and manage tokenized stocks, gold, and commodities as easily as swapping any other token.
◆ FAST & SECURE ON-CHAIN SWAPS
Auto-confirm: Enjoy one-click, lightning-fast trades on OKX DEX. Fully rolled out on the web, with trend line visibility for smarter entries.
1inch Swap API integration: Execute swaps with MEV protection, powered by the industry's best APIs.
Limit order & TP/SL upgrade: Trade with advanced strategies and greater performance. Pending orders are now automatically revoked, and the new UI simplifies complex trading.
◆ SMART TRADING: TOOLS TO ENHANCE YOUR PERFORMANCE
Smart Accounts: Launch automated trading strategies, set up low-buy triggers, and execute timed orders, and many other advanced trading. Manage your portfolio with next-generation programmable accounts.
Smart money signals: Get real-time whale buy alerts and follow-buy signals. Our enhanced algorithm and upgraded database provide precise insights to enhance your trading decisions.
Meme Pump: Revamped chain scanner with second-level alerts, AI token summaries, and signals to spot trending meme coins before they go viral.
On-chain analytics: Use our new Vibes Social Media Analysis Tool and Address Radar to track token trends, sentiments, and cross-holdings of top traders.
◆ OKX BOOST: X LAUNCH, AIRDROPS & EXCLUSIVE REWARDS
Get early access to new tokens through X Launch — OKX Wallet's exclusive token launch platform. Participate in X Staking campaigns, trading competitions, and airdrop giveaways. Earn multiplied rewards based on your trading volume and wallet balance. Stay ahead with priority access to the hottest new projects and community-driven events.

 affordable rentals tailored for both short-term and long-term needs. Our platform offers competitive

 with maintenance, storage, and other ownership responsibilities when you can access one at your 
 convenience for a fraction of the price? Our user-friendly interface makes it easy to find the perfect

bluejetty:00026826:ios.description:
豆瓣，一个有趣多元的文化生活社区。在这里，从书影音出发，认知世界、体悟生活、充实心灵，塑造成更丰富的自我。在这里，世界更开阔，自我也被妥帖安放，自在生长。
丰富庞大的书影音资料库，能让你快速找到喜欢的电影、剧集、图书和音乐。你可以浏览评分、评论，查看真实可信的观众和读者反馈，获得有效的参考；也可以通过豆瓣榜单、片单、书单进行探索和延伸，刻画更系统的兴趣脉络。同时，你的标记和评论将成为珍贵的文化足迹，收纳在你的精神生活档案。无论普世审美还是小众偏好，都能在豆瓣遇见同类、收获共鸣。
小组拥有难以置信的活力，帮助你与兴趣相投的人找到彼此，汇聚“遥远的相似性”。在这里，你将不断发现有趣的最新小组和时下热组，从当下、真实的生活日常，到多元、硬核的文化爱好，你将遇见与你一样特别的人。通过交流和讨论，一起抱团取暖传递关怀和善意，一起探索思考并拥抱新鲜事物，一起感受陪伴、互助、同行的力量。
“我”是专属于你的空间。和生活在豆瓣的其他人一样，介绍自己时，你可以放大“关于我”的一切细枝末节，而不用担心陌生人没有耐心了解。暂时不谈相貌、年龄、职业，豆友们在豆瓣谈论的是自己喜欢的作家导演、坚持做的小事、最近的小发现、对社会事件的观点……你甚至可以通过成立一个小组或发起一个话题，将自己的独特放大到豆瓣的公共空间，影响和塑造彼此在豆瓣的生活。
“市集”将供你选购更多实体商品。豆瓣自营电商品牌“豆瓣豆品”，主打豆瓣生活美学物品，让热爱生活、追求人文内涵的你尽享高品质购物乐趣。豆瓣内容付费产品“豆瓣时间”为你甄选在线课程，伴你收获知识与成长。另外，你还可以逛“豆瓣书店”选购精品纸书，于活字森林里采撷书香。

微信：公众账号搜索“豆瓣” 
微博：@豆瓣

bluejetty:00134914:ios.description:
Read less. Understand more.
Visualmed turns landmark and newly published clinical trials into clear, high-yield visual abstracts designed for busy healthcare professionals and medical students.
Instead of spending hours working through dense research papers, quickly understand the studies that are shaping modern medicine.
WHY VISUALMED?
• 2,000+ clinical trials across major medical specialties
• Clear visual abstracts that make complex research easier to understand
• Quickly review study design, patient population, interventions, outcomes, and key findings
• Search by trial, disease, treatment, or specialty
• Discover landmark studies that changed clinical practice
• Stay current with newly published research
• Designed for physicians, residents, fellows, medical students, and other healthcare professionals
CLINICAL TRIALS — VISUALIZED
Visualmed transforms important medical research into concise visual summaries that help you understand the evidence quickly.
Whether you're preparing for rounds, reviewing evidence before clinic, studying for an exam, teaching trainees, or simply trying to stay current, Visualmed puts key clinical research at your fingertips.
EXPLORE MEDICINE ACROSS SPECIALTIES
Discover important studies across cardiology, internal medicine, oncology, neurology, endocrinology, nephrology, pulmonology, infectious disease, critical care, and more.
BUILT FOR BUSY CLINICIANS
Medical literature moves quickly. Visualmed helps you focus on the studies that matter and understand their key findings without having to read every paper from beginning to end.
VISUALMED PRO
Unlock full access to Visualmed's growing library of visual abstracts and newly added clinical trials with Visualmed Pro.
Download Visualmed and make keeping up with medical evidence part of your daily routine.
Visualmed is intended for educational and informational purposes only. It does not provide medical advice and is not a substitute for independent clinical judgment or review of the original research.

bluejetty:00137836:ios.description:
Kids360 is the first parental control app that kids enjoy. Help your child build healthy phone habits through smart screen time management, educational tasks, and positive routines - not just restrictions. Set phone limits, manage apps, create schedules, and give your child more independence while staying involved.
Kids360 helps parents create a balanced digital environment where children learn to use their phones responsibly. By completing educational tasks and physical activities, children can earn extra screen time and understand the value of managing their own device usage.
Create healthy screen time habits
Set daily phone time limits and help your child develop better digital routines. Create schedules for school, homework, bedtime, or family time and decide when entertainment apps should be available.
Manage apps and games
Control which apps your child can use and limit distracting activities when needed. Block games, social media, or other apps that take too much time, while keeping access to important tools and learning apps.
Support your child's first smartphone
Kids360 is designed for families introducing a first phone or helping children become more independent with technology. Set clear boundaries while giving your child the opportunity to build responsible habits.
Turn screen time into motivation
Unlike traditional parental controls that only block and restrict, Kids360 helps make digital rules more positive. Children can complete educational tasks, solve logical exercises, practice math, and complete physical activities to earn additional phone time.
Help children stay active
Kids360 can automatically count physical exercises using the phone camera. Your child can complete activities such as jumps or squats and receive extra screen time based on completed exercises.
Keep your child safer online
Help protect your child from unsuitable websites and encourage safer internet use. Manage web access and create a more appropriate online environment for your child's age.
Know where your child is
Stay connected with real-time GPS location. View your child's location on a map and feel more confident knowing where they are.
Stay connected when needed
Send a loud signal to your child's phone when you need to get their attention.
How Kids360 works:
Install Kids360 on your phone.
Install the Alli360 companion app on your child's smartphone.
Connect both devices and set up parental control features.
Kids360 is designed to be visible to children and used with their knowledge. Personal data is stored securely in accordance with applicable laws and GDPR requirements.

support@kids360.app

bluejetty:00146986:ios.summary:
SMART THINGS COME IN SMALL PACKAGES

bluejetty:00146986:ios.description:
SMART THINGS COME IN SMALL PACKAGES
Dario makes monitoring blood glucose easy thanks to the small size of its medical device. The Dario Blood Glucose Monitoring System combines the meter, lancet, and a pack of 25 test strips in a unit so small, it can fit in your pocket. This makes it easy to keep with you, whether at home or on the go. With Dario, checking your blood glucose is quick, easy, and discreet, one drop at a time. It’s an all-in-one diabetes tracker.
NOW SUPPORTING BLOOD PRESSURE
Dario is more than just a diabetes tracker for monitoring blood glucose. The app also pairs with the Dario Blood Pressure Monitoring System to record and store blood pressure measurements in the same logbook where you track blood glucose. This gives you a more complete perspective of your health. Track these two medical conditions together to learn more about your health for better conversations with your doctor, and to help you live better every day.
WHAT MAKES DARIO DIFFERENT?
Dario was designed with convenience in mind, to make it easier to see your medical trends and help build healthy new habits according to your results. With insights gained through the Dario app, you may learn which foods and activities lead to better results. You may see how following a treatment plan improves your blood pressure results. Getting this positive reinforcement in real-time can be a powerful motivator! One drop is all it takes to see where you stand with this innovative diabetes tracker.
KEEP YOUR DOCTOR & LOVED ONES IN THE LOOP
Keep your medical care providers and family members up to date on your diabetic measurements. You can share all the data and logbooks inside the Dario application with anyone you like. Simply tap the share icon and select a contact from your address book to share your data instantly.
COUNT CARBS & TRACK ACTIVITY
Any diabetic knows how challenging it can be to keep track of carbohydrate intake. Dario does the math for you. Simply tag which foods you ate, and Dario will automatically calculate how many carbs that gave you. With time, you may even start spotting patterns between the foods you’ve eaten and your blood glucose results and learn how to choose foods that your body responds to better. The same goes for activity. With Dario, you can keep track of your daily exercise (even washing the dishes!) and see if it influences your blood glucose levels. The results of this diabetes tracker may surprise you!
HOW ACCURATE IS DARIO?
Dario has been tested extensively to ensure it meets FDA guidance for accuracy, that 95% of measurements are within ±15% of a true lab-tested value. This means you can be assured that the Dario meter will provide results you can trust. Dario has also presented several studies to the ADA, demonstrating how its system can help improve life for people living with diabetes.
HYPO ALERT SYSTEM WITH GPS LOCATOR
Hypo alerts may save your life! If you have diabetes and have suffered from hypo events in the past, or have a child with diabetes, Dario's hypo alert system with GPS location can help bring you peace of mind. Simply connect the Dario meter to your smartphone, and upon recording a dangerously low glucose reading in one drop of blood, the Dario app will prepare a complete text message, including current blood glucose level and GPS location, to send to up to 4 emergency contacts. Because when a hypo strikes, time is of the essence. And you may not feel well enough to describe your situation. Dario is here to keep you safe.
The information provided is not intended to be used for medical diagnosis or treatment or as a substitute for professional medical advice. Please consult your physician or qualified health provider regarding your condition and appropriate medical treatment. Individual symptoms, situations, and circumstances may vary.
 Dario integrates with the Apple HeatlhKit, so your exercise, nutrition, and health data are recorded in one easy-to-access location.

Geovelo, your free GPS application, your statistics and your challenges!
As a B Corp, Geovelo is part of a global community of businesses that meet high social and environmental standards
- PERSONALIZED ITINERARIES & GPS
The app adapts to your type of bike (classic, electric, self-service (SSB), to your travel speed and to the type of route you prefer (from the fastest to the most secure). Geovelo prioritises cycle paths, cycle lanes and low-traffic streets to ensure your comfort, safety and peace of mind. Geovelo includes a real-time guidance system (map / full screen / compass mode), with voice guidance and notifications.
- STATISTICS & RECORDING
Log in and save your rides to access your personalized statistics.
When the Geovelo app is installed, you can start cycling around, and your routes will be automatically detected and saved. You can then view them in the app. Please note that you will need to authorise the retrieval of locations when the app is closed or in the background for this feature to work.
Geovelo allows you to synchronise your cycling activity information with the Apple Health app.
You can also use your Apple Watch to follow your itinerary or start a new trip.
- CYCLING FACILITIES AND BIKE PARKING
With its comprehensive mapping, Geovelo also allows you to quickly and easily find nearby bicycle parkings and bike racks.
- COMMUNITIES & CHALLENGES
Find other cyclists in your city or organisation, and connect by participating in regular activity challenges. Get on your bike every day or ride as many kilometres as you can to try and make it to the podium in your community! Note that several competitions are organised to win useful gifts for cyclists. 
- CYCLE ROUTES & WALKS
The app also offers cycling routes (including La Vélodyssée®, Via Rhôna, La Loire à Vélo®, La Scandibérique, La Flow Vélo, Le Canal des deux Mers à Vélo, La Vélo Francette®, La Véloscénie, L'Avenue Verte London-Paris and others) as well as numerous walks to discover the local heritages & treasures
- CONTRIBUTIONS & REPORTS
Report any missing bike-park, problems or roadworks, dangerous roads for cyclists and much more for the benefit of the community.
- PRACTICAL TOOLS

bluejetty:00081122:ios.description:
Create accurate estimates and invoices, track your payments, add images and descriptions to win the jobs.

Contractor Estimate & Invoice
- Create estimates and invoices with a professional look and feel.
- Allow your clients to pay you with credit cards (like VISA, MasterCard) and PayPal.
- Send your estimates and invoices by SMS, email or download the PDF.
- Manage your team and collect the payments of all your clients in your account.
- Take pictures and draw on them.
- Keep a markup on the total of your estimates and invoices that will not be visible to your clients.
- Set discounts and taxes per item.
Your Clients As A Priority
- Get the client's history easily.
- Use it as a CRM and keep comments on your clients.
- Build trust with your clients, show them you are the perfect contractor for the job.

- Keep your schedule efficient.
- Freelancers can create an invoice with a detailed timesheet just by selecting the month.
Track Your Expenses
- Take pictures of your invoices so you don't lose them.
Estimate With Real Store Products
- The contractor's best feature!
- Search through local store products to produce your estimates easily.
- Get an estimated price for Plywood, OSB, Foams, 2x3, 2x4, 2x6, 2x8, Paint, Sinks, Concrete Blocks, Ceramic and a lot more.

A Calculator For Contractors

Team

App & Web
- Access your data from anywhere: on your phone, tablet, or on the web from your computer (Mac or PC).

bluejetty:00124134:ios.description:

The app now has 10 free games, and more are on the way! More than ‘just a ball,’ the inflatable Gameball is embedded with patent-pending sensor technology that connects to the Play Impossible app via Bluetooth, bringing a new twist to a favorite play and sport object. 
Connect, compete and challenge your ball skill with the popular new game Impossible; see how long it takes to reach your vertical limit in Skyscraper; use brains and brawn in a new version of ‘keep away’ with Jostle. See how fast you can throw or how much spin you can get in Sport Labs. 
The Play Impossible Gameball is recommended for ages nine and higher. When your Gameball runs low on energy, refuel in 20 seconds with the Rapid Charger for another complete hour of fun! 
Play Impossible Gameball™ is sold separately from this application. 
Please be aware that because of the significant number of different models, variants, and manufacturing standards of available devices.

bluejetty:00119725:ios.summary:
UpHabit is an Personal CRM for Business solution for Professionals who build relationships to generate business.
UpHabit eliminates contact & activity leakage (10X your Constant Contact, Mailchimp & Salesforce contacts). It also surfaces a
bluejetty:00119725:ios.description:
UpHabit is an Personal CRM for Business solution for Professionals who build relationships to generate business.
UpHabit eliminates contact & activity leakage (10X your Constant Contact, Mailchimp & Salesforce contacts). It also surfaces all contacts anyone knows at every prospect and customer. UpHabit is deeply and seamlessly integrated with Salesforce and we're open to other integrations should our customers request them.
The UpHabit app ensures you never forget important dates. You can nurture great relationships and generate increased revenue and success. Reminders, notes, tags, social connections, we've got it all.
7 reasons to use UpHabit:
1. Salesforce: we're deeply integrated and ensure that organizations have all the data they require on their contacts and activities
2. Introductions: making introductions has never been easier — with custom introduction templates and duplication options, you can make all the introductions in the world within seconds.
3. Custom reminders: set regular or custom reminders, and you’ll never forget a birthday or a milestone.
4. Searchable notes: for personal or business relationships alike, it’s important to remember details. Adding notes to people’s profiles will help you stand out and be present for your friends, whether it is band practice or the development of a new business.
5. Organize by tags: want to read about business relations only? Add tags to your contacts and filter your feed in an instant.
6. All contacts in the same place: easily sync contacts from your Google and Microsoft accounts, your local calendar, as well as your phone's address book.
7. Snooze reminders: stay focused and productive during your busiest times and say no to reminders.
Your data is also protected with UpHabit. We will never share your personal information, and you can get a copy of your data at any time within the app. The only thing we do with your data is help you organize and act on it. Because you’re our only focus, and we’d all quit if that wasn’t the case.
Privacy Policy: https://uphabit.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://uphabit.com/terms-of-service/
Support: You can email us at support@uphabit.com

HUMANS. Aqllilar ilovasi.

bluejetty:00063771:ios.description:
My Movies & TV Shows: Watch List - The Best way to track your favorite movies and TV Shows. Simple and convenient application for explore movies, tv shows theirs details, ratings, trailers, cast and much more in one place. Add your favorite Movies and TV Shows to the watch lists and then track the release of new episodes in the calendar and on notifications. In the application there is sync with iCloud (it works automatically).
- Huge database movies, TV Shows and actors. And this all in one place.
- View full information about Films and TV Shows (Cast, ratings, runtime, recommendation, genres and more).
- Watch trailers.
- View photos of movies and TV shows.
- Discover Popular and Top Rated.
- Look for upcoming movies and now playing in theaters (cinema).
- Advanced Search for movies by genre, year of release, movie ratings, duration, actors.
- Get Notification when new episodes from your favorite TV Shows come out. Now you never miss it. Although you have Calendar in application with timetables all episodes all your favorite TV Shows.
- Save Movies and TV Shows to you watch list or mark it as watched. 
- Manage seen episodes Tv Shows.
- Sorting Movies and TV Shows in you lists.
- Add Notes to Movies and TV shows.
- Change the language information about movies in the application settings.
- Statistics on your account (time spent on watching movies / serials, the number of series viewed / not viewed, favorite genres etc.)
- Synchronization with iCloud (automatically after each change)
- No accounts required.
- Easy to use

bluejetty:00072854:ios.name: Built by Becky
bluejetty:00072854:ios.summary: Thank you so much for coming here to check out my new fitness app. I am so grateful to be given this opportunity to help you reach your goals when it comes to health and fitness. My passion for fitness started when I was 25 years old and du
bluejetty:00072854:ios.description:
Thank you so much for coming here to check out my new fitness app. I am so grateful to be given this opportunity to help you reach your goals when it comes to health and fitness. My passion for fitness started when I was 25 years old and during that time I let fitness control my life. I was scared to eat out in fear of weight gain, scared to go a day without tracking every single piece of food that went into my mouth, scared to take a rest day thinking I would lose all of my progress. Over the years I've learned that balance is key and fitness should compliment your life, not control it. Let me help you find that balance. - Becky
Becky has transformed her mind and body all from home using free weights and has achieved amazing results as well as confidence. Within the app you will find follow along full length workouts where she will struggle, sweat and sometimes swear with you. Whether you're looking for weight lifting, cardio, abs/core - Built by Becky has got it all! 
So many women have had life changing results from following these programs and Becky's method of slow and controlled movements will have you finally feeling that mind to muscle connection that makes all the difference in gaining muscle. Whether you're a complete beginner or an experienced lifter, Becky has crafted these programs to work for all fitness levels. 
NUTRITION
Becky will be continuously adding her meals/recipes to the nutrition section of the app. You will find meals that are high in protein, easy to prepare, and delicious. There is no fad diet or strict meal plan. Becky is a self described "lazy cook" but her meals are so simple and nutrient dense that it's almost genius. No complicated dishes, perfect for life on the go or someone who just doesn't like spending lots of time preparing their meals. Becky never restricts foods and always leaves room for a treat. If you're going to train like Becky you're going to get hungry and you will need to fuel your body with enough nutrient dense food to give you the energy to put in the work. Let her show you exactly how she does it - it might surprise you how easy it can be!
WORKOUT PROGRAMS
Whether you are a beginner or an advanced lifter, there is a program for you. Becky has designed each program to perfection with her favourite exercises to give you incredible results all from home using minimal equipment. All you need to do is dedicate 30-50 minutes of your day! Within the workouts, some exercises will have a 'swap' feature with a list of alternate exercises to choose from. Maybe you need an easier exercise or you don't have the listed equipment. We've got you covered. 
CHAT FORUM
The BBB Ladies Lounge grew to popularity on Facebook with the BBB 6 Week Challenges and we are happy to announce that we are putting the Ladies Lounge on the app so everyone can connect, help each other and just share their journey. Its so motivating to see and hear from other people who are on the same path as you. So many lifelong friendships have been made through the Ladies Lounge and we are so excited to see this continue on the app. 
Health and fitness is definitely a lifestyle. Becky has tried so many of the fad diets and been through so many of the mental barriers of the journey. She's finally found a sustainable way to maintain balance with exercise and diet that doesn't result in binge eating or burning out. You need to do this for YOU. Focus on feeling better and being healthier. Stay consistent and in time the results will show. You are so important and you deserve to feel your best. 
Please note that Becky is not a certified personal trainer and the contents of this app are based off of her years of experience through trial and error.
Terms of Use: https://www.builtbybecky.com/terms/

bluejetty:00173124:ios.description:
There is too much free space in the city, wouldn't it be better to build some towers? Become a skyscraper builder, build as many houses as you can! Hire your own team and become the richest tycoon. Don’t forget to enjoy relaxing and fun gameplay! Are you ready?
Start your own construction business
Open your own business and start building a house on your own. Stack bricks and blocks, step by step, every journey starts small. When you make your first money, hire workers and things will go faster. Build the house floor by floor and eventually get a huge skyscraper, and you have become a real tycoon! Sounds complicated? But it's not, the gameplay is as simple and fun, the main thing to start!
Hire new employees
It takes a lot of time and resources to build the skyscraper of your dreams, but things will go much faster with a good team. Hire new employees and improve their skills to speed up the construction process. Good employees are the key to success in any business, so don't be stingy and hire the best ones to make a lot of money and become a tycoon!
Build up the whole city
Once you build your first skyscraper, the game doesn't end. Open up new areas and start building new towers! More buildings mean more money, so hurry up. Manage construction at different sites, hire more workers and automate the process. Build up the whole city and become the richest tycoon!
Game Features:
Collect & stack bricks
Build the house of your dream
Upgrade your skill, become faster and stronger
Hire new employees and workers, improve their skills
Get the cash flowing and become the rich city tycoon
Don’t stop collecting and building! Build the highest towers and skyscrapers!
Enjoy easy controls and idle gameplay. Become a tower master now!
Get ready to open your own business and become the richest builder in town! Stack blocks and bricks, build skyscrapers and towers, and hire your dream team. Manage construction sites, enjoy addictive gameplay and become the richest tycoon. Download and play now!

What is a guitar?

bluejetty:00017038:ios.description:
The Real Guitar provides all the tools necessary to master the art of playing guitar on your smartphone or tablet. Now you can easily play any music, anywhere! Feel the sensation of playing guitar in a real band!
What is a guitar?
A guitar is a musical instrument played by plucking or strumming its strings. Guitars come in various types, including acoustic and electric guitars.
Why, haven't you learned to play the guitar yet?
Real Guitar offers multiple video lessons to support you, along with a variety of loops for interactive play-along experiences.
Don't have access to an acoustic or electric guitar? No problem! 
Real Guitar provides a diverse range of instruments with high-quality sounds, enabling you to play any song you desire!
You don't need a physical guitar to learn to play!
Real Guitar is an ideal choice for practicing or playing the guitar quietly, without causing disturbance or requiring extensive space. Enjoy the freedom to practice guitar anywhere you like!
Show your friends how good you are at playing guitar!
Share videos of your performances with friends and on social media!
The Real Guitar app allows both children and adults to learn the guitar while having fun and enhancing their cognitive and motor skills. This guitar game will stimulate your musical talent, making it easy to learn as if using a real guitar instrument.
So, what are you waiting for to become a guitarist?
Explore the features of Real Guitar:
- 100 guitar lessons: Learn to play guitar with our lessons.
- Full 22-Fret Scale: Explore the entire fretboard.
- Solo and Chord Mode: Switch between playing solos and strumming chords effortlessly.
- Adjustable Scale Size: Customize the fretboard to your preference.
- Guitar Chords Library: Access over 1500 chords.
- Studio Audio Quality: Enjoy crystal-clear sound.
- A Diverse Range of Instruments: Explore lifelike instrument options.
- New Instruments Weekly: Keep your sound fresh.
- Recording Mode: Record your tunes and share them on social media.
- Interactive Loops: Play along with professionally crafted loops.
- MIDI Support: Connect your MIDI devices for enhanced control.
- Universal Compatibility: Works seamlessly on all screen resolutions, from smartphones to tablets (HD images).
- Free App: No hidden costs.
- Delay-Free Audio: Enjoy seamless sound.
The app contains the following subscription:
- Premium Version (Remove ads; Unlock all loops; Unlock all lessons and Unlock Metronome)
- Monthly payment ($3,90).
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.

- The subsequent monthly subscriptions are automatically renewed unless cancelled 24 hours before the next renewal (considering the day of the effective monthly subscription).
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

Made for guitarists, professional musicians, amateurs, and beginners alike!
From the same creator of Real Drum.
Don't wait any longer to become a guitarist. Download Real Guitar now!

Vivid offers incredible movie-grade AI technology which can automatically enhance photo quality into high-definitionin for you even when zoomed in, with editing features including photo enhancer, magic eraser, color correction, cartoon selfie, portrait animer, black and white photo colorizer, background blur, etc. Download and enjoy the convenience of cutting-edge AI technology for everyday life!

Remove anything unwanted. Passersby, trash cans, wires, clutter, obstructions, all the things you don't like can be removed with a simple touch. Magic Cut & Fill with stunning results as if things never existed before.

Achieving fantastic color correction, balance the colors in the image. Get proper photo exposure including highlights and shadows and a varying degree of contrast in between. bluejetty:00093124:ios.description:
A SOUZA & REIS é uma empresa que ultrapassou sua primeira década de instituição e de serviços prestados no ramo de administração de condomínios.
Nossa missão é prestar aos nossos clientes um serviço de qualidade com excelência e ética, oferecendo um atendimento diferenciado, com profissionais altamente qualificados e contando com toda a tecnologia disponível neste mercado.
Tanto pelo site da Souza & Reis quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real.
Com a Souza & Reis, a vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente. Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade,
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para souzareis@winker.com.br

bluejetty:00152641:ios.name: Romantic Mahjong Slide
bluejetty:00152641:ios.summary: Experience the charm of Romantic Mahjong Slide, a beautifully crafted puzzle game that combines the timeless elegance of mahjong with a fresh sliding and merging twist. Designed for casual and puzzle lovers alike, this game offers hours of
bluejetty:00152641:ios.description:
Experience the charm of Romantic Mahjong Slide, a beautifully crafted puzzle game that combines the timeless elegance of mahjong with a fresh sliding and merging twist. Designed for casual and puzzle lovers alike, this game offers hours of relaxing yet engaging gameplay right at your fingertips.
A New Take on Mahjong
Forget the traditional static boards – here, you’ll slide tiles across the board to merge matching ones, clearing space and unlocking new possibilities. The innovative sliding mechanic adds a dynamic layer of strategy, making each move matter.
Romantic Visuals & Atmosphere
Step into a world filled with soft colors, elegant tile designs, and soothing music. Each completed level reveals charming romantic scenes, making your journey both relaxing and heartwarming.
How to Play
- Slide tiles in any direction to move them.
- Match & Merge identical tiles to clear them from the board.
- Plan Ahead to create combos and unlock higher scores.
- Complete Levels to unlock new chapters and romantic illustrations.
Game Features
- A brand-new sliding mahjong merge gameplay style.
- Hundreds of hand-crafted levels with varying challenges.
- Relaxing visuals and background music for stress-free play.
- Easy to pick up, yet offers depth for puzzle enthusiasts.
- Play at your own pace – no rush, no time limit.
- Offline play supported – enjoy anywhere, anytime.
Whether you’re here for the romance, the puzzles, or just a peaceful escape, Romantic Mahjong Slide delivers a delightful blend of love and logic. Perfect for winding down after a busy day or enjoying a quiet moment.
Download now and start sliding, merging, and falling in love with mahjong all over again!
Privacy Policy: https://www.charm-scape-jigsaw.com/privacy-policy.html
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00186227:ios.summary:
“It’s really great!”
—Kenneth Branagh, actor and director
“I can't remember a time it wasn't on my iPhone. So feature rich!"
—Stephen Fry, actor and writer
“‘The app’s the thing.’ Hamlet was almost right. Great to see Shakespeare Pro supe
bluejetty:00186227:ios.description:
“It’s really great!”
—Kenneth Branagh, actor and director
“I can't remember a time it wasn't on my iPhone. So feature rich!"
—Stephen Fry, actor and writer
“‘The app’s the thing.’ Hamlet was almost right. Great to see Shakespeare Pro superplaying with Shakespeare’s plays.”
—David Crystal, linguist and author of Shakespeare's Words
“The Shakespeare Pro app is simply terrific and filled with loads of wonderful information!”
—Ken Ludwig, Tony and Olivier Award Winning Playwright
Shakespeare Pro® includes the complete works of Shakespeare (41 plays, 154 sonnets and 6 poems, including apocrypha) and search the concordance to find the exact word or phrase you’re looking for (with “relaxed” searching to find words close to your search term).
Shakespeare Pro is packed with these impressive features:
••• QUALITY TEXTS are a top priority and our team spent years compiling and editing the best references available. In the updated editions, the text is even more clear and each individual character is uniquely identified.
••• FIRST FOLIOS AND QUARTOS in original spelling show the works as they were originally published in Shakespeare’s time.
••• AN INTEGRATED GLOSSARY, based on the bestselling lexicon by David & Ben Crystal, Shakespeare’s Words™ is included. Simply tapping on a word will display its definition in context (not just a general definition). 
••• ADD YOUR OWN NOTES AND SHARE THEM with your students, classmates, friends, and colleagues. Organize your notes into notebooks for use in the classroom, theatre, or just to remember key facts. Then share them via email or AirDrop.
••• POWER SEARCH THE WORKS by customizing multiple parameters like gender, genre, work, language, line form, soliloquies, and more.
••• CUSTOMIZE YOUR READING EXPERIENCE by choosing from a variety of color themes, change the font family and size, display long or short character names, jump around to different scenes, and view line numbers (*read the note below about line numbering).
••• BOOKMARK YOUR FAVORITE PARTS in addition to remembering the last page you viewed. Even copy/paste that great line.
••• DETAILED SCENE BREAKDOWNS give you an overview of the scenes within each play, their locations, and the characters present in each.
••• CHARACTER DESCRIPTIONS help you better understand the actions and motivations of every character—all 1,155 of them.
••• MODERN TRANSLATIONS and lexicons to help you better understand Elizabethan English (extra add-ons).
••• GET THE FACTS by reading up on Shakespeare’s life, view data and chronology about his works, and an overview of scansion terminology or rhetoric. Character Arc Visualizers show individual character arcs or allow for comparison of multiple characters.
••• SHAKE YOUR DEVICE for Shakespeare himself to display a random memorable quote or insult. Or get a new random quote every day.
••• BROWSE THE GALLERY of famous Shakespeare portraits.
••• TEACHER CURRICULUM makes it easy for teachers to introduce students to Shakespeare's works. 
••• COMPLETE APOCRYPHA is the most comprehensive breakdown of 14 plays Shakespeare may have had a hand in. 
••• BARDFIND™ is the easiest way to find a Shakespeare theatre or venue anywhere in the world.
These are just a few highlights of the great things in Shakespeare Pro. If you’re a student, professor, actor, or just plain love the Bard, this must-have app ensures you have the complete works at your fingertips.
Like the new features? Having trouble and need support? Let us know at support@playshakespeare.com or at http://support.playshakespeare.com.

bluejetty:00064426:ios.name: XKchrome LED Light
bluejetty:00064426:ios.summary: XKchrome is an innovative app-enabled light system that completely changes the look of your night rides. It casts dynamic light that highlights the beauty of your vehicle with any color you picked. You can sync its light with your camera a
bluejetty:00064426:ios.description:
XKchrome is an innovative app-enabled light system that completely changes the look of your night rides. It casts dynamic light that highlights the beauty of your vehicle with any color you picked. You can sync its light with your camera and music, or choose from 15 hand-picked, fully-customizable animation themes.
XKchrome can also remember your parking spot, and help you find the way back to your vehicle. In addition, the whole system can be turned into a bright red light when you brake, significantly increase the night driving safety.
FUN:
- 16 million vivid colors at your finger tip.
- Sync light with the music in your phone or the microphone. 
- Sync light with your vehicle's speed or acceleration. 
- Capture a color with camera and paint your vehicle with it.
- Choose from 15 holiday themes with full customization.
- Control multiple zones simultaneously, and group/ungroup zones at your will. 
CONVENIENCE:
- Remember where you parked your vehicle.
SAFETY:
- Turn the entire lighting kit into RED color when you brake.
REQUIREMENTS:
XKchrome controller or light system is required for using this app.
DEVICE COMPATIBILITY:
- iPhone: iPhone 6, iPhone 6 Plus, iPhone 7, iPhone 7 Plus, iPhone 8, iPhone 8 Plus, iPhone X, iPhone XS, iPhone XR
- iPad†: iPad (3rd gen), iPad (4th gen), iPad Air, iPad Air 2, iPad mini, iPad mini 2, iPad mini 3, iPad Pro
- iPod touch†: iPod touch 5th gen
DISCLAIMER:
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. To provide best user experience, "find my vehicle" feature only activates the GPS in the background for about 10 seconds when the phone is disconnected from the controller. The power consumption is similar to opening the Maps App briefly to find your current location. You can also turn off this feature at any time.

bluejetty:00146406:ios.description:
calorie.ai - making calories simple.
Welcome to calorie.ai, your new companion in achieving a balanced and healthy lifestyle. Focused on simplicity and driven by advanced AI features, our app is here to make your weight loss/gain journey straightforward and enjoyable.
Why choose calorie.ai?
Achieving your fitness goals shouldn't be a burden. At calorie.ai, we're committed to making it easy for you to take control of your health and fitness. Whether your aim is to shed a few pounds, build muscle, or simply embrace a healthier lifestyle, we're here to facilitate each step.
Key Features:
- Effortless Calorie and Macro Tracking: Say goodbye to cumbersome tracking processes. With calorie.ai, monitor your calorie and macro intake effortlessly.
- Customizable Goals: Set and modify your calorie and macro goals according to your personal preferences and fitness objectives.
- Extensive Food Database: Access over 1.5 million verified food items, ensuring accurate and comprehensive tracking.
- AI-Powered Food Search Engine: Find and log your meals seamlessly with our advanced AI-powered food search engine.
- Free Barcode Scanning: Quickly add food items to your diary with our hassle-free barcode scanning feature.
- Quick Add & Manual Entries: For those unique or homemade items, our app allows quick add and manual entry features for accurate tracking.
- Saved Foods + Meals: Save your favorite foods and create re-usable meals to more conveniently track your calories.
- Exercise Tracking: Had an intense workout? Track them in our app in order to adjust your calorie goals for the day.
- Weight Tracking: Monitor your weight on a weekly, monthly, and yearly timeline to see your progress and make adjustments as you go.
The calorie.ai application is more than just a calorie tracker. It's your personal health and fitness assistant, equipped with AI-driven features to streamline your calorie tracking and nutritional monitoring process. Whether you are venturing on a weight loss journey, aiming to gain muscle, or keen on maintaining a robust and healthy lifestyle, calorie.ai is crafted to support you at every juncture.
Our platform is user-friendly and efficient, enabling you to keep a close eye on your daily calorie intake and nutritional macros with ease. Tailored to meet individual needs, calorie.ai empowers you with customizable goals and a rich database, fostering a simplified yet effective approach to health and nutrition management.
Start using calorie.ai today, and embark on a journey towards a happier, healthier, and more balanced life.

bluejetty:00091134:ios.summary:
If you ever wished spiders were a little less itsy-bitsy and a little more mutanty-radioactivy, this is a game for you!
Merge the most exotic spider species you’ll ever come across to create new bug breeds with unpredictably awesome featur
bluejetty:00091134:ios.description:
If you ever wished spiders were a little less itsy-bitsy and a little more mutanty-radioactivy, this is a game for you!
Merge the most exotic spider species you’ll ever come across to create new bug breeds with unpredictably awesome features!
You might even be responsible for the origin story of your next friendly neighborhood masked superhero!
SPIDER FEATURES
- Pantheon: a new place for supreme beings to look down on us mortals and laugh at our misery
- Impostors: watch out for impostors trying to steal the spotlight from the spiders.
HOW TO PLAY
- Drag and drop similar spiders to create new mutant creatures
- Use spider eggs to earn coins, buy new creatures and make even more money
- Alternatively, fiercely tap a spider to make coins pop from their eggs
HIGHLIGHTS
- Different stages and many spider species to discover
- A mind-blowing story with venomous twists!
- The unexpected mix of creature evolution dynamics and incremental clicker games
- Doodle-like illustrations
- Open-ended gameplay: enjoy the freedom!
 - No spiders were harmed in the making of this game, only developers
Spider Evolution: the new web sensation.
Please note! This game is free to play, but it contains items that can be purchased for real money. Some features and extras mentioned in the description may also have to be purchased for real money.

bluejetty:00064860:ios.description:
Die einfachste Börsen- und Aktien-App Deutschlands!
Finden Sie Realtimekurse zu Aktien, Indizes (Dax, TecDax, etc.), ETFs, Währungen und Rohstoffen. Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden mit tagesaktuellen Top-News zu Aktien, Börsen sowie zur Wirtschaft und den Märkten. 
Mit F100 Trends immer den neuesten Entwicklungen auf der Spur. In Trends finden Sie Cards zu Top-Titeln verschiedener Themen - vollautomatisiert und immer aktuell zu Performance, Vorhersagen durch Künstliche Intelligenz und Medienstimmung! 
Speichern Sie interessante Aktien, Zertifikate, Fonds, ETFs, Optionen schnell und einfach in der Watchlist oder im Portfolio ab.
Erhalten Sie Push-Benachrichtigungen bei Limits oder wichtigen Börsen- und Wirtschafts-News.
Die wichtigsten App-Features im Überblick:
• Echtzeitkurse der wichtigsten Aktien, Indizes, ETFs, Währungen und Rohstoffe
• Blickt auf die wichtigsten Börsen und Märkte
• Umfangreiche Chart-Analyse
• Leicht bedienbare und komfortable Portfolios und Watchlisten
• Limit-Alerts und Börsen- sowie Aktien-Eilmeldungen per Push-Notification
• Synchronisierung der Musterdepots zwischen Web und App
• Schnelle Suche für alle Wertpapiere und Nachrichten
• Börsen-News und Finanznachrichten aus über 12.500 Quellen
• Exklusive Anlagestrategien von Experten
• Aktien, Fonds, Anleihen, ETF
• Indizes (Dax, TecDax, Dow Jones, etc.)
• Rohstoffe, Währungskurse und Devisen
Finanzen100 ist exklusiver Börsen-Partner von FOCUS Online.
Unsere In-App-Käufe:
• Finanzen100 Werbefreiheit
Finanzen100 ohne Werbung gibt es als einfache In-App-Käufe für einen Monat oder für ein Jahr.
• Bernecker Börsenkompass
Der Bernecker Börsenkompass ist der exklusive, mobile Börsendienst aus dem Hause Bernecker: Marktkommentare, fundierte Analysen und geldwerte Empfehlungen kommen direkt auf Ihr Smartphone. Börsen-Expertise, die sich sofort für Sie auszahlt.
Abonnements werden über die Kreditkarte in Ihrem iTunes-Account belastet. Ihr Abonnement wird automatisch verlängert, es sei denn, Sie kündigen es mindestens 24 Stunden vor dem Ende des aktuellen Abonnementzeitraums. Sie können Ihr Abonnement nach dem Kauf in den Accounteinstellungen verwalten.
Unsere Nutzungsbedingungen: http://www.finanzen100.de/nutzungsbedingungen.html
Unsere Datenschutzbestimmungen: http://www.finanzen100.de/datenschutz.html
Für in App Käufe und Downloads gelten unsere AGB: https://www.finanzen100.de/agb.html
Wir entwickeln unsere App ständig für Sie weiter und freuen uns über Ihre Fragen, Kritik und Anregungen.
SUPPORT
So erreichen Sie uns:
• per E-Mail, unter kundenservice@finanzen100.de (sehr bequem geht das über die Feedback-Funktion in der App, hinter dem Info-Symbol auf der Übersicht)
• über die Finanzen100-Wissensdatenbank, mit vielen Hilfe-Artikeln rund um die Finanzen100-Produkte: https://finanzen100-faq.groovehq.com/help
