bluejetty:00182917:ios.description:
FANTAMASTER È L’UNICA APP ALL-IN-ONE PER IL FANTACALCIO
Come tanti altri fantallenatori sei anche tu alla ricerca di un’app alternativa per le tue leghe di fantacalcio per avere la certezza di avere voti sensati?
La tua soluzione è FantaMaster!
FantaMaster è un progetto indipendente che ti garantisce equità e imparzialità nelle valutazioni che esprime sui giocatori.
FantaMaster è l'alternativa vera che risolve tutti i problemi che hai avuto in passato su altre piattaforme.
Leggi di seguito come te li risolve:
4 FONTI VOTI DIVERSE:
- Voto Statistico Live FantaMaster, calcolato sui dati reali di gara (Opta), senza interpretazioni soggettive
- Voti Fantacampionato – La Gazzetta dello Sport, i voti ufficiali del quotidiano sportivo più prestigioso
- Voti Redazionali
- Voti Community: sono gli utenti stessi a votare dopo ogni partita, non un voto calato dall'alto
Puoi usarle singolarmente o selezionarne più di una in contemporanea: otterrai la media arrotondata per eccesso.
NOVITÀ 2026/2027 - 3 LISTONI DIVERSI:
- Listone FantaMaster
- Listone Fantacampionato - La Gazzetta dello Sport
- Listone Classico
8 MODALITÀ DI MERCATO IN UNA SOLA APP:
Asta Ebay con autobid, Asta in Presenza, Asta Live da remoto, Busta Chiusa, Listone libero, Mercato Manuale dell’admin, svincoli e scambi.
L’Asta LIVE ha il timer regolabile, la modalità a chiamata, chat tra i partecipanti ed è integrata con la tua strategia personale per l’asta!
Basta usare dieci app diverse per fare un'asta decente… ti basta solo quella di FantaMaster! (ma se vuoi puoi usare anche la versione desktop)
NUMEROSI FORMATI DI COMPETIZIONE (attivabili insieme):
Campionato a scontri diretti, Coppa Play Off, Coppa a Gironi, Apertura/Clausura, Formula 1, Sopravvivenza e la nuova SuperSfida, dove ogni giornata sfidi tutti contemporaneamente e azzeri il fattore fortuna del calendario.
BONUS E MALUS PERSONALIZZABILI:
Modificatori (difesa, capitano, ecc.), Bonus Rigore Procurato, Malus Rigore Provocato, MVP automatico da dati Opta. Fasce gol, soglie e bonus/malus personalizzabili per ruolo.
Costruisci il regolamento della tua lega come vuoi tu!
NOVITÀ DI QUEST’ANNO: I FANTAMASTER TOOLS INTEGRATI NELL’APP:
- ASTA PERFETTA: domina la tua lega grazie alla potenza dei dati
- FORMAZIONE PERFETTA: l'AI che conosce la tua rosa e le regole della lega e ti consiglia modulo e formazione migliori ogni giornata
GESTIONE TRASPARENTE DELLA LEGA:
Registro Attività Admin consultabile da tutti i partecipanti. Se hai mai sospettato che l'admin modifichi voti o formazioni senza dirlo, ora controlli tutto in autonomia.
RUOLI PERSONALIZZABILI, VOTI/RISULTATI/CLASSIFICHE LIVE, NOTIFICHE PUSH in tempo reale su gol, assist e tutti i bonus/malus della tua squadra e di quella dell'avversario.
ANCHE DA PC:
Gestisci mercato, formazioni e classifiche da qualunque browser con Leghe FantaMaster, comodissimo durante l'asta.
PASSI SENZA PERDERE NIENTE:
Albo d'Oro personalizzabile, import rose via CSV con mappatura automatica, supporto attivo 7 giorni su 7 via Email, Facebook e Instagram.
Probabili Formazioni in tempo reale, Risultati Live di tutte le partite, statistiche dettagliate, news su calciomercato e consigli: tutto in un'unica app.
Passare a FantaMaster significa riprendere in mano le redini del gioco. Non subire un sistema, ma ribellarsi.
Già più di 2,5 MILIONI di Fantallenatori hanno scelto FantaMaster e non sono più tornati indietro!
Tu cosa aspetti?
*** Abbonamenti ***
La sottoscrizione "Premium", al costo di 2.99€/mese o 9.99€/anno, prevede la rimozione della pubblicita' e l'attivazione di tutte le funzionalita' premium.
Il rinnovo automatico può essere disattivato in qualsiasi momento almeno 24 ore prima della scadenza.
Il rinnovo ha un costo di 2.99€ o 9.99€ e l'addebito e' eseguito 24 ore prima della scadenza.

MDCalc is the leading clinical decision support app providing 900+ evidence-based calculators, risk scores, and clinical tools to support patient care at the bedside. MDCalc has been trusted by millions of clinicians since 2005.
Why Clinic
bluejetty:00131533:ios.description:
MDCalc is the leading clinical decision support app providing 900+ evidence-based calculators, risk scores, and clinical tools to support patient care at the bedside. MDCalc has been trusted by millions of clinicians since 2005.
Why Clinicians Choose MDCalc:
• Created by Physicians, for Physicians - All tools developed and validated by board-certified physicians 
• 900+ Clinical Tools - Risk scores, algorithms, dosing calculators, and more with consistent updates and new tools added regularly 
• Works Offline - Full functionality without internet connection 
• Evidence-Based - Every tool includes research validation and expert commentary 
• CME Tracking - Earn CME just by reading through the clinical content surrounding many of our tools
• Free Registration - Complete access in under 30 seconds 
Key Features:
Smart Search & Organization
• Quick search across all tools
• Customizable favorites and specialty lists
• Recently used tools for quick access
• Auto-sync between web and mobile
• Explore page for personalized suggestions
Clinical Expertise
• Expert insights from creators
• Pearls & pitfalls from specialists
• Evidence summaries with PubMed links
• Error warnings and normal value ranges
Workflow Support
• Toggle between US and SI units instantly
• Works in limited connectivity settings
• Easy to use at the point-of-care
Popular Tools Include:
• Creatinine Clearance - Cockcroft-Gault Equation
• HA2DS2-VASc Score - Atrial Fibrillation Stroke Risk
• HEART Score- Major Cardiac Events
• Wells' Criteria - Pulmonary Embolism & DVT
• MELD Score - End-Stage Liver Disease
• HAS-BLED Score - Major Bleeding Risk
• SIRS/Sepsis Criteria - Septic Shock Assessment
• Mean Arterial Pressure - Hemodynamic Monitoring
MDCalc ensures only the highest-quality, clinically relevant tools make it into the app. Each calculator undergoes rigorous evidence appraisal and validation by our network of academic and practicing physician experts.

bluejetty:00014446:ios.description:
Mobile-Punch: Time, Project, and Communication Management Solution
Mobile-Punch is a comprehensive solution designed to simplify workforce, project, and communication management within your organization. It enables managers and employees to improve efficiency through an intuitive platform that centralizes timesheets, payroll, project tracking, team communication, and reporting.
By automating many administrative tasks, Mobile-Punch helps reduce errors, save time, and lower costs associated with manual management. Accessible at any time via the cloud, the application allows you to stay in control of your operations wherever you are.
Key Features
Time and Project Management
 - One-click clock-in/out: Employees quickly log their start time, end time, and travel directly within the appropriate project.
 - Integrated geolocation: Each clock-in is linked to a GPS location, ensuring accurate validation of on-site presence.
 - Automated timesheets: Hours are compiled automatically, eliminating manual calculations and reducing errors.
 - Project cost reporting: Track labor costs and project progress in real time with clear and detailed reports.
 - Cloud access: Manage your teams and projects anytime, anywhere.
Integrated Communication Tool
Mobile-Punch goes beyond management by integrating a powerful communication solution directly into the application.
 - Centralized team messaging: Easily communicate with employees through an integrated chat, without relying on multiple emails, text messages, or external apps.
 - Discussion channels:
 - General channel for company-wide announcements
 - Project-based channels for targeted and organized discussions
 - File and media sharing: Send photos, videos, and documents to support communications and track project progress.
 - Integrated media gallery (photos and videos): Quickly access all images and proof of work in one place.
 - Real-time interaction: Reply, react, and collaborate efficiently using interaction features (emojis, direct replies, etc.).
This centralized communication approach helps prevent information loss, improves collaboration, and supports better day-to-day decision-making.
A Solution Tailored for Mobile Workforces
Whether you operate in construction, security, maintenance, or any field requiring on-site teams, Mobile-Punch helps you stay organized, connected, and efficient.
Take Action
Download Mobile-Punch today to optimize workforce management, improve internal communications, and take control of your operations.

bluejetty:00088441:ios.summary:
WebProxyTool captures and displays all network data that your device and installed apps transmit and receive.
How It Works:
The app creates a local on-device server and routes all outgoing HTTPS traffic through it. The app locally generate
bluejetty:00088441:ios.description:
WebProxyTool captures and displays all network data that your device and installed apps transmit and receive.
How It Works:
The app creates a local on-device server and routes all outgoing HTTPS traffic through it. The app locally generates a trust certificate that should be installed and trusted to securely decrypt HTTPS traffic. When it is done, WebProxyTool captures HTTPS requests, makes dummy leaf certificates for requested domains, and acts as a man-in-the-middle proxy to read network data. Importantly, data is stored only in a local device database, ensuring user privacy, and WebProxyTool developers do not have access to it. The app works without any remote servers involved.
Privacy Statement:
1. The configuration profile and trust certificate are generated and used only locally on your device.
2. The app does not collect any data about the user, the user's device, or other apps used on that device, and thus the app does not sell, use, or disclose to third parties any data for any purpose.
3. The captured HTTPS traffic never leaves your device.
Terms of Service:
https://webproxytool.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy:
https://webproxytool.com/privacy-policy

Offline New York Subway Map. Official MTA Subway Map of New York
Navigate the New York City subway system with a breeze.

Ever got caught on the NY subway with no Internet service and not sure where to go because a map is not handy?
New York Subway Map lets you view New York City's complicated subway lines and guide you on a map on your mobile phone/tablet even offline! No need for Internet Service!
Whether you're a tourist planning to go to Time Square, Central Park Zoo, SOHO, Financial District, One World Trade Center, Grand Central Terminal, NYU, Empire State Building, Rockefeller Center, Brooklyn Bridge, High Line, Metropolitan Museum of Art (The Met), The Battery, Museum of Modern Art, Flatiron Building, Chrysler Building, Bryant Park, American Museum of Natural History, Chinatown, Chelsea Market, The bull, or catch a glimpse of the Statue of Liberty via the Staten Island ferry or just an avid sports fan to catch a game in Madison Square Garden or Barclays Center or Yankee stadium, Or student going to a new school, college or university, or on your commute to a workplace or a work meeting, this is perfect for you!
Super Simple and Easy to use! Either find your way by looking at the Official MTA NY subway map or choose from the collection of subway lines and check the stations' information and available subway line transfers.

Go now and hop on to your next stop. Be your own travel guide. Be a tourist in a city that never sleeps. (Not all subway lines run 24 hours. Please check the night map for guidance.)

bluejetty:00068984:ios.description:

Netter's Anatomy Flash Cards - Learn the essential anatomy you need to known quickly and easily! Each flash card in this full-color deck features high-quality Netter art (and several new paintings by Dr. Carlos Machado), numbered labels (with hidden answers), and concise comments and clinical notes for the most commonly tested anatomy terms and concepts. Focusing on clinically relevant anatomy, this easy-to-use, portable study tool helps you learn anatomical structures with confidence!
KEY FEATURES :
* Clinical Notes help you focus on the most relevant clinical implications of anatomical concepts, helpful in preparing for the USMLE Step 1 exam
* Features a full-color illustration from Netter's Atlas of Human Anatomy, with numbered lines pointing to key structures
* Concise text identifies those structures and reviews relevant anatomical information and clinical correlations
* Offers a unique learning resource to supplement the anatomy textbook, atlas or dissection materials used in medical, dental, nursing, allied health, and undergraduate courses in human anatomy
* Separate groups of illustrations are devoted to anatomy - head and neck, back and spinal cord, thorax, abdomen, pelvis and perineum, upper and lower limb
* Within each group, information is arranged sequentially: Bones and Joints; Muscles; Nerves; Vessels; and Viscera;
* No internet connection is required to access the content after the initial download. Find information quickly using powerful SmartSearch technology. Search part of term for those hard-to-spell medical terms.

bluejetty:00040300:ios.description:
YOUR HEROES NEVER STOP. NEITHER DOES YOUR POWER.
Firestone is an idle RPG about building a five-hero formation and pushing it through endless waves of enemies and epic bosses.
Choose heroes whose abilities and resources work together. Equip them, refine your formation, break through the next wall, and turn yesterday’s impossible boss into today’s effortless victory.
Battles continue while you are away, with gold, loot, and progress waiting when you return. When you are at the keyboard, use abilities, accelerate combat, and decide which upgrades will carry your army farther.
BUILD YOUR PERFECT FORMATION
Collect heroes with distinct abilities, combat roles, and resources. Experiment with formations, combine their strengths, and create an auto battler team capable of defeating increasingly powerful enemies.
Level up heroes, equip and enchant gear, enhance jewels, develop talents, and unlock permanent upgrades. Every improvement makes your formation stronger and prepares it for the next boss.
A wall today becomes tomorrow’s easy victory.
EXPLORE THE WORLD OF ALANDRIA
Travel through a colorful fantasy world of dangerous forests, frozen lands, pirate territories, ancient ruins, and hostile strongholds.
Advance across the campaign map, clear stages, defeat powerful bosses, and unlock new regions, activities, and progression systems as your army grows.
ALWAYS ANOTHER WAY TO GROW
Firestone is an incremental RPG built around satisfying long-term progression. Research permanent upgrades, enchant equipment, command war machines, complete missions and expeditions, discover ancient artifacts, and unlock deeper layers of power.
New systems open gradually as you advance, giving you time to understand each one before adding the next to your strategy.
Your offline progress keeps rewards coming, but your choices decide how far your army can push. Choose which heroes to invest in, how to build your formation, and which upgrades will overcome the next challenge.
RECRUIT GUARDIANS. BUILD MORE POWER.
Collect and upgrade Guardians, powerful companions that support your heroes and add new bonuses to your army. Each Guardian brings another long-term goal and another way to strengthen your formation.
PLAY YOUR WAY
Let your heroes battle automatically while you work, relax, or step away. Return to accumulated rewards, upgrade your heroes and systems, and watch your team destroy enemies that once blocked your progress.
When you want to play more actively, use abilities, click to accelerate combat, optimize your formation, manage resources, and choose the upgrades that will carry you farther.
Whether you prefer idle games, clicker games, AFK progression, or deep incremental systems, Firestone lets you play at your own pace.
GROW SOLO OR WITH OTHER PLAYERS
Play solo or join a guild and progress alongside other players. Take part in guild expeditions, join a fellowship, unlock shared bonuses, and pursue more rewards without losing control of your personal journey.
Firestone’s online RPG features add cooperation and shared goals while allowing you to progress on your own schedule.
SEVEN YEARS OF UPDATES. 2M+ PLAYERS.
Regular updates bring new heroes, progression systems, seasonal events, balance improvements, and quality-of-life features. With 15+ interconnected systems, there is always another goal waiting ahead.
BUILD YOUR ARMY. BREAK THE NEXT WALL.
Collect your heroes. Build your formation. Defeat the next boss. Return stronger.
How far can your army go?
Join the community on Discord.

bluejetty:00046393:ios.description:
Missão
Oferecer produtos, serviços de qualidade, variedade e atendimento diferenciado, proporcionando aos nossos clientes a melhor escolha para suas compras.
Visão
Ser reconhecido como referência de qualidade e empreendedorismo sustentável no mercado varejista regional.
Valores
Integridade
Respeito
Disciplina
Determinação
Integridade
Manter uma conduta ética preservando a confiança em nossos relacionamentos.
Respeito
Reconhecer os princípios do respeito através da não discriminação e da igualdade de oportunidades nas relações com pessoas e instituições.
Disciplina
Agir com foco na realização dos objetivos e entregar sempre conforme o combinado.
Determinação
Saber o que deve ser feito, realizando todas as atividades com muita energia, buscando ser melhor sempre sem desistir.
Pilares da Sustentação
Segurança
Uma empresa que transmite segurança, é uma empresa que se torna confiável, que ganha credibilidade de seus clientes internos e externos, de seus parceiros, enfim, é uma empresa que possui bases sólidas e sustentabilidade.
Eficiência
A eficiência seria o ato de “fazer certo as coisas”. Acreditamos nessa premissa e trabalhamos para sermos eficientes em todos os nossos processos, pois de nada adianta ter qualidade nos seus produtos e serviços e não ser assertivo no momento da concretização de algum processo.
Qualidade
O Armazém do Grão oferece qualidade em todos os serviços e produtos que disponibiliza. Pensamos e trabalhamos com o detalhe, pois a qualidade está exatamente aí, no cuidado com os detalhes.
Atendimento UAU
O bom atendimento ao cliente é uma premissa do Armazém do Grão. Acreditamos que oferecendo um Atendimento Uau, ou seja, aquele que surpreende o cliente, que supera suas expectativas, estamos contribuindo decisivamente para criar a felicidade que tanto desejamos.
DNA do Armazém do Grão
Inovação
 O Armazém do Grão busca sempre trazer para seus clientes e funcionários novidades que facilitem sua vida, que ofereçam mais conforto e praticidade para o seu dia a dia. Pensar diferente, fazer diferente, inovar para crescer e se desenvolver, esse é o objetivo sempre.
Variedade
 A busca pela variedade dos produtos que oferecemos vem da vontade de proporcionar para o nosso cliente opções agradáveis de escolha, tornando assim o momento da compra mais prazeroso e feliz.
Excelência
Podemos sempre fazer amanhã ainda melhor o que fizemos hoje, esse é o caminho para quem busca a excelência, esse é o caminho que estamos trilhando.
Prática do Sorriso
Outra premissa do Armazém do Grão é a prática do SORRISO! Acreditamos que o sorriso quebra barreiras, abre portas, desfaz mal entendidos e principalmente transmite FELICIDADE que é nosso objetivo!

Member registration

Combine numerous parts and make your own avatar!
There is avatar of event limited distribution as well.
◆ New features! Tsumei Shogi every day!
I tried to pursue that I could continue with Tsume Shogi and created it.
Why do not you keep on tight shogi, which is the shortest practice to become stronger every day?
You can solve the problem of the number of hands set in 1 to 5 hands, increasing all 10 questions gradually with increasing difficulty.
Even if you do not know the answer, you can check the answer in 1 minute so it will not stop with a problem you do not understand.
You can receive reward every day by solving!
◆ People who want to start shogi, people who want to become strong in apps
It is packed with functions necessary for beginners to strengthen Shogi.
Although studying Shogi is hard, I can reach it fully with this one application until the first stage of Ama.
Why do not you graduate a chess beginner while playing for a little free time or killing time at commuting school time?
From checking the rules, flowing in the game, wearing shogi with Tsume Shogi can all be done with this application.
◆ Recommended for people like this!
From weak AI to strong AI, those who want to play chess with a wide range of opponents
Those who want to solve many packed shogi
Those who are about to start shogi in their free time
Those who do not know the rules of shogi, but who are trying to start shogi by watching animation and movies
◆ The mechanism of premium membership service
【Billing method】
You will be charged for your iTunes account. It is automatically renewed every month from the application date.
[Details of automatic update]
The membership period will be automatically renewed unless you cancel automatic renewal at least 24 hours before the end date of the premium service membership period.
Charges for automatic renewal will be made within 24 hours after the end of the membership period.
【Confirmation / Withdrawal of membership status (cancellation of automatic renewal))
Confirmation of member status and withdrawal can be done from the following.
1. Open the App Store application
2. Scroll to the bottom of the "Recommended" tab
3. Tap "Apple ID"
4. Tap "Show Apple ID" in the displayed pop-up
5. Sign in as needed
6. Tap "Register" on the "Account" screen
Please confirm the next automatic update date and time and cancel / setting automatic update on this screen.
* Please note that cancellation of the premium service currently in use in iTunes Store payment from within a shogi application can not be done.
【Cancellation for the current month】
We do not accept cancellation of the premium service for the current month.

◆Privacy policy

bluejetty:00015134:ios.description:
Master rhythm sight reading and expand your rhythm vocabulary with Coryvo - the ultimate rhythm trainer and sight reading app.
Coryvo's innovative algorithms generate randomized rhythms tailored to your chosen subject, allowing you to level up your rhythm sight reading skills by practicing new rhythms in every session.
The built-in playback feature with live animated cursor makes practicing your rhythm sight reading more engaging and effective. Enhance your rhythm sense and sight reading abilities with the integrated metronome that can be easily toggled on and off.
Created by professional musicians, Coryvo offers a progressive learning experience for everyone - from beginners to pros. Choose from over 100 presets to start practicing simple rhythms like quarter notes and eighth notes, then work your way up to advanced patterns like sixteenth notes, eighth note triplets, and more.
Coryvo also covers complex rhythms such as quintuplets, sextuplets, septuplets, 32nd notes, odd time signatures, and a vast range of polyrhythms.
Customize your practice with the Custom Score feature, allowing you to create your own rhythms by selecting parameters that match your needs. Focus on specific rhythmic ideas and phrases that challenge you.
Coryvo is the go-to tool for rhythm sight reading improvement, whether you play guitar, piano, bass, or drums.
Features:
- Over 100 rhythm presets for all skill levels and rhythm combinations
- Presets include 16th notes, 8th note triplets, odd subdivisions, odd time signatures, polyrhythms, and the challenging Scores of Doom!
- Playback features diverse samples, a live cursor, loopable sections, and a metronome
- Clean, intuitive graphic design for efficient sight reading practice
Experience infinite rhythm possibilities with Coryvo - you'll never practice the same score twice.
Happy practicing!
• Unlock the full potential of Coryvo by purchasing the premium version, granting access to all app presets and the ability to create your own custom scores.

bluejetty:00024865:ios.summary: Twisty Arrow: Bow Game is an addictive and exhilarating game that challenges players to test their precision and reflexes. With its simple yet engaging gameplay, the game is suitable for players of all ages. The objective is to shoot arrows
bluejetty:00024865:ios.description:
Twisty Arrow: Bow Game is an addictive and exhilarating game that challenges players to test their precision and reflexes. With its simple yet engaging gameplay, the game is suitable for players of all ages. The objective is to shoot arrows at a spinning circle target, aiming to hit the bullseye without touching the other arrows. As the circle twists and spins, the challenge intensifies, requiring players to strategize and improve their accuracy with each shot.
Players must tap their screens to release the arrows, carefully timing their shots to achieve the perfect aim. With each level, the difficulty increases as the spinning wheel rotates in different directions and at varying speeds. The game offers over 100 levels to conquer, with new levels added weekly to keep players engaged.
Featuring a quick reflex twitchy tap style gameplay, Twisty Arrow: Bow Game provides an immersive experience that keeps players on the edge of their seats. The game's funky and upbeat soundtrack adds to the overall enjoyment, creating a vibrant and lively atmosphere.
Features:
- Quick reflex twitchy tap style gameplay
- Over 100 levels to master with more updated weekly
- Funky fun soundtrack to jam to
- Simple to learn yet hard to conquer
With its simple mechanics yet challenging gameplay, Twisty Arrow: Bow Game is a must-have for anyone seeking an addictive and entertaining gaming experience. Test your skills, earn points, and see how far you can go in this thrilling game of precision and speed. Download and put your bow skills to the test!

bluejetty:00123416:ios.description:
Get best deals at top restaurants. Reserve a table now.
EazyDiner is the best app you’ll ever need to discover restaurants, make table reservations to avail great deals every time you eat out. If you love to explore new & exotic dishes in your vicinity, EazyDiner helps you to choose from 10,000+ restaurants across India & Dubai.
Created by a team of industry experts who are hoteliers and chefs from around the globe, you can choose from handpicked and curated restaurant selection for your next dining out experience. EazyDiner members get best deals and discounts ranging from free drinks to 50% off on total bill. Our Prime membership ensures guaranteed 25% to 50 % discounts. All our members enjoy deal on every meal.
Discover Restaurants & Reserve a Table
Reserve a table at best restaurants in all top cities such as Delhi-NCR, Pune, Mumbai, Bangalore, Kolkata, Chennai, Ahmedabad, Hyderabad and 150 other cities in India & Dubai. The EazyDiner app helps you find top restaurants in your city depending on your choice of cuisine, restaurant, and location. Keep a track of your current and past bookings and also share the booking details with friends and family. Reserve a table at trendy restaurants in just a few clicks and save time & money!
Earn and Splurge EazyPoints
EazyPoints are loyalty points that you earn by making table reservations with EazyDiner, eating out, writing a review and even by referring a friend. You’ll be amazed to explore the variety of redemption offers we have in store for you. You can redeem EazyPoints for FREE 1-night stays at 5-star hotel properties across the country. Keep on uploading the bill and pay via the app to earn more and more EazyPoints. The more the merrier!
Dine like a VIP with EazyDiner Prime
EazyDiner Prime gives guaranteed 25% and upto 50% discounts for members. Dine like a VIP every time you go out. The membership provides higher discounts, access to dining events, F&B experiences along with give 2X extra EazyPoints on every booking.
EazyDiner Savings – Big, Bigger, Biggest!
Go cashless and pay your food bill through the EazyDiner app with additional bank offers. Make big on savings at over 2500 restaurants with our PayEazy feature that lets you make 100% safe online food bill payments (cashless), provides EXTRA PayEazy exclusive discounts every time you pay your dining bill and also lets you earn additional EazyPoints.
Stay Abreast of Latest Food Trends, New Dining Spots & Restaurant Reviews:
As and when a new restaurant opens up in your vicinity, we’ll get on a mission to make you gorge its signature delights with the top deals there. With exclusive expert reviews by top food critics helmed by our co-founder, the iconic Vir Sanghvi, EazyDiner doubles up as your personal guide to an extensive range of dining options in your city. Install the EazyDiner app, read quality restaurant reviews, which will help you plan the next meal at your choice of restaurant with best deals & discounts.
24x7 Culinary Concierge to Delight your Dining Experience
To make sure you have a swift and smooth dining experience, EazyDiner offers a 24x7 concierge facility. Ping for any assistance & eat out without any worry!
Deli-very very Safe
If you don’t feel like going out and wish to eat your favourite dishes in the comforts of your home, bring EazyDiner to your rescue and get exciting deals on delivery as well. EazyDiner provides safe food deliveries and takeaway services from selected restaurants in your city those which are following strict guidelines and safety measures like frequent temperature checks, sanitization process and time-to-time visits to monitor the safety standards. EazyDiner makes sure that a stronger end-to-end control on hygiene and quality of the food is being done that reaches the diners, because your safety is our utmost priority. 
Experience dining the Eazy way !

bluejetty:00046493:ios.description:
Viko is a community app designed specifically for skiing enthusiasts, aiming to gather a large number of skiing enthusiasts to share the passion and fun of skiing together. Here, you can record and share every exciting moment of skiing, and reminisce about the speed and passion on the snow trail with like-minded partners.
Share your confident and heroic skiing posture through Viko and quickly upload it to the community. Whether it's thrilling jumping moments or elegant and smooth gliding postures, they can receive likes and comments from other skiing enthusiasts.
In addition, Viko also allows users to post skiing updates in the community, sharing their skiing experiences, insights, and upcoming skiing activities. This not only helps to expand your social circle, but also allows you to meet more like-minded friends and explore the infinite possibilities of the skiing world together.
You can communicate in real-time with other skiing enthusiasts on Viko, discussing skiing techniques, equipment selection, and the advantages and disadvantages of different ski resorts. Download Viko and join thousands of skiing enthusiasts to embark on your own ice and snow adventure!

• Export database as HTML or CVS. 
• Rate book for quick mileage rate reference.

• Designed for both iPhone and iPad.
• Dropbox support
• Apple Watch support!
*Disclaimer: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00187952:ios.description:
Need a few hours in a hotel? 
The BYHOURS app is the key to more than 4000 hotels booking for 3, 6 or 24 hours. In our hotels, you can choose the check-in time during the day or night and pay only for the time you need. With your booking, you can enjoy all the services included in the hotel with immediate confirmation and free cancellation.
Hotels by the hour?
There are thousands of occasions when you may need a few hours in a hotel! 
- Long waits at airports, stations, service areas and ports
- Leisure and disconnecting moments in your city
- Naps or moments of spa and relaxation
- Resting after a concert, party or football match
- Short stays in hotels near hospitals
- Business trips and meetings
- Enjoy early check-in and late check-out
In three simple steps, you can book rooms by the hour in 3, 4 and 5-star hotels worldwide. In the BYHOURS app, you will find independent hotels and the best chains: Sheraton, Hilton, Starwood, Meliá, Silken, Best Western, Hyatt, Barceló, Sercotel, Holiday Inn, Iberostar, NH and many more.
How to book a hotel room by the hour with BYHOURS?
1. Select destination, pack of hours, date and check-in time.
2. Choose the hotel that best suits your needs.
3. Book and receive your confirmation immediately.
Why will you fall in love with BYHOURS?
- Pay the right price: if you're only staying for a few hours... Why pay for a whole day? BYHOURS is revolutionising the hotel industry with its pay-per-use model.
- Hotels adapt to your schedule: why wait until 2 pm to check-in? You decide what time you want to check-in and how long you want to stay.
- Early check-in and late check-out.
- Top Hotels: now you can book rooms by the hour in over 4,000 3, 4 and 5-star hotels.
- Airports worldwide: we don't want you to wait hours at the airport when you have a stopover or when your flight is delay. Rest in the best airport hotels around the world.
- Access to all the services included in the hotel: WIFI, gym, meeting rooms, terrace, swimming pool, spa, etc.
- Booking cancellation: enjoy free cancellation up to 24 hours before check-in time.
Download the BYHOURS app to enjoy savings and flexibility when booking hotels by the hour.
Do you have any questions or suggestions? Contact us at: hello@byhours.com. We will be happy to help you!
BYHOURS is compatible with all iPhone and iPad models with iOS 15 or higher.

bluejetty:00063999:ios.name: Revenge of Sultans
bluejetty:00063999:ios.summary: Come and join players from around the world in this online real-time strategy game, and establish your own empire on the shores of the Mediterranean Sea! As a Lord in our world, you will be required to face intense challenges and fight epic
bluejetty:00063999:ios.description:
Come and join players from around the world in this online real-time strategy game, and establish your own empire on the shores of the Mediterranean Sea! As a Lord in our world, you will be required to face intense challenges and fight epic battles on behalf of your realm. Shoulder the hopes of your people and establish yourself as a mighty king, bringing peace and prosperity to the lands under your rule.
There will be a never-ending succession of rivals who covet the throne that is yours by right, and it's up to you to exhaust the limits of your strategic ability and remain one step ahead. Collect resources, train troops, and defend your kingdom. Wars will arise, and you must use all your knowledge and skill to ensure that you emerge on the winning side, time and time again, until the whole world lies at your feet!
Experience Battle on an Epic Level
Command elite troops as you annihilate your enemies, surrounded by the clamor of battle. To the victor go the spoils, to the loser, ignominy. With a mighty army at your back, and fueled by the latest technological advances, you are now ready to take on the world!
Explore the Rich Coastline of the Mediterranean Sea
Untold dangers lie in wait amongst the wild, virgin landscape. But for those who lust to travel, and have an army to fend off monsters, there is much to explore in the Relics of this new hinterland. Find boundless resources, or end up on a long and incredible adventure.
Overcome Your Problems With Strategy
You were chosen by the people to serve as king, but your enemies are resourceful and they will try to destroy your kingdom by any means possible. Can you keep up with the demands of your people? Or will a lack of resources cripple your economy? Remember, you can always ask your allies for help! Choose your allies with care, for they will be invaluable on your road to world domination!
Do Battle Shoulder to Shoulder With Your Friends
You will undoubtedly make many new friends on your long road to kingship, but be careful not to leave your old friends behind; invite them to play alongside you and conquer the world together! Share your victories and glory with your friends and forge a prosperous kingdom together!
FEATURES
● Build your castle, upgrade and defend it with turrets, walls and Traps.
● Build your own army of swordsmen, Archers, Camel Riders, catapults and other mighty fighters and tools.
● Battle with other players worldwide, defeat them and snatch their resources.
● Real-time strategy wars.
● Join together with other players and friends to form the ultimate alliance.
● Accept PvP challenges and prove your mettle against the best Lords in the Realm.
● Fight against other clans in the throne war and take revenge upon your enemies. 
● Live the medieval wars and re-live history.
Subscription Packs
Subscribe to receive 7 straight days of superb Weekly Pack offers. 
Apple monitors and manages all payments made through iTunes.
Once purchase has been confirmed, all fees will be charged from your iTunes account.
Subscriptions will renew automatically, unless automatic renewal is disabled at least 24 hours prior to your subscription ending.
Renewal fees will be charged to your account and confirmed within 24 hours of your subscription ending.
You can manage your subscriptions and can turn off automatic renewal in your account settings once a subscription has been set up.
 Where free trial periods are offered, any remaining time on your trial will be discarded as soon as you purchase the full subscription
User Support
My Lord, if you have any feedback then please send us a message at serviceros@onemt.com
Privacy Policy: http://www.onemt.com/abroadgame/outer/policy
Terms of Service: http://www.onemt.com/abroadgame/outer/terms

bluejetty:00167241:ios.name: Restaurant Simulator 3D Bar
bluejetty:00167241:ios.summary: Welcome to the exciting world of restaurant management in Restaurant Simulator 3D Bar! This realistic simulation game puts you in charge of your very own restaurant, where you’ll oversee every aspect of the business. From ordering food supp
bluejetty:00167241:ios.description:
Welcome to the exciting world of restaurant management in Restaurant Simulator 3D Bar! This realistic simulation game puts you in charge of your very own restaurant, where you’ll oversee every aspect of the business. From ordering food supplies, preparing dishes, and managing kitchen operations to serving customers, handling payments, and expanding your restaurant—every decision is yours to make!
In Restaurant Simulator 3D Bar, your main task is to order food supplies from vendors, prepare them by heating, and distribute them to the warmers to keep dishes ready for serving. The success of your restaurant depends on selecting the right ingredients, managing cooking times, and storing food properly. Every choice matters—from what you order to how quickly you get dishes onto customers' tables.
Your restaurant will attract a variety of customers, each with unique preferences and expectations. Your role is not only to prepare the dishes they order but also to ensure quick and efficient service. Make sure each customer receives their meal promptly and that the entire process—from ordering to payment—runs smoothly. Satisfied customers leave bigger tips and better reviews, which in turn will bring more traffic to your restaurant! Realistic cooking simulation, serving delicious dishes and selling the like in the supermarket. 
Grow Your Restaurant
Restaurant Simulator 3D Bar is not just about managing daily operations but also planning the growth of your restaurant. Use the money you earn to invest in kitchen upgrades, new equipment, and expanding your premises. Increase your space to serve more customers at once, and experiment with new recipes and dishes to attract even more patrons.
The game offers a realistic simulation of running a restaurant, where every task requires careful planning and execution. Manage your time, resources, and staff efficiently to ensure your restaurant operates like a well-oiled machine. Can you rise to the challenges of running a successful restaurant business? In Restaurant Simulator 3D Bar, you’ll put your management and organizational skills to the test.
Dive into a fully 3D-rendered world that offers detailed and realistic depictions of every aspect of restaurant life. Every element—from the kitchen to the dining area and the bar—has been meticulously designed to make you feel like a true restaurateur. Dynamic animations, realistic sound effects, and rich visuals make every minute in the game a delightful experience.
Key Features:
 Realistic Restaurant Management: Order supplies, prepare dishes, serve customers, and manage finances.
 Restaurant Growth: Invest in new equipment, expand your premises, and introduce new dishes to your menu.
 3D Graphics: Detailed, realistic, and immersive visual representation of all restaurant operations.
 Dynamic Gameplay: Manage multiple aspects of your business simultaneously and face the daily challenges of being a restaurateur.
Restaurant Simulator 3D Bar is the perfect game for anyone who dreams of running their own restaurant or wants to test their management and customer service skills in a virtual environment. Whether you’re a fan of simulation games or just love a good challenge, this game will provide you with hours of entertainment. Download Restaurant Simulator 3D Bar now and start your journey in the culinary world!
Optimize your restaurant business and dominate the culinary scene with Restaurant Simulator 3D Bar—where your management skills and quick decisions determine your success. Whether you're looking to grow your restaurant empire or just enjoy the thrill of the service industry, this game offers endless possibilities. Take control of your restaurant's destiny, create unforgettable dining experiences for your customers, and build the culinary empire of your dreams.

bluejetty:00066382:ios.description:
Know what's ahead on the road with the help from other drivers. Waze is a live map that harnesses the local knowledge of tens of millions of drivers around the world. Drivers safely and confidently reach their everyday destinations thanks to Waze map’s GPS navigation, live traffic updates, real-time safety alerts (including construction, accidents, crashes, police, potholes, and more), and accurate ETAs.
Make your next drive more predictable and stress-free:
• Get there faster with real-time directions, accurate ETAs, and automatic rerouting based on live traffic, incidents, and road closures
• Even if you know the way, avoid surprises on the road ahead with safety alerts for accidents, crashes, construction, objects on the road, potholes, speed bumps, sharp curves, bad weather, emergency vehicles, railroad crossings, and more
• Steer clear of tickets by knowing where police and red light & speed cameras are located
• Share what’s happening on the road with other drivers by reporting live incidents and hazards
• Stay informed of upcoming speed limit changes, and keep your speedometer in check
• Know which lane to be in with multi-lane guidance
• See toll pricing and choose to avoid tolls along your routes
• Add road passes and vignettes for HOV lanes and restricted traffic zones
• Find gas / fuel stations & prices and EV charging stations along your route
• Locate and compare parking lots and their prices near your destination
• Use voice-guided turn-by-turn navigation from a variety of languages, local accents, and your favorite celebrities
• Plan your next drive by checking ETAs by future departure or arrival times
• Use your favorite audio apps (for podcasts, music, news, audiobooks) directly within Waze
• Sync Waze to your car’s built-in display through Apple CarPlay
* Some features are not available in all countries
* Waze navigation is not intended for emergency or oversized vehicles
You can manage your in-app Waze Privacy Settings at any time. Learn more about the Waze privacy policy here, www.waze.com/legal/privacy.

bluejetty:00039930:ios.description:
Sunrise is an ADHD-focused AI coach and habit tracker for building a daily routine. Start with a small goal, follow your progress, and find support when your day feels overwhelming.
AI COACHING
Use chat or voice conversations to think through your daily challenges and choose a practical next step.
HABITS AND MOOD
Track habits, build streaks, and record your mood. Look back at patterns and make room for the routines that work for you.
FOCUS AND SLEEP COURSES
Follow short lessons in focus training, dopamine detox and better sleep. Take one step at a time instead of trying to change everything at once.
BREATHING AND MOVEMENT
Use guided breathing exercises for a pause between tasks. Track steps and keep movement in your day.
SELF-REFLECTION
Explore ADHD self-assessments and personal insights. Sunrise is a support tool, not a medical diagnosis or a replacement for professional ADHD treatment.
The app interface is available in English.

bluejetty:00183831:ios.summary:

- Lightning fast payments: send a
bluejetty:00183831:ios.description:
Muun is the most powerful wallet for bitcoin and lightning network. It is simple, fast, and secure. We provide the best user experience for sending and receiving bitcoin (BTC). 
Muun's highlights include:
- Lightning fast payments: send and receive instant payments using bitcoin's latest tech, lightning network. Lightning is the most popular scaling solution for blockchains and brings great UX benefits such as faster and cheaper payments.
- Seamless lightning integration: make all payments from a single wallet and following the same steps. You can enjoy lightning without needing any specific knowledge.
- Smartest bitcoin fees: Muun's mempool-based estimator gets your transaction confirmed fast without overpaying. Save an average of 30% compared to other wallets.
- Fully self-custodial: Muun is a self-custodial wallet meaning you are in total control of your bitcoin. Nobody, not even Muun, can access your money. Export an Emergency Kit with your private keys and output descriptors, intended to be used in a scenario where Muun is unavailable. The Kit was designed to fit bitcoin's latest scripts, including multisig, lightning and taproot.
- Convenient wallet recovery: access your wallet from a different phone using a code written on paper or your email and password.
- Protected with multi-signature: Muun is a 2-of-2 multi-signature wallet. Your Emergency Kit has both keys, but your phone just one. Your money is safe even if your phone gets hacked or stolen because two keys are needed to spend it, and only one is in your phone.
Other features include:
- Fee selection
- Support for Bech32
- Native app
- Customer support in English and Spanish
For feedback and assistance, you can reach us at support@muun.com.
You can also find us on Twitter: @MuunWallet

bluejetty:00091573:ios.name: Outcomes4Me Cancer Care
bluejetty:00091573:ios.summary: Outcomes4Me is a direct-to-patient digital platform with the clinical, evidence-based knowledge you’ll need to best navigate your medical choices and take a more active role in treating your cancer. Outcomes4Me currently supports breast can
bluejetty:00091573:ios.description:
Outcomes4Me is a direct-to-patient digital platform with the clinical, evidence-based knowledge you’ll need to best navigate your medical choices and take a more active role in treating your cancer. Outcomes4Me currently supports breast cancer and lung cancer patients. 
***
Outcomes4Me Featured Tools & Resources
• Personalized treatment path – get a snapshot of recommended treatment options, drug information, and procedure alternatives based on your medical records history.
• Clinical trial matching – get matched with clinical trials that are relevant to you and around your desired location.
• Symptom management & tracking – monitor how your medication and therapies are making you feel and track your progress towards improved health.
• Consolidated medical records – we will track down and consolidate all your medical records into one report that is easy to read and understand.
• Curated cancer news and content – personalized news and content surrounding your cancer diagnosis, insurance, policies, and much more.
• Ask Outcomes4Me – ask our team of oncology nurse practitioners a question based on how you’re feeling for support on how to better manage your care.
• Validated external resources – our resources section provides you with additional vetted information on genomics, specialized cases, and guidance from The American Society of Breast Cancer, the National Comprehensive Cancer Network® (NCCN®), the CDC, ASCO, WHO, Wolters Kluwer, and more.
How does Outcomes4Me work?
Outcomes4Me is a direct-to-patient, AI-driven patient empowerment platform that integrates with the NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology (NCCN Guidelines®) and makes them patient-facing, providing the clinical, evidence-based knowledge you need to take a more active role in navigating your cancer treatment. Outcomes4Me gathers treatment recommendations typically meant for oncologists and uses Artificial Intelligence to translate that information so you can understand it, putting you in control. With this knowledge, you can feel empowered to make the best medical decisions with your care team.
Why Outcomes4Me?
• Outcomes4Me is the only app fully integrated with the NCCN Guidelines®, from the not-for-profit alliance of 32 leading cancer centers, that provides you with personalized treatment options based on your specific diagnosis.
• 7 days of symptom tracking is all it takes before you start to see trends and results that can make you feel better.
• No additional appointments, and no added bills. This app is 100% free for patients and always will be.
Download Outcomes4Me today and join our community of members helping us on our mission to empower patients with understandable, relevant, and evidence-based information surrounding their cancer diagnosis. Take control over your cancer with this all-in-one app.
Music: www.bensound.com

bluejetty:00100220:ios.description:
Ball Sort Puzzle - Color Magic: Relax & Play
Discover the most relaxing and addictive color sorting game Ball Sort Puzzle - Magic Sort!
Designed to entertain and sharpen your mind, Ball Sort Puzzle - Magic Sort melts away stress while distracting you from daily worries.
Simple to play, hard to master. 
Just tap to move colored balls between bottles until they are sorted by color. 
With thousands of puzzles ranging from easy to expert, you’ll need to think strategically. One wrong move and you might get stuck! 
Ball Sort Puzzle - Magic Sort is the ultimate puzzle game to train your logic and exercise your brain.
Totally FREE to play.
Easy Control: One-finger control, just tap to sort the ball.
10000+ Levels: Endless challenges and fun.
NO Timer: Play at your own pace without pressure.
No Penalties: Restart levels whenever you want.
Smart Tools: Use "Undo" to step back or "Add" for an extra bottle.
Brain Training: Improve logic while you relax.
Offline Mode: Play anywhere, no WiFi needed.
Family Friendly: Fun for all ages!
HOW TO PLAY:
Tap a bottle to pick up the top ball, then tap another to drop it in.
You can only stack a ball on top of the same color and if there is enough space.
Sort all same-colored balls into one bottle to win!
Each bottle holds a limited number of balls. If it's full, no more can be poured.
Never get bored again! This challenging yet soothing Ball Sort game is perfect for passing the time. 
Share the fun with your family and enjoy quality time together.
Why play this game? The color ball sort puzzle games not only exercise your brain but also relieve stress and distract you from daily worries.
If you like games such as Tile Master, Water Sort, Mahjong Tile Match, or Hexa Puzzle, you will definitely love this color match game! It brings a new experience to sorting games. 
Share our brain training game with your family and enjoy a full day of entertaining family time.
Ready to train your brain? Download now and see who becomes the ultimate Color Sorting Master!

bluejetty:00144746:ios.summary:
Play the classic card game Contract Bridge — featuring Rubber Bridge, Chicago Bridge, and Duplicate Teams — anytime, anywhere!
CHALLENGING AND ENJOYABLE FOR ALL
New to Bridge?
Learn and improve as you play with helpful bid and play sugges
bluejetty:00144746:ios.description:
Play the classic card game Contract Bridge — featuring Rubber Bridge, Chicago Bridge, and Duplicate Teams — anytime, anywhere!
CHALLENGING AND ENJOYABLE FOR ALL
New to Bridge?
Learn and improve as you play with helpful bid and play suggestions from the NeuralPlay AI. Unsure about a bid's meaning? Just tap it for an explanation.
Experienced player?
Sharpen your strategy with six levels of advanced AI and our unique double dummy solver, featuring detailed optimal play analysis.
Choose from popular bidding systems — SAYC, 2/1 Game Force, ACOL, and Precision — and play the system you prefer.
KEY FEATURES
Learn & Improve
• Bidding explanations: Tap any bid to see an explanation.
• AI guidance: Receive real-time insights when your plays differ from the AI’s.
• Double dummy solver: See an optimal play for any hand and compare it to your own.
• Trick-by-trick review: Analyze every move in detail to sharpen your gameplay.
• Bidding practice: Practice bidding hands with the NeuralPlay AI, without playing the full deal.
• Built-in card counter: Strengthen your counting and strategic decision-making.
Core Gameplay
• Game modes: Play Rubber Bridge, Chicago Bridge, Duplicate Teams, or Matchpoint Practice.
• Offline play: Enjoy the game anytime, even without an internet connection.
• Six AI levels: Choose from beginner-friendly to expert-level AI opponents.
• Undo: Quickly correct mistakes and refine your strategy.
• Hints: Get helpful suggestions when you’re unsure of your next move.
• Claim remaining tricks: End the hand early when your cards are unbeatable.
• Skip hand: Move past hands you’d rather not play.
• Replay hand: Review and replay previous deals.
Advanced Tools & Customization
• Custom deals: Play deals with specific distributions and point counts (e.g., deal South 15–17 HCP hands to practice notrump bidding).
• Setup a deal: Construct hands from scratch with the Setup Deal option. Choose the dealer and vulnerability, arrange the cards exactly how you want, and play.
• Edit & replay deals: Explore alternate lines of play. Move cards between hands at any point and replay the deal to test “what if” strategies.
• Double dummy analysis: Explore the optimal plays of each hand, try alternate lines of play, and view par contracts.
• Detailed statistics: Track your performance, including game and slam success rates, and compare your results with the AI’s.
• PBN support: Save or load human-readable records of deals in Portable Bridge Notation (PBN) format to play or review.
• Deal sequences: Play a predetermined set of hands by entering a sequence number. Share it with friends to play the same deals.
• Deal database: Automatically saves every deal you play for easy review, replay, and sharing.
• Deal editor: Create and modify your own deals, or edit existing ones from your deal database.
• Customizable bidding system: Enable or disable specific conventions (including Weak Twos, Jacoby Transfers, Roman Keycard Blackwood, and more).
• Dummy Layouts: Choose the Traditional layout where cards are grouped by suit in rows or columns and oriented toward you, or a Compact single-row or column layout designed to maximize card size and save space on smaller screens.
• Personalize: Customize the look with color themes and card decks.
DOWNLOAD TODAY
Play, learn, and enjoy a single-player Bridge experience with smart AI partners, in-depth learning tools, and numerous ways to practice and improve.

bluejetty:00040570:ios.description:
HabitDone is a modern habit tracking app that helps you achieve your goals and stay motivated through its clean and modern interface. You can set multiple habits, establish goals, and track your progress. It utilizes visually appealing heat maps to track your progress and provides various data analysis features. Additionally, it supports custom theme colors, multiple check-ins per day, personalized icons, habit descriptions, and system reminders to keep you motivated.
Key features include:
Habit Tracking
Customize habit names, descriptions, personalized icons, system notification settings, and set the frequency of completion for each habit.
Multiple Check-Ins
Set habits to be completed multiple times per day. You can choose the number of times to check in each day.
Goal Setting
Set your goals for how often you want to complete your habits—whether it's weekly, daily, or monthly. You have the flexibility to define it as you wish.
Reminder Functionality
HabitDone can set system reminders, allowing you to schedule reminders on specific days and times each week. You'll receive notifications at the designated times to help you stay on track with your habits.
Chart Analysis
HabitDone provides heat maps, line charts, scatter plots, calendars, and various other dimensions for tracking and analyzing your habits.
Data Import/Export
HabitDone supports data import and export functions to ensure the safety of your data. You can store your data at any location at any time.
Privacy Protection
Your data is completely private and secure—no login is required, there are no servers, and no data is stored.

bluejetty:00128478:ios.description:
The Nuclear Bomb Simulator is a free app designed to calculate the areas affected by a nuclear explosion based on the nuclear explosion formula.
This app is suitable for those who wish to learn about the destructive effects of nuclear explosions and may be useful for evacuation planning.
The app can calculate the approximate radiation radius and possible number of casualties based on a list of existing or past weapons and their yields, such as Fat Man, Little Boy, Tsar Bomba, and 28 other weapons with their respective yields.
The development of this app is primarily for educational and awareness purposes.
We hope for world peace and the preservation of our planet!

bluejetty:00081149:ios.name: Popular Words 2: Trivia Quiz
bluejetty:00081149:ios.summary:
Sequel to the fan-favorite word trivia quiz game Popular Words: Family Game is here! Being your own tv show game with amazing new game modes and even more fun trivia questions! 
Enhance your trivia quiz game experience with Popular Words 2
bluejetty:00081149:ios.description:
Sequel to the fan-favorite word trivia quiz game Popular Words: Family Game is here! Being your own tv show game with amazing new game modes and even more fun trivia questions! 
Enhance your trivia quiz game experience with Popular Words 2. It has a unique design and it is an addictive, fun quiz game like its predecessor Popular Words. This brain teasing game invites you to the best trivia game experience. Test your general knowledge, vocabulary, intelligence, and ingenuity with a relaxing design and gameplay while improving your IQ, memory, concentration, attention and logic. Guessing words has never been this fun!
If you are a word game fan, try this challenge, take the quizzes, and discover Popular Words 2. Enjoy the most addictive quiz game mode with new competitive tv show elements! Try to score high points by not only guessing the most popular answers to short everyday questions in life, but also in correct order. Enjoy this fun quiz game with your friends and family. Hours and hours of fun are guaranteed with this free and addictive trivia quiz game! Your awareness of your daily routine will also increase. You will be aware of what people say generally and become a master of game show games. 
If you like headbands games, people games and guess the word games you will enjoy this fun word trivia game too. Get everyone's heads up in your family and ready to play this engaging family game of guessing words to fill in the blanks.
Popular Words 2, TV shows like implementation, will be your favorite in family and friends. Feud in the family is inevitable when the time comes answering questions. “Fifty Fifty” will make it easier to select the correct answer by reducing the options into two answers. When you have a wrong guess you can use “Extra Move” to compensate for it. If you are sure you are the best then use “Double Points” to double the points you earn from the answers and advance in ranks fastly. You will always have the “Remove Answer” option to get rid of excessive answers in this free trivia game.
Get famous by rising up in the ladder of popularity. Feel like a true trivia celebrity and a talk show host. Start from nobody and reach the level of Legend! Every correct answer and extra game modes grant you popularity points to help in this tricky trivia journey. Fun quiz show game blends with a true word search experience empowered with millions of quizzes and trivia challenges. Guess the answers and become a star and prevent feud in your family!
FAST FAME
Can you guess quickly what the other players picked? The words will seem very easy, but the answers are tricky and be aware of jeopardy. Quiz up the questions in a row to get higher points in this trivia pursuit. Are you careful enough to keep your turn in this puzzle brain game? Each level win will increase your points multiplier as you take higher risks in higher trivia levels. 
WHEEL OF FUN
Spin the wheel, answer the questions from the five different categories, collect the points, and advance in the leaderboard. Geography, History, Sports, Science, and Movies have their own rankings. Show yourself in which category you are the best in this free quiz game. Your trivia and popular culture trove will be enlarged massively by playing our trivia questions. 
FEATURES
- Hundreds of questions, thousands of word challenges 
- Daily gift coins for free hints
- Three different modes to entertain yourself
- Questions from Geography, History, Sports, Science, Movies
- Simple & easy to play. Relaxing music and gameplay 
- Leaderboards to compete with others.
- Brain test for your general knowledge

bluejetty:00185392:ios.description:
The official Hoosier Lottery app makes it easy to stay in the know, wherever you go. It’s more convenient than ever to scan your tickets, see the latest games, view winning numbers and jackpot amounts, enter 2nd Chance promotions, setup alerts, and find your nearest retailer, anytime, anywhere. 
Create and save your favorite numbers using a Digital Playslip! Skip the paper playslips and build your Digital Playslip right in the Hoosier Lottery app! You can easily scan the Digital Playslip QR code at any Hoosier Lottery retailer or select vending machines to purchase your ticket.
Features: 
- Scan Tickets. Scan the barcode on your Draw, Scratch-off and Fast Play tickets to see your results. 
- Enter available 2nd Chance promotions for more chances to win. 
- Stay up to date on myLOTTERY promotions for chances to win prize packs, Scratch-offs, VIP experiences and more! 
- Create and save digital playslips for your favorite Draw games. 
- Check the latest jackpot amounts. 
- See winning numbers and learn how to play Powerball®, Mega Millions®, Hoosier Lotto®, Cash POP™, CA$H 5, Millionaire for Life, Powerball Xs and Os, Daily 3, Daily 4, and Quick Draw games. 
- See the latest Scratch-off and Fast Play games. 
- Set your preferences and get customized notifications for jackpots and winning number alerts, plus other Hoosier Lottery game information. 
- Turn on push notifications. 
- Find your nearest Hoosier Lottery retailers. 
Must be 18 or older to play. Please play responsibly. The Hoosier Lottery encourages adults to establish appropriate parental controls on mobile devices accessed by children under the age of 18 to limit their ability to download or access this app. 
*This app uses background location to serve region-specific promotions and event information to our players. Continued use of background location may decrease battery life.* 
*Apple is in no way involved or associated with the functions of the Hoosier Lottery App*

bluejetty:00026456:ios.description:
Discover Essential, your ultimate companion for a vibrant and heart-healthy life. Essential is more than an app; it's a comprehensive approach to well-being. From heart health and blood sugar data monitoring and tracking to healthy lifestyle nurturing, Essential guides you towards a fitter and happier you like a personal health assistant. It now includes blood sugar management tools to help you maintain optimal health. Stay updated with the latest heart health insights and tips to stay ahead on your wellness journey.
Before You Begin: Health Disclaimer
· This app is specifically designed for fitness purposes and its primary function is to support general health awareness and encourage physical activity. 
· Please refrain from using the app to diagnose, prevent, or treat any medical conditions. It is not a replacement for professional medical tools or expert medical advice. 
· Please note that the app's capabilities are limited to measuring heart rate and do not extend to monitoring blood pressure or blood oxygen levels.
· If you possess any health-related concerns, always consult with a qualified healthcare provider before making any decisions or following any recommendations.
Measuring Heart Rate: Your Guide to Accuracy
-Gently grasp your phone and ensure you remain in a tranquil state.
-Fully block the rear camera using your fingertip.
-Remain stationary throughout the entire measuring procedure until it finishes.
Main Features of Essential:
1. Heart Rate Monitor: Stay connected to your heart's rhythm with real-time heart rate and Heart Rate Variability (HRV) monitoring. Understand your body's responses to stress and activities, and make mindful adjustments for better heart health.
2. Blood Pressure and Oxygen Analyzer: Monitor your blood pressure and oxygen saturation trends to gain a holistic view of your cardiovascular well-being.
3. Blood Sugar Tracker: Support your blood sugar management with capabilities to record and track your blood sugar trends. This feature helps you monitor and respond to your body's glucose levels effectively.
4. Tailored Bite-sized Workouts: Access easy-to-follow workout routines that cater to your fitness level and heart health goals. Strengthen your cardiovascular system with exercises designed to support a healthy heart.
5. Shareable Heart Health Report: Create detailed heart health reports to share with your doctor for personalized care.
6. Soothing Sleep Music and Meditation: Enhance relaxation and sleep quality with soothing music and guided meditations for better heart health.
7. Health Tips and Articles: Keep up with heart health developments through selected tips and articles from trusted sources.
8. MBTI and Health Tests: Discover how your personality affects heart health with the MBTI and utilize health assessments for deeper insights.
Get Essential membership to unlock VIP features
Subscription plans:
-Every week
-Every month
-Every year
·Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon purchase confirmation.
·Manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in Account Settings after purchase.
·Your subscription will auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Essential empowers you to enhance your cardiovascular health through technology and mindfulness. It offers real-time heart rate monitoring, trend analysis, customized workouts, and meditation resources, providing you with the necessary tools to actively manage your heart health. Download Essential today!

bluejetty:00150859:ios.description:
HOME
View upcoming and past infusions. Set reminders to get notified when it’s time to infuse. Easily access Record Infusion and access additional content.
RECORD INFUSIONS
The Hizentra App can make it easy for you to record infusions. Just scan the QR code with your device’s camera and record details such as infusion sites. With improved scanning, the date, time, lot number, expiration date, form type, and form size will be automatically captured.
TRACK
With the Hizentra App, every infusion you log becomes a digital record of your therapy history, which you can review and edit at any time. You can filter your records by date or search by lot number or keywords from your past infusions. The Hizentra App lets you share your infusion data as a PDF.
DATA
With your consent, the Hizentra App will store your data in a secure cloud, backing up your infusion history and syncing across your devices. Please see full Prescribing Information and Important Safety Information, including boxed warning at www.Hizentra.com.
SELECT IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION
WARNING: Thrombosis (blood clots) can occur with immune globulin products, including Hizentra. Risk factors include: advanced age, prolonged immobilization, a history of blood clotting or hyperviscosity (blood thickness), use of estrogens, installed vascular catheters, and cardiovascular risk factors. If you are at high risk of blood clots, your doctor will prescribe Hizentra at the minimum dose and infusion rate practicable and will monitor for signs of clotting events and hyperviscosity. Always drink sufficient fluids before infusing Hizentra. For US residents only.USA-IG-0088.
Please see full Prescribing Information and Important Safety Information, including boxed warning at www.hizentra.com

bluejetty:00120053:ios.name: Infinite Crafter: Alchemy & AI
bluejetty:00120053:ios.summary: Infinite Crafter is a sandbox simulation video game built around structured element fusion, strategic merge mechanics, and progressive world-building gameplay. This God Simulator allows players to create own world step by step inside a cont
bluejetty:00120053:ios.description:
Infinite Crafter is a sandbox simulation video game built around structured element fusion, strategic merge mechanics, and progressive world-building gameplay. This God Simulator allows players to create own world step by step inside a controlled creation lab environment.
The core gameplay loop is based on combining fundamental elements such as fire, earth, wind, and air. Each successful combination unlocks a new element, expanding the crafting tree and advancing world evolution. The system is designed as an endless sandbox progression model where experimentation directly drives simulation growth.
Players begin with basic natural forces and gradually evolve their planet from microscopic life to complex civilizations. Every merge action contributes to structured development within the simulation system.
Infinite Crafter focuses on:
► Element fusion experimentation
► Logical merge chains
► Combination-based progression
► Sandbox world simulation
► Evolution-driven crafting mechanics
Each new element expands gameplay depth. Each new reaction strengthens the sandbox structure. The simulation rewards strategic thinking, experimentation, and systematic discovery.
Players build ecosystems, develop technologies, construct cities, and guide civilization growth through consistent element fusion mechanics. The gameplay emphasizes world-building simulation rather than random crafting.
Planet Mode enhances the sandbox experience by visualizing world progression.
As players merge elements:
► Volcanoes appear
► Forests expand
► Oceans form
► Cities develop
► Skyscrapers rise
This system reinforces the create own world concept and provides direct visual feedback for every element fusion and combination. The planet evolves dynamically based on player decisions inside the simulation.
Infinite Crafter includes multiple gameplay systems built around the same sandbox simulation core:
► Mission Mode – structured logic challenges
► Puzzle Mode – construction-based objectives
► Quest Mode – scenario-driven simulation tasks
► Artifacts Mode – advanced triple element fusion combinations
► Arcade mini-games for additional gameplay variety
All modes support the central merge and element fusion mechanics.
Key Features
* Sandbox world-building simulation game
* Advanced element fusion system
* Strategic merge and combination gameplay
* Endless crafting progression
* Interactive creation lab environment
* 300+ unlockable elements and concepts
* Achievement and progression system
* Integrated elements encyclopedia
* Optimized for phone and tablet
* Optional ad control
* Available in 13 languages
Why Infinite Crafter?
* Deep sandbox simulation mechanics
* Structured God Simulator progression
* Creative and strategic combination system
* Endless merge experimentation
* Full create own world experience
Merge elements.
Expand your sandbox. Control the simulation. Create your own world in Infinite Crafter

bluejetty:00119735:ios.description:
Lightspeed Retail POS is the most powerful and intuitive iPad point of sale system for retail. Designed with a modern and sleek interface that’s as beautiful as your store, Lightspeed Retail POS is the #1 point of sale system that lets you run your business right from your iPad. Join 150,000+ customer locations worldwide who use Lightspeed’s award-winning one-stop commerce platform—no contracts, no commitment necessary.
Untether the checkout experience
• Move out from behind the counter and take your checkout process to the customer
• Speed up the checkout process with Quick Keys and an easy search function
• Run various types of promotions and discounts right from the app
Serve your customers better
• Make selling flexible with layaways, gift cards, on-account sales, and on-the-spot returns
• Collect customer details using Lightspeed Retail POS to grow your database and personalize the shopping experience
Gain new insights into your business
• Access data from anywhere with real-time reporting
• Create custom sales, inventory, and customer reports to always have a handle on your retail performance
• Manage and track sales targets per store and per team member so everyone can keep improving
Enjoy speed and reliability
• Delight shoppers with speedy transactions and reduced waiting times in store
• Enjoy continuous stable app usage even through your busiest periods
Expand the power of your POS
• Connect with your own hardware, from barcode scanners to receipt printers
• Access powerful capabilities—including Lightspeed Payments and ecommerce—from Lightspeed’s one-stop commerce platform
• Integrate with the best solutions in the world, including top accounting software, marketing platforms, and more
• Tap into Lightspeed’s open API to create bespoke apps and workflows that suit your business
Free onboarding & 24/7 support
• Enjoy award-winning customer support from our in-house team that’s available 24/7
• Get the undivided attention of a dedicated account manager 
• Get free step-by-step articles and resources in our comprehensive Help Center
• Watch step-by-step video tutorials to help you navigate and get the most out of your POS
Lightspeed Retail is the effortless POS software for busy retailers. You live and breathe retail… and guess what? So do we. We know the unique challenges that brick-and-mortar retailers face, and we’re giving you all the tools you need to run a thriving physical store. Thanks to Lightspeed’s one-stop commerce platform, you can get all the tools to successfully run your business from one powerful solution.

Welcome to Australian Military Bank’s official app. With Australian Military Bank mobile banking app you can:
- Check your account balance instantly (no PIN required)
- Use OSKO and PayID to send and receive money instantly
- Link to your favourite digital wallets, such as Apple Pay. 
- Log onto the app faster by creating a 4-digit PIN or using biometrics.
Plus all the things that you already expect, such as managing your cards and personal details. 
Things you should know: 
- Make sure you remember your secret question and answer before registering. You can reset this on internet banking if you have forgotten.
- To use Australian Military Bank mobile banking app you’ll need to be a member of Australian Military Bank and registered for online banking. You can open an account on our website. 
- Terms of Use apply and are available at australianmilitarybank.com.au/mobile-banking-app-terms-of-use.
A few things to remember about security:
- Don’t keep your PIN with your mobile device.
- Make sure you logout when you’re finished with mobile banking.
- Get in touch with Australian Military Bank immediately, if you've lost your mobile device or feel that someone may know your login details.
To learn more about Australian Military Bank mobile app, please visit https://australianmilitarybank.com.au/app.
Important Information: 
Terms of Use apply and are available at australianmilitarybank.com.au/mobile-banking-app-terms-of-use.

Transform your iPhone or iPad’s look with Daily Wallpaper, the ultimate app that offers a fresh, high-quality wallpaper every day. • Daily New Wallpapers from Bing: Enjoy a brand-new, high-resolution wallpaper every day. Our handpicked collection ensures that your device always looks fresh and exciting.

• Multiple Widgets: Access the latest, random, photography, and AI wallpapers directly from your Home Screen, StandBy Mode, or Control Center with our new widgets.
• Universal Support for iPad & iPhone: Experience a fully native interface designed specifically for your device. Whether on iPhone or the large screen of an iPad, your wallpapers look incredible.
• iCloud Sync: Keep your favorites consistent. Sync your handpicked favorite wallpapers across all your devices seamlessly using iCloud.
• High-Quality Photos: Each wallpaper is optimized for Retina displays, ensuring vibrant, crystal-clear backgrounds that look stunning on both iPhone and iPad.
• Dark Mode Support: Enjoy a sleek, modern interface with Dark Mode, seamlessly blending with your iOS device.

*This is the new app for Jitjatjo and Network users. Log in with the same email to access your team and shifts. 
Dayforce Flex Work makes it easy to find and manage reliable shift workers on demand. Whether you need last-minute coverage or ongoing support, connect with local, experienced professionals ready to work. 
How it works: Post shifts in seconds, get matched with best-fit available workers, and fill your schedule gaps without the headaches. 
Key Features: 
Fast matching - Book reliable, qualified workers in your area who match your shift requirements, preferences, and accreditations. 
‘My Team’ - Build a bench of your favorite repeat workers who know your business. 
Easy scheduling - Post shifts directly from your phone and watch fill rates update in real time. 
Accurate time-keeping: Workers check in with QR codes and real-time location tracking to keep everything transparent. 
Manager/Worker reviews - After each shift, review your team and see how they rated their experience too. 
Team messaging - Chat directly with workers for quick coordination and updates onsite. 
24/7 availability - Submit shift requests anytime. 
Instant support - Get help from our team when you need it most. 
Get Started: Download Dayforce Flex Work to post shifts, find reliable workers fast, and keep your business moving. 
Need help? Contact us at helpdesk@dayforceflexwork.com
