bluejetty:00152574:ios.name: Journey: Screen Time Control
bluejetty:00152574:ios.summary:
Almost every app on your phone is engineered to keep you scrolling. Journey is engineered to get you off it by turning real-world habits into a game you actually want to play.
Each morning, you unlock a set of real-world quests like going t
bluejetty:00152574:ios.description:
Almost every app on your phone is engineered to keep you scrolling. Journey is engineered to get you off it by turning real-world habits into a game you actually want to play.
Each morning, you unlock a set of real-world quests like going to the gym, reading, running, or getting outside. Complete them and earn Knight's gold. The apps that waste your time stay locked until you buy more screentime, so you stop instinctively scrolling everytime you pick up your phone.
It's the same reward loop that makes games addictive, except now it's working for you instead of against you.
- Daily Habits
Every morning at 6 AM, your main quest resets. Each one is a real-world habit: exercise, reading, going outside. Earn time on social media by completing it or else you'll stay locked out. 
- App Blocking
Pick the apps that drain your focus and lock them down. Your apps unlock only after you buy more screentime with the gold you earn. 
- Focus Buddy
Your mascot reflects how you're doing. Stay off your phone and it thrives. Pick it up too much and it lets you know. It's a visual reminder that keeps you motivated to do better. 
*Access to Journey requires a paid subscription*
Terms of Service: https://www.brainnourishment.io/_files/ugd/2e1950_ad149e0f2a11466682626871fd073315.pdf

bluejetty:00019510:ios.name: Top Drives - Car Race Battles
bluejetty:00019510:ios.summary: Petrol-heads, motor-heads, turn to Top Drives, the high octane driving challenge - test your skills and knowledge to the limit. Think you know cars? Top Drives is a new card collecting game with over 6000 real life cars to collect, compare
bluejetty:00019510:ios.description:
Petrol-heads, motor-heads, turn to Top Drives, the high octane driving challenge - test your skills and knowledge to the limit. Think you know cars? Top Drives is a new card collecting game with over 6000 real life cars to collect, compare and compete in racing battles with other players.
Build a garage of the best customized cars and create your very own perfect racing deck for supercharged action against your friends or other drivers. Whether you prefer a tuned up American muscle, a feisty Japanese hot rod or go turbo with European and agile, you’ll find a car that gets your motor running in Top Drives - the FREE car racing card collection game.
Top Drives is about racing cars across a variety of roads, tracks and challenges. If you like your driving fast and furious, you’ll love Top Drives. Hit the gas on asphalt circuits, slide your wheels around twisty circuits, master drifting in the G Force tests or speed to the chequered flag in a 1-100mph drag race. Choose Mustang, Camaro, Porsche Turbo, Audi TT or Nissan GTR, just make sure you’ve got the right car for the right track. You’ll need a garage of cars fast in the wet, good off-road, can take corners and burn rubber for drag races.
Why is Top Drives the ultimate motorsport experience for every car enthusiast? 
Features:
- Build the perfect car racing deck from over 6000 officially licensed cars
- Marques such as Bugatti, Pagani, Porsche, Mercedes, Audi, Mustang and many more
- Real car stats sourced from Evo makes this the ultimate bench racing game
- Unleash your cars on 100s of racing track challenges with our all-new Card Racing System
- Manage, upgrade and tune your stock cars – be the best motorsport manager
- Compete against your friends in thrilling scenarios including drag strips, race circuits & hill climbs
- Compete against rivals to win exclusive cars in live multiplayer events
- Weather effects and multiple surface types, including dirt tracks, asphalt and snow
- Stunning car photography from one of the world’s top car magazines
- Turbocharged, addictive, fun racing strategy gameplay
Own the road, start collecting the coolest new rides, customize with upgrades then sell on your tuned- up cars to build the perfect garage! Top Drives has fast single player campaigns and multiplayer mayhem modes with speed battles to the chequered flag. Top Drives is a combination of strategic card collecting with a motor-head racing theme!
Get an edge by fusing your cars and push your hot wheels to the limit. Become driving champion with the best combination of performance, handling and grip. Start your engine. Hit the road with Top Drives and unleash exciting updates, take to the track with the coolest, fastest cars including Porsche and Mustang, plus enjoy new game modes and new events themed around global car culture.
So, buckle up, stop dreaming and start driving. 
Download Top Drives today and let them eat your dust. 
Let us know what you want to see in the game: www.hutchgames.com
Our Privacy Policy: http://www.hutchgames.com/privacy/
Our Terms of Service: http://www.hutchgames.com/terms-of-service/
Top Drives is FREE to play but offers some optional in-game items that can be purchased for real money. Top Drives includes loot boxes that drop the available items in randomised order. Information about drop rates can be found by selecting a pack in game and tapping the 'Drop Rates' button. Packs can be purchased using in-game currency (Gold and Cash), which can be purchased through IAPs or earned through gameplay. Top Drives is an online game and requires a persistent internet connection to play.

bluejetty:00062719:ios.description:
- Featured on the TODAY show!
- Editor's Choice Award! - Children's Technology Review 
- "Stack the Countries is worth every penny and this is an educational purchase that you absolutely will not regret." - The iPhone Mom
Stack the Countries® makes learning about the world fun! Watch the countries actually come to life in this colorful and dynamic game! 
As you learn country capitals, landmarks, geographic locations and more, you can actually touch, move and drop the animated countries anywhere on the screen. Carefully build a stack of countries that reaches the checkered line to win each level.
You earn a random country for every successfully completed level. All of your countries appear on your own personalized maps of the continents. Try to collect all 193! As you earn more countries, you begin to unlock the free bonus games: Map It! and Pile Up! Three games in one!
CONTROL YOUR OWN EXPERIENCE: You can choose to focus on just one specific continent or play the whole world. You can also select which types of questions are asked.
LEARN BEFORE YOU PLAY: Stack the Countries provides 193 country flash cards and colorful interactive maps of the continents. Use them to brush up on your world geography before you play or as a handy reference tool.
HAVE FUN LEARNING ALL ABOUT THE COUNTRIES OF THE WORLD:
▸ Capitals
▸ Landmarks
▸ Major Cities
▸ Continents
▸ Border Countries
▸ Languages
▸ Flags
▸ Country Shapes
FEATURES:
▸ More than 1000 unique questions
▸ 193 flash cards -- one for each country!
▸ Interactive maps of the continents
▸ Collect all 193 countries and track your progress on personalized maps
▸ Earn FREE bonus games: Map It! and Pile Up!
▸ Play in English, Spanish and French
▸ Works on both iPhone and iPad - a universal app
▸ Create up to six player profiles
▸ Choose any of the friendly-looking countries as your avatar
▸ High resolution pictures of famous world landmarks
▸ All games are powered by a realistic physics engine
▸ Fun sound effects and music
▸ iPhone 4 Retina Display support
THREE GAMES IN ONE:
STACK THE COUNTRIES: Build tall piles of countries and try to reach the checkered line.
MAP IT: Tap the location of the selected country on the map. Try to complete the whole continent!
PILE UP: The countries are piling up! Identify and tap them quickly to get rid of them before they reach the top.
Stack the Countries® is an educational app for all ages that's actually FUN to play. Try it now and enjoy three games for the price of one!
PRIVACY DISCLOSURE:
Stack the Countries®:
- Does not contain 3rd party ads.
- Does not contain in-app purchases.
- Does not contain integration with social networks.
- Does not use 3rd party analytics / data collection tools.
- Does include links to apps by Dan Russell-Pinson in the iTunes App Store (via Performance Horizon).
For more information on our privacy policy please visit:
http://dan-russell-pinson.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00129543:ios.description:
Display NFTs as widgets using NFT Widgets! To use this app, simply paste an ethereum address into the text field and then add widgets onto your home screen! You can then long press the widget, hit edit widget, and select the NFT that you want each widget to display.
You can select whether or not you want to display the title of the NFT on the widget. You can also select whether you want the text to be on the top or bottom, and you can even select whether you want the title to be black or white. 
NFT Widgets is the first app of it's kind to bring widget utility to NFTs. Integrate as many NFTs as you want into your home screen, and do it with convenience and style!
(Apple does not support animated widgets, animated NFTs may not display)
NFT Widgets All Access gives you access to Wallet Floor Price widgets that updates every 15 minutes with the latest floor price of an NFT wallet.

NFT Widgets All Access starts with a three day free trial period, and then automatically renews at $1.99 per month.

bluejetty:00032866:ios.description:
Welcome to the enchanting Princess Castle! 
It's makeover time for the princess, and you're in charge! Choose from dazzling dresses, sparkling earrings to elegant shoes to create the perfect royal look. Team up with the adorabl fairy, Cocoping, to dress up your very own unique princess! 
■ Lovely Princess Dress-up
- Hairstyles: Change the princess's hairstyle with various options, from long flowing hair to elegantly tied ponytails.
- Dresses: What dress will she wear today? Choose an outfit that perfectly complements the princess's style!
- Makeup: Enhance the princess's beauty with a touch of makeup for an even more adorable look! 
- Nail Art: A variety of nail polish colors, rings, and bracelets are ready for the princess's charming manicure makeover. 
■ Special Care for the Princess
- Skin Care: Create a magical essence-infused face mask. After the treatment, the princess's skin will radiate with an enchanting glow! 
- Hair Care: Untangle those locks and neatly comb the hair. Don't forget to apply some magical cream!
■ Princess's Special Moments
- Afternoon Tea: The neighboring princesses have been invited to an afternoon tea party! Enjoy delightful desserts in the beautiful garden together.
- Party: An invitation to a grand party awaits! Dress up the princess to shine the brightest and set off to the party venue as the guest of honor!
■ Cocobi Princess Party's Special Fun
- Castle Decoration: Dress up the princess and collect hearts! Gather hearts for a beautiful castle transformation! 
- Photo Sessions: Create your own album! Capture moments of the afternoon tea, princess party, and the princess in the castle!
- Surprise Gifts: Play the Princess Party game every day to receive special gifts! Collect all the presents for a delightful surprise.
■ About Kigle
Kigle's mission is to create the 'first playground for children all over the world' with creative content for children. We make interactive apps, videos, songs, and toys to spark children's creativity, imagination, and curiosity. In addition to our Cocobi apps, you can download and play other popular games such as Pororo, Tayo, and Robocar Poli. 
■ Welcome to the Cocobi universe, where dinosaurs never became extinct! Cocobi is the fun compound name for brave Coco and cute Lobi! Play with the little dinosaurs and experience the world with various jobs, duties, and places.

bluejetty:00083132:ios.name: Number Salad: a daily puzzle
bluejetty:00083132:ios.summary: From the creators of Word Salad comes Number Salad, a brand new kind of daily game that will test and improve your math skills. Figure out the five problems in each daily puzzle, swiping to solve increasingly tricky tests. It’s time to get
bluejetty:00083132:ios.description:
From the creators of Word Salad comes Number Salad, a brand new kind of daily game that will test and improve your math skills. Figure out the five problems in each daily puzzle, swiping to solve increasingly tricky tests. It’s time to get math into your daily brain game routine!
A New Puzzle Daily
Number Salad challenges you with a new puzzle every day, starting with an easier one on a Monday before hitting you with a really tough challenge on the weekend, giving you time to warm-up as the week progresses.
Add Math To Your Daily Routine
Most daily puzzles are word or logic-based, but Number Salad offers something entirely different that will work out your brain in a totally new way. Number Salad fits perfectly into your daily puzzle routine by making math a fun part of it.
Thousands Of Completely Free Puzzles
Number Salad contains thousands of puzzles for you to play, all available completely offline! Play back through the daily puzzles or attempt one of the thousands of totally free extra puzzles.
A Wide Range Of Difficulties
Want a gentle puzzle? You’ll love the easier Trampoline levels. Fancy a mind-bending challenge? You’ll enjoy the fiendish Hourglass levels that really put your math skills to the test. The daily puzzle also gets harder as you move through the week, meaning that you’ll always be able to find a puzzle that suits the difficulty you feel like facing that day.
Perfect For Kids
Want a fun way to teach your kids about math? Children will love the Trampoline levels which are perfect for helping them learn their times tables. Doing the daily challenge with your kids can also be a great way to make learning fun.
Polish Your Math Skills
Mental arithmetic is a great skill for everyday life. Number Salad will help you hone yours while keeping your brain active and engaged.
Satisfying Gameplay
Number Salad brings the popular swiping mechanic from Word Salad to a whole new type of challenge.
More Than Just Math
You’ll need more than just simple arithmetic to solve the daily Number Salad, you’ll need both logic and geometry to figure out the solution to the puzzle.
Innovative Hints
Feeling stuck? Number Salad has an intuitive hint system which can point you in the right direction while still keeping it satisfying.
New shapes every day
Each daily puzzle has an exciting and different shape to it, so you’ll always find something new to test your brain.

bluejetty:00040930:ios.description:
- Easy taxi booking 
- Fixed price on all trips
- Pay by card or PayPal directly in the app
- Get status updates for your trip
TaxiKurir is a taxi company with flexible service for companies and individuals all over Scandinavia. We are Scandinavia's leading taxi company with representation in over 230 locations in Sweden, Norway and Denmark, always focusing on reliability and efficiency.
Download the app today to find out how easy it is!
- Start the app and book directly from your current location with Travel Now
- You can schedule future trips by tapping Pre-book 
- Next up is adding your destination to get a fixed price
- Finally tap Book trip to confirm your booking and get a taxi
- You can easily select different payment options (in car, CreditCard or Paypal)
We notify you both when the taxi is on its way and when it has arrived. You can also follow your car directly on the map. The app provides you with the taxi's car number so you can smoothly and easily find your car! You find the taxi's car number on the back of the taxi sign.
As a registered business customer you also have the option to pay by invoice, travel account or credit card. Your receipts can be sent directly to your company and you save both money and unnecessary time on administration! Contact us today and become a business customer.
Have a burning question? Email us at info@taxikurir.se
Want more information? Check our website taxikurir.se
TaxiKurir is part of Cabonline group, founded in 1989 and is today a leading European technology and service supplier in the taxi world. Originated in one of the most complex and deregulated markets in the world we have grown organically and through acquisitions. Today, our presence extends beyond Sweden and spans across Norway, Denmark, Finland, Holland and Great Britain.
Taxikurir is located in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Uppsala, Borlänge, Borås, Båstad, Eskilstuna, Falun, Gotland, Gävle, Helsingborg, Härnösand, Hässleholm, Hörby, Jönköping, Kalmar, Karlshamn, Karlskrona, Karlstad, Kristianstad, Lidköping, Linköping, Luleå , Lund, Norrköping, Skövde, Strängnäs, Sundsvall, Södertälje/Botkyrka, Tidaholm, Umeå, Vara, Västerås, Växjö, Ängelholm, Örebro, Östersund/Åre.

bluejetty:00145243:ios.description:
Conheça o POP driver, o aplicativo perfeito para quem busca uma renda extra utilizando seu carro e tempo livre. Com o POP driver, você se torna parceiro da POP move, uma das plataformas líderes em transporte de passageiros, e começa a ganhar dinheiro transportando pessoas em sua cidade de maneira simples, rápida e segura.
Ao baixar o aplicativo e se cadastrar como parceiro, você terá acesso a diversas funcionalidades pensadas para facilitar o seu trabalho e garantir que você maximize seus ganhos:
1. Cadastro rápido e sem burocracia: Realize seu cadastro diretamente pelo aplicativo, sem a necessidade de enfrentar filas ou processos demorados. Tudo é feito online e de maneira simplificada para que você possa começar a trabalhar o quanto antes.
2. Flexibilidade de horário: Escolha quando e onde trabalhar, de acordo com sua disponibilidade e preferências. Não há restrições de horários, permitindo que você adapte sua agenda e encontre o equilíbrio perfeito entre vida pessoal e profissional.
3. Sistema de pagamentos seguro: Receba seus pagamentos diretamente em sua conta bancária, sem preocupações. O aplicativo conta com um sistema de pagamentos seguro e eficiente, garantindo que você seja remunerado pelo seu trabalho.
4. Suporte ao motorista: Conte com o apoio da equipe POP para tirar dúvidas, resolver problemas e receber orientações sempre que necessário. Estamos aqui para ajudá-lo a ter sucesso em sua jornada como parceiro.
5. Avaliações e feedbacks: Receba avaliações e comentários dos passageiros após cada corrida, permitindo que você melhore constantemente seu atendimento e se destaque como um motorista de excelência.
6. Promoções e incentivos: Participe de promoções e programas de incentivo exclusivos para motoristas parceiros, aumentando ainda mais seus ganhos e oportunidades.
7. Segurança em primeiro lugar: A plataforma POP move se preocupa com a segurança de seus motoristas e passageiros. Por isso, investimos em tecnologias e recursos que garantem um ambiente seguro e confiável para todos os usuários.
Com o POP driver, você tem a oportunidade de fazer parte de uma comunidade em crescimento, que valoriza o trabalho de seus parceiros e busca sempre oferecer as melhores condições para que você alcance o sucesso. Não perca tempo, baixe o aplicativo agora mesmo e comece a ganhar dinheiro como motorista POP!

bluejetty:00028734:ios.name: World of Goo Remastered
bluejetty:00028734:ios.summary:
Available exclusively for Netflix members.
They're squirmy and curious! Drag and drop living Goo Balls to build everything from bridges to giant tongues in this physics-based puzzle game.
The millions of Goo Balls that live in the beautif
bluejetty:00028734:ios.description:
Available exclusively for Netflix members.
They're squirmy and curious! Drag and drop living Goo Balls to build everything from bridges to giant tongues in this physics-based puzzle game.
The millions of Goo Balls that live in the beautiful World of Goo are curious to explore — but they don't know that they're in a game, or that they're extremely delicious. Connect the Goo Balls to build a wide range of jiggly architecture, including: bridges, cannonballs, and zeppelins. 
This award-winning game, made entirely by two guys, has been praised for its "ingenious-level design" by IGN and named "Game of the Year" by TouchArcade and Metacritic. Be prepared to be charmed by the weird and wonderful World of Goo. 
Features:
• Mysterious Levels: Each level is strange and dangerously beautiful, introducing new puzzles and areas — and the creatures that live in them.
• A Diverse World of Goo Balls: Along the way, undiscovered new species of Goo Ball, each with unique abilities, come together to ooze through reluctant tales of discovery, love, surveillance, beauty, electric power, and the third dimension.
• The Sign Painter: Someone is watching you.
• Build the Tallest Tower in World of Goo Corporation's Mysterious Sandbox: World of Goo Corporation is contractually obligated to state that everyone is a winner and is enthusiastic to celebrate everyone's tower building opportunities equally.
Updates for the Netflix edition: 
• Hi-Res Art for the Modern Age: The original art for this game was designed to look excellent on screens of years past; it's now updated to double the original resolution for a remastered gameplay experience. The Netflix edition also includes support for modern screen sizes. 
• Save Your Progress: Play on your phone or mobile device and track your advancement with cloud save. Each Netflix profile will track progress separately. 
More awards and recognition for World of Goo: 
• Best Design – Academy of Interactive Arts and Sciences
• Best Indie Game – Spike TV Video Game Awards
• Best Downloadable Title – Game Developers Choice Awards
• Best Design – Independent Games Festival
• Technical Excellence – Independent Games Festival
• Game of the Year – Rock Paper Shotgun
• Game of the Year – GameTunnel
• Wii Game of the Year, Best PC Puzzle Game, Best Wii Puzzle Game, Best Artistic Design Wii, Best New IP Wii, Most Innovative Design Wii – IGN
• Puzzler of the Year – Golden Joystick Awards
- Created by 2D BOY.

Get ready to ignite your brain! Unblocky - Color Jam is a vibrant, high-energy evolution of the classic sliding puzzle. If you love deep strategy, satisfying movements, and the thrill of a perfect solve, this is the logic challenge you’ve been waiting for.
The Gameplay: Slide, Solve, Succeed
In this world of tangled paths and vibrant obstacles, your spatial logic is your greatest weapon.
- The Core Objective: You must navigate a crowded board to guide every colored block to its matching exit.
- Tactical Maneuvers: Slide and match to conquer the color block jam by shifting obstacles horizontally and vertically to clear a path.
- The Jam Twist: It’s not just about one block! You’ll need to coordinate multiple colors simultaneously, ensuring no block gets trapped in the crossfire.
Key Features
- Infinite Logic Challenges: Thousands of hand-crafted levels ranging from introductory spatial exercises to expert-level cognitive challenges.
- Level Architect: Design, build, and test your own complex puzzles, then share them with the global community to see who can solve your "impossible" jams.
- Satisfying Physics: Experience buttery-smooth sliding mechanics and crisp, haptic feedback with every move.
- Powerful Boosters: Stuck in a tight spot? Use high-utility boosters to break the jam and keep the momentum going.
- Competitive PvP Mode: When you’re ready for a change of pace, take your skills online and race real players in a real-time battle of speed and logic.
Unblocky - Color Jam is more than a game; it offers a unique synthesis of relaxation and intense mental stimulation. Whether you are solving the world’s most difficult grids or architecting your own, every move is a testament to your strategic prowess.
Are you ready to redefine your limits? Download Unblocky - Color Jam and refine your logic today.

bluejetty:00114475:ios.name: Game Nest - Offline Games
bluejetty:00114475:ios.summary: 102 games in one app — puzzles, board classics, cards, arcade, word games, quizzes, party pickers and everyday tools. All offline. All free. No ads, no sign-up, and nothing to log into. Download once and play anywhere, on a flight, on the s
bluejetty:00114475:ios.description:
102 games in one app — puzzles, board classics, cards, arcade, word games, quizzes, party pickers and everyday tools. All offline. All free. No ads, no sign-up, and nothing to log into. Download once and play anywhere, on a flight, on the subway, or on the sofa with the Wi-Fi off.
【Offline Freedom】
Every one of the 102 games runs with no internet, no account and no data plan. There are no loading screens between you and a game, and nothing you do is interrupted by an ad. Your focus stays on the puzzle in front of you.
【Puzzle & Logic — 21 games】
Sharpen your mind with Sudoku, 2048, Nonogram, Minesweeper and Kakuro, or think in shapes with Ball Sort, Rush Hour, Shikaku, Fillomino and Bridges. Each has clean rules, honest difficulty and a satisfying click when it finally clicks.
【Board & Strategy — 20 games】
The classics you grew up with: Chess, Checkers, Ludo, Backgammon, Gomoku, Go, Mancala, Warships, Dots & Boxes and Snakes & Ladders. Chess ships a full engine with an adjustable strength slider, so it stays a fair fight whatever your level.
【Cards & Solitaire — 10 games】
A proper solitaire cabinet — Solitaire, Spider, FreeCell, Pyramid, TriPeaks, Golf, Yukon and Baker's Dozen — plus Mahjong Solitaire and Memory Match. Deals are solver-checked, so every game you start can actually be won.
【Arcade & Reflex — 12 games】
Quick, twitchy fun: Snake, Tetra Blocks, Brick Breaker, Tower Stack, Whack-a-Mole and a set of reaction and memory tests. Easy to pick up for one round, hard to put down.
【Word & Vocabulary — 10 games】
Word Search, Word Trace, Hangman and Word Ladder for everyday play, with synonym and antonym quizzes to stretch your vocabulary. Great for a calm five minutes or a daily streak.
【Quiz & Learning — 8 games】
Turn downtime into knowledge: world flags and capitals, the periodic table, Roman numerals, number bases, and math and fraction drills. Fun enough for kids, sharp enough for adults.
【Party & Pickers — 15 games】
Settle any decision or start any game night. Bingo and Housie boards with tickets, Spin the Bottle, a two-player Reflex Duel, a team generator and a finger chooser, plus dice, coin flip, spin wheel and random number, card and name pickers.
【Everyday Tools — 6 games】
Genuinely useful extras: a stopwatch and timer, a Pomodoro focus timer, a chess clock, a BMI and calories calculator, a QR code generator and a savings "time to buy" calculator.
【Play Solo or Together】
Face tunable AI opponents with Easy, Medium and Hard for every computer player, pass one device back and forth for pass-and-play, or go online with real-time multiplayer in 16 board games. Joining a friend's room is always free.
【Make It Yours】
Light and dark modes plus a custom theme you color yourself — set your own primary and accent shades, then pick from 15 typefaces. Favorites give one-tap access, every game keeps detailed statistics, and sound and haptics toggle independently. The app speaks 12 languages.
【ONLINE, YOUR CHOICE】
Online features are optional. Multiplayer creates a pseudonymous session only when you create, join or spectate a room, and it does not create a leaderboard profile. That profile is created only when you choose to sync a score and confirm the public name you want displayed.
【Game Nest Pro】
All 102 games and tools stay free forever. Pro adds the Personal Game Studio for your own photos and sounds, private play insights, and online hosting with spectators and saved room presets. Available monthly, yearly, or as a one-time lifetime purchase.
Terms of Use: https://gamenest.voythrix.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://gamenest.voythrix.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00175417:ios.description:
Weedmaps is your complete, all-in-one guide, marketplace, and local dispensary locator. We provide you with the latest industry news, answers to cannabis-related questions, access to local dispensary and product reviews, and the ability to easily order cannabis products from local retailers in regions where weed is legal for medical- or recreational-use across the U.S. and Canada.
As a Weedmaps app user:
GET access to weed deals from local retailers on your favorite cannabis products.
FIND valuable information on cannabis dispensaries near you, including store amenities, hours, contact information, directions, reviews, and upcoming cannabis events.
SHOP our marketplace for your favorite 420 products by using our sorting and filtering feature to browse verified cannabis brands and find flower, concentrates, pre-rolls, edibles, beverages, capsules, topicals, accessories, apparel, grinders, and pipes.
FILTER and COMPARE cannabis products and brands to find the weed and hemp products you want, and browse verified user reviews from our community across strains, edibles, tinctures, concentrates, and more. 
EXPLORE new and popular strains based on your preferences, including genetics (indica, sativa, hybrid), effects, and flavors.
BROWSE interactive maps for local dispensaries and delivery services in your area, and see where you can order for delivery or reserve for in-store or curbside pick-up from your local retailer.
GROW your cannabis knowledge with WM Learn, our cannabis education and news resource for new and experienced users, covering information on cannabis 101, CBD and THC, the endocannabinoid system (how cannabis compounds work in our bodies), marijuana laws, and more.
SAVE your favorite local retailers, products, and strains in the Weedmaps app for quick access later and to get notifications on cannabis deals from your selected favorites.
Founded in 2008, Weedmaps creates the digital common ground for cannabis businesses and consumers to engage.
Weedmaps doesn’t sell or participate in any marijuana-related trades. Features vary by jurisdiction.
Privacy Policy: https://weedmaps.com/legal/privacy
Terms of Use: https://weedmaps.com/legal/terms
You must be 21 or over (or the applicable legal age based on your state), or a qualified registered patient (as applicable), to access and use Weedmaps.

bluejetty:00120174:ios.description:
Do you like fishing? Then come fishing! Get to know 20 kinds of fish such as goldfish, clownfish, Kissing gourami and more while enjoy fishing. 
Fish at 4 different locations
On the ice
Assemble the rod, wrap the fish tape, and tie the hook. Bring the bait and let's go fishing! Dig a hole in the ice, string the bait on the hook, release the fish tape, and wait for the fish to take the bait! Congratulations, you've got a big fish! Drag the rod, wow! What a big goldfish! You are indeed a fishing master! 
At the pond
What to do if the bait runs out? You need to make delicious bait: peel the corn kernels and mix with other ingredients. Scatter the bait in the pond to attract fish. Go and see what you have got! Kissing gourami, carps, and guppies as well as crawfish, crabs, and naughty little frogs! 
On the sea
Wanna go fishing in a ship? Of course! Trim your nets before you set off, and sew new ones! Remember to bring your binoculars. Let's set sailing! Woo! Find the fish with the binoculars, cast the net, and pull back the net. What will you catch this time? Let's find out! 
Under the sea
Dive to the bottom of the sea with your diving suit to discover more fish! Look carefully. Where are the fish hiding? Beside aquatic plants, behind coral reefs, or in the treasure box? Make the most of your power of observation and find them. Can you catch parrotfish, clownfish, and firefish? Aim at them and cast the nets. Give it a try! 
Beside fish, there are all kinds of creatures in the mysterious underwater world, such as shell, conch, crab and more! Let's see what interesting creatures you can catch!
About BabyBus
—————
At BabyBus, we dedicate ourselves to sparking kids' creativity, imagination and curiosity,and designing our products through the kids' perspective to help them explore the world on their own. 
Now BabyBus offers a wide variety of products, videos and other educational content for over 250 million fans from ages 0-8 around the world! We have produced more than 150 children's educational games, 700 children's songs, and animations of various themes spanning the arts, health, and science.

bluejetty:00132580:ios.description:
The newest popular match 3 game SheepNSheep is coming! Compete with players from all over the world! Challenge super difficult puzzle!
Only 0.1% of the players can solve the puzzle and clear the level! It is said that the IQ of those who clear the level is as high as that of Einstein! Come and challenge yourself!
How to play SheepNSheep:
There is a groove below, a total of 7 blocks can be placed in the groove.
Match three tiles with the same pattern. Clicking on tiles automatically places them in the groove below. When there are 3 tiles of the same pattern in the groove, they will be automatically eliminated.
*Note: Up to 7 moves can be used to remove three tiles with the same pattern in each round! If the groove is full of tiles, it means you fail. Every step matters!
Tiles will have many layers. Only after the tiles on the upper layer are eliminated, the blocks on the lower layer can be eliminated.
When there are no tiles on the grass, you have successfully cleared the level!
SheepNSheep FEATURES
►Easy match - Challenge your brain through thousands of mahjong puzzles. classic elimination gameplay. The low difficulty level at the beginning will help you quickly get started, and then puzzles will become challenging! Are you ready? 
►Super difficult puzzle - Only 0.1% of players can clear the level! Will you be one of them? Come and challenge yourself!
►New levels every day - A new level is released every day. The difficulty of the level is random, don't give up, the next Einstein is you!
►Compete with global users - the leaderboard will display the number of players who pass the level in each region, quickly pass the level to occupy the top of the leaderboard, and win the title of "The King of all challengers"!
►Level Mode-Accumulate the number of checkpoints and rank among the best on the real-time updated personal leaderboard.
►Various cute skins - Clear levels to win various skins! More cute free skins are waiting for you!
Come and play, the next Einstein is you! Start your SheepNSheep adventure now!
Join us on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/jhgxJcgSYE
Join us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/sheepnsheep7/

bluejetty:00030445:ios.description:
Things to know before you buy:
* This is a short game: about 90 minutes.
* The background music is anything but medieval. This is by design.
* It’s all a bit weird.
—
Explore what remains of the ancient city of San Francisco and experience dynamic combat in this RPG text game.
What if goblins, ogres, and dragons weren't imagined? What if our ancestors were, unwittingly, foretelling the future? Find yourself in that future, centuries from now, among the ruins of what was once the 21st century – where these terrifying creatures roam freely…
Heavily inspired by modern tabletop RPGs like Dungeon World, this game puts you in the shoes of a young necromancer on a quest. Battle monsters, raise the dead, and explore what remains of the ancient city of San Francisco.
Features:
* Dynamic Combat: Simulated to the level of individual body parts. Cleave off someone’s leg, take it, and bash it over their head! A Natural Language Generation system explains what's happening to you in plain English.
* Make Your Choices with Caution: Every action has consequences! Make a mistake in battle and you could lose recruits in your party.
* A Living, Breathing World: Lots of the text isn't pre-written, but generated. The world continues on without you.
* Quick Gameplay: Hop right into the fray! Experience automatic saving and no loading screens.
This game is a labor of love of a single writer-programmer, Filip Hracek, and a single illustrator, Alec Webb. It is relatively short, and can be finished in about 90 minutes.
The gameplay is closer to tabletop role playing games than to traditional computer RPGs. Instead of presenting you with numbers and graphics, the game tells you what's happening, the same way a dungeon master would. Things are still meticulously tracked in the background, but there are no big tables to look at or tactical maps to read.

bluejetty:00188141:ios.summary: Swamini Vato, Mul Aksharmurti Gunatitanand Swami’s divine discourses, is an ocean of knowledge for spiritual seekers all over the world. This scripture, filled with teachings based on the eternal Vedic Akshar Purushottam Siddhant, is read r
bluejetty:00188141:ios.description:
Swamini Vato, Mul Aksharmurti Gunatitanand Swami’s divine discourses, is an ocean of knowledge for spiritual seekers all over the world. This scripture, filled with teachings based on the eternal Vedic Akshar Purushottam Siddhant, is read regularly by thousands of devotees seeking worldly advice and spiritual wisdom.
With the inspiration and guidance of Param Pujya Mahant Swami Maharaj, and over 25,000 hours of effort by the learned sadhus and experienced volunteers of BAPS, Swamini Vato is being made available in ‘app’ format – delivering the same spiritual wisdom in a modern accessible medium.
Through short-and-simple definitions and easy-to-understand explanations, this app provides a study platform for spiritual seekers looking to better understand the subtleties of Gunatitanand Swami’s talks and apply his teachings to their lives. Utilising current technology, this app meets the needs of today’s spiritual generation by giving them access to ancient wisdom in a modern format – making the study of Swamini Vato a truly enjoyable experience.
The ‘Swamini Vato Study App’ contains easy-to-use features such as:
Simple definitions of vernacular and colloquial words
Clear explanations of phrases and analogies
Compilation of quotations by Bhagwan Swaminarayan and the Guru Parampara, clarifying subtle concepts in Swami’s talks
Interesting introductions to various people, places and scriptures
Historical accounts, Puranic incidents and moral stories referred to in Swami’s talks
Additional information through maps and images
Other helpful options include:
English translation and transliteration to complement the Gujarati text
Audio feature to enhance the reading experience
Recommended reading lists
Subject-wise reading option
Note-taking function
Search option

bluejetty:00015898:ios.description:
We recognize the importance on-going education holds for our clinicians. As a result, the ZimVie Institute offers world-class educational opportunities at learning facilities throughout the world. Our specialty courses focus on current and emerging dental procedures, technology, and products empowering you to exceed the needs of your patients and your practice. ZimVie Dental trains thousands of clinicians on an annual basis worldwide. Our SimLabs allow clinicians to practice real-life case scenarios, in their entirety, on one-of-a-kind, proprietary simulation patients. We now have an online platform where you can register for courses all over the world and access over 100 hours of on-demand videos available all at your fingertips.
Features:
• Stay up to date on ZimVie Institute Educational Opportunities
• Register for ZimVie Institute courses
• Register and view on-demand webcasts right from the app
• Watch technique videos
• Stores all of your future and past courses
• Store your continuing education certificates within the app
About ZVI
ZimVie Institute (ZVI) transforms the traditional classroom into a revolutionary learning facility. Each ZimVie Institute is equipped with the latest tools and advancements in implant dentistry as well as state-of-the-art audio and visual equipment. But what truly makes ZimVie Institute a world leader in dental education is our Simulated Patient Training Laboratory (SimLab).
ZVI’s SimLabs allow clinicians to practice real-life case scenarios, in their entirety, on one-of-a-kind, proprietary simulation patients. During each course, attendees practice multiple procedures on a variety of simulated patients, creating an accelerated learning experience that no other educational facility can replicate. Our industry-leading, advanced surgical cadaver courses also offer clinicians the unique ability to refine their skills by practicing complex procedures on human tissue.

bluejetty:00172664:ios.description:
We all have travelled to various places in our cars, thanks to the highways connecting various cities. Have you ever wondered how these highways are constructed. This game brings you the real adventure gameplay of building these highways. The tasks will be done to extend a highway. All the construction levels are divided into levels and each level is different, you will enjoy playing this game and constructing a highway.
Drive various heavy vehicles like excavators and cranes to dig the ground. Once the digger digs the ground you have to transport the mixer to pour cement and build the pillars. Once the pillars are completed you have to transport the bridge parts and then you have to complete the bridge. These bridges will fill the gap on the road ways.
Once the path is complete you have to build the roads. Driving various trucks to unload the rocks, tar and all the road building stuff after that you have to use the road roller to level the road and finish the road. Once you are done the highway will be ready to use. These levels are completely different and unique.
Features:
* Amazing Unique Game
* Unique Levels
* Many Vehicles to Drive
* Smooth Gameplay
* Adventure Based Game
* Many Addictive Levels
* Smooth Driving Controls

bluejetty:00142168:ios.description:
Pay to park in seconds. With secure methods such as debit or credit cards available for payment and Apple Pay available in most locations, RingGo is the safe, cashless, flexible, and easy solution for your parking needs. 
You can pay with RingGo in more than 500 towns and cities across the UK. Our space availability solution, with its traffic light indicator, shows where spaces are most likely to be found, so you don’t need to circle the block multiple times. 
If you want to use RingGo for business parking, check out our RingGo Corporate service or download your VAT receipts from within the app if you want to pay and claim.
Use the RingGo app to pay to park across London in Westminster, Bexley, Brent, Bromley, City of London, Croydon, Fulham, Hackney, Hammersmith, Haringey, Islington, Kingston, Merton, Redbridge, Richmond, Sutton, Tower Hamlets, and Wandsworth, as well as Birmingham, Bournemouth, Bristol, Cambridge, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Guildford, Manchester, Milton Keynes, Nottingham, Oxford, Plymouth, and Winchester, plus a host of other towns and cities across the UK.
For more information and to see the 500 towns and cities where RingGo is offered for parking, please see our website at www.RingGo.co.uk

[Virtual Walls and Restricted Areas] Set up virtual walls and restricted areas, ready to use and set, so that the robot will not cross the virtual wall or enter the restricted area during cleaning.

[Selected Area Cleaning] (Only applicable to some devices) You can choose to specify a room for cleaning. After selection, only the selected room will be cleaned, and you can clean wherever you want.
[Spot Cleaning] Click on the location to be cleaned on the map, and after clicking Start, the robot will automatically plan the path to the target point and perform local cleaning.

bluejetty:00138447:ios.description:
[Folded Spacetime, Endless Causality - Version Update Announcement]
I. New Story: Folded Spacetime
Time-travel phenomena are occurring frequently, and the butterfly wings of parallel worlds quietly brush across the sea of space-time. The future Morden Army, reduced to "Temporal Assassins" due to the collapse of the Space-Time Gate, appeared above Andrew City without warning. Folded Spacetime, Endless Causality. The future Morden Army, gradually losing their sanity in the void, seems to be resolutely executing some kind of "directive"...
II. New Character: Thea
A member of the Hidden Knowledge Society, codenamed "Snowy Owl." Growing up in the polar blizzards, she deconstructed the Abyss energy in the "Echo Crystal" with her extraordinary sensitivity to light and color. She partners with the information broker "Crow" to explore the mysteries of the Time-space Rift together.
III. New Weapon: Light Sniper Gun
Achieves kilometer-level precise penetration with a Hyper Laser beam, leaving a Whiteflare Trace along its trajectory. With strong impact, it can penetrate Mecha Shields and is highly effective against heavy objectives.
IV. Gameplay Update: Abyssal Cruise
With the appearance of the Space-Time Gate and the future Morden Army, some high-ranking Regular Army officials have considered using space-time technology to achieve world domination. The Space-Time Administration suspects that someone is secretly conducting illegal research and has specially commissioned the Adventurers' Guild to investigate. Eugenia, the president of the Adventurers' Guild, discovered that the "Sea of Time" has recently welcomed a large number of uninvited guests.
The "Sea of Time" is a sea area with many Legendary time travelers passed down since ancient times. It belongs to an active space-time plate and is therefore targeted by illegal researchers. The adventure Team gathers and sets off once again, vowing to nip the conspiracy in the bud!
Join our official communities for more information.

[Folded Spacetime, Endless Causality - Version Update Announcement]

I. New Story: Folded Spacetime
Time-travel phenomena are occurring frequently, and the butterfly wings of parallel worlds quietly brush across the sea of space-time. The future Morden Army, reduced to "Temporal Assassins" due to the collapse of the Space-Time Gate, appeared above Andrew City without warning. Folded Spacetime, Endless Causality. The future Morden Army, gradually losing their sanity in the void, seems to be resolutely executing some kind of "directive"...

II. New Character: Thea
A member of the Hidden Knowledge Society, codenamed "Snowy Owl." Growing up in the polar blizzards, she deconstructed the Abyss energy in the "Echo Crystal" with her extraordinary sensitivity to light and color. She partners with the information broker "Crow" to explore the mysteries of the Time-space Rift together.

III. New Weapon: Light Sniper Gun
Achieves kilometer-level precise penetration with a Hyper Laser beam, leaving a Whiteflare Trace along its trajectory. With strong impact, it can penetrate Mecha Shields and is highly effective against heavy objectives.

IV. Gameplay Update: Abyssal Cruise
With the appearance of the Space-Time Gate and the future Morden Army, some high-ranking Regular Army officials have considered using space-time technology to achieve world domination. The Space-Time Administration suspects that someone is secretly conducting illegal research and has specially commissioned the Adventurers' Guild to investigate. Eugenia, the president of the Adventurers' Guild, discovered that the "Sea of Time" has recently welcomed a large number of uninvited guests.
The "Sea of Time" is a sea area with many Legendary time travelers passed down since ancient times. It belongs to an active space-time plate and is therefore targeted by illegal researchers. The adventure Team gathers and sets off once again, vowing to nip the conspiracy in the bud!
 
Join our official communities for more information.
Discord: https://discord.gg/metalslugawakening
X: @MetalSlugAwaken
YouTube: @MetalSlug_Awakening

- 66 stadiums.
You can now choose the duration of your match: 30, 45 or 60 seconds. You can change it in options.
Ultrafast pace when you need it. 
Stay tuned for new updates coming soon.

bluejetty:00130998:ios.name: Ukulele Tuner - Simple Tuner
bluejetty:00130998:ios.summary: Make every strum start in tune. Ukulele Tuner puts your G C E A strings, reference sounds and a clear pitch needle together in one focused check. Its pitch tracker follows a sustained plucked string through some background noise, helping yo
bluejetty:00130998:ios.description:
Make every strum start in tune. Ukulele Tuner puts your G C E A strings, reference sounds and a clear pitch needle together in one focused check. Its pitch tracker follows a sustained plucked string through some background noise, helping you make small, confident adjustments.
Know your tuning
Use Ukulele Tuner with soprano, concert or tenor instruments set up for re-entrant high-G tuning. The configured notes are G4, C4, E4 and A4: the G string is higher in pitch than the C string. This setup is different from low-G or baritone tuning.
- See the detected note, octave and frequency.
- Follow visual feedback for sharp or flat pitch.
- Tap a string button to hear its reference sound.
- Compare what you hear with the note on the screen.
Precision you can see
Ukulele Tuner shows the note, octave and frequency in hertz. Its cent-based needle helps you move from “almost there” to in tune with small, accurate adjustments. When the sound is too uncertain, the detector waits for a clearer note instead of guessing. Get the best of both approaches: follow the needle or tap a recorded reference and tune by ear.
A simple way to tune by ear
Listen to a reference, pluck the matching string, and make a small adjustment. Ukulele Tuner gives beginners and returning players both a sound to compare and a visual pitch check before practice.
Chromatic mode and A4 settings
Switch to chromatic mode when you want to follow other notes. Set the pitch-detection A4 reference between 430 and 450 Hz, including 432, 440 and 442 Hz. The recorded G C E A sounds are fixed references; they do not change pitch with the A4 setting.
Get ready for your next song
Allow microphone access and play one string at a time. For your most accurate reading, let one string ring clearly near the microphone. If nearby noise drowns out your ukulele, move closer or find a quieter spot. Let the note ring while you watch the needle. Open Ukulele Tuner for a focused high-G check before your next song.
Built on tuner experience
Our tuner apps have helped millions of users. Ukulele Tuner brings that experience to a focused high-G tuning check.

bluejetty:00139780:ios.description:
Find Real Connections, Effortlessly!
Lady first is designed to make dating easier, safer, and more exciting. Our innovative algorithm ensures you find the right match while prioritizing a fun and secure experience.
Empowering Women, Simplifying Dating
lady first puts women in control while offering men a stress-free way to connect. Women can choose to stay anonymous or reveal their profile at their own pace. For added privacy, women can even wear a mask in their profile photo.
Key Features:
* Women in Control – Browse available matches and send connection requests on your terms.
* Anonymous & Safe – Women can choose full or partial anonymity when interacting.
* No Swiping – Men can simply browse and respond to requests, making dating easier.
* Verified Profiles – Build trust and increase your chances of making real connections.
* Live Streaming – Women can go live anytime to engage with potential matches.
A Smarter, Safer Way to Meet
* Women can send connection gestures with or without revealing their identity.
* Men can only send connection gestures with a verified profile photo to maintain authenticity.
* Video calls are permission-based, ensuring only women decide when and with whom they chat.
* Real-time updates on available matches, interactions, and insights make dating more engaging.
Subscription Options:
* $6.99 per week
* $17.99 per month
* $45.99 for 3 months
Payments are securely processed through your iTunes account. Subscriptions auto-renew unless turned off 24 hours before the renewal date. Manage subscriptions via your iTunes settings.
Privacy First: http://theladyfirst.com/privacy.html
Terms & Conditions: http://theladyfirst.com/terms.html
Support & Contact: http://theladyfirst.com

bluejetty:00014218:ios.description:
GanaMóvil es simple, rápido y seguro para realizar transacciones bancarias personales con tu dispositivo móvil.
Consulta tus cuentas y tarjetas de créditos, realiza transferencias a otros bancos, entre cuentas propias, a cuentas de terceros, pago de servicios, pago de instituciones educativas registradas, giros y remesas, pago de préstamos, pago de tarjetas de crédito, administración de tarjetas de débito para compras por internet, países y límites de transacciones.
Además, clientes y usuarios pueden descargar la aplicación móvil para ubicar puntos de atención y revisar tiempos aproximados de espera para escoger la mejor alternativa. Incluye la función para apertura de cuenta de ahorro GanaDoble desde el celular.
Para habilitar el servicio de cliente:
1. Descarga la aplicación desde la tienda autorizada App Store.
2. Ingresa tu código de persona del Banco Ganadero S.A.
3. Solicita la habilitación del servicio en el dispositivo utilizado (puedes habilitar hasta 3 dispositivos móviles).
4. Si dispones del dispositivo de seguridad GanaPin ingresa a tu banca por internet GanaNet en el menú “GanaMóvil” y escoge la opción “Habilitación de dispositivo”. Una vez completes la información solicitada y finalices la habilitación de tu celular podrás ingresar a GanaMóvil con tu código de persona y clave. 
5. Si dispones quieres habilitar un segundo dispositivo, puedes activar el GanaPin Digital desde GanaMóvil y seguir los pasos del punto anterior.
5. Accede a GanaMóvil con tu código de persona y clave de acceso a nuestra plataforma de banca virtual GanaNet.
Consultas sobre cómo habilitar el servicio:
Email: bancoganadero@bg.com.bo
Telf. Contact Center: 800 10 3999
WhatsApp: 72103001
Funciones para clientes y usuarios:
• Puntos de Atención: Localiza oficinas y cajeros automáticos (ATMs) del banco. Además, consulta el tiempo aproximado de espera para atención en caja, ejecutivo de cuenta y plataforma en oficinas próximas a tu ubicación, para comparar la opción más conveniente.
• Apertura de Caja de Ahorro Ganadoble: Permite al usuario solicitar apertura de una caja de ahorro GanaDoble en bolivianos para persona natural de manejo individual desde el dispositivo móvil, registrando información para luego visitar las oficinas y finalizar el contrato.
Aspectos de Seguridad:
Una vez hayas habilitado tu dispositivo, para ingresar a la aplicación deberás utilizar tu código de persona y clave de acceso a la banca virtual GanaNet. Adicionalmente, la pantalla mostrará tu imagen de seguridad (la que previamente seleccionaste en GanaNet o en nuestras oficinas) y la fecha y hora del último acceso a tu GanaMóvil.
La secuencia para efectos de seguridad es:
- Ingresa tu código de persona.
- Verifica si es correcta la imagen de seguridad (la que previamente seleccionaste en GanaNet o en nuestras oficinas); si es la correcta introduce tu contraseña de acceso a GanaMóvil.
- Una vez haya ingresado se mostrará los datos de fecha y hora del último acceso a GanaMóvil.
Si lo requieres, puedes realizar el bloqueo de la aplicación en cualquiera de tus dispositivos registrados, desde GanaNet, llamando al Contact Center o en nuestras oficinas.
-La información de tus operaciones se transmite protegida y no se guarda en tu celular.
Si tienes dudas en temas de seguridad contáctenos por:
Email: bancoganadero@bg.com.bo
GanaNet, GanaMóvil y el isotipo de GanaMóvil son marcas registradas del Banco Ganadero S.A. Bolivia.

bluejetty:00072156:ios.name: American Marksman: 3D Hunting
bluejetty:00072156:ios.summary: American Marksman is a realistic hunting game built for players who want the whole outdoor experience, not just the shot. Track deer, elk, turkey, and wild game across vast open landscapes, hunt alongside your own dog, set up camp, and buil
bluejetty:00072156:ios.description:
American Marksman is a realistic hunting game built for players who want the whole outdoor experience, not just the shot. Track deer, elk, turkey, and wild game across vast open landscapes, hunt alongside your own dog, set up camp, and build the hunting grounds you want to hunt.
Looking for a hunting game that respects the hunt? American Marksman blends sniper hunting games, deer hunting games, wild animal hunting, and open-world outdoor simulation into one experience, with realistic graphics and country you actually want to spend time in.
HUNT REAL GAME
Deer. Elk. Wild turkey. Boar, bear, and wild game across open country. Every animal moves, spooks, and beds down differently, so every hunt plays different. Read the terrain, work the turkey call out to two hundred yards, close the distance, and take the shot when it's there. Bullet time on heart and head shots, with bullet trails you can follow. Or switch to duck hunting mode for fast, timed wingshooting, where every bird on the wing buys you more time on the clock.
BUILD YOUR HUNTING GROUNDS
Purchase your own land in different regions of the country and make it yours. Modify the terrain to suit the way you hunt. Clear shooting lanes, shape the ground, and set up the property the way you want it. This isn't a hunting game on rails, it's your land and your hunt.
HUNT WITH FRIENDS
Join forces in multiplayer and hunt together. Run a coordinated stalk, push game toward your buddy, or call it a day and roleplay instead. Set up camp, explore the wilderness, and go off-roading across the property. The hunt is better together.
GEAR UP
Sniper rifles, shotguns, and realistic hunting gear built for the shot you're taking. Dial in your setup for long-range precision or fast, close work in heavy cover. Upgrade your guns, collect Hall of Fame skins, and build the loadout that matches how you hunt.
WORK YOUR CAREER
Hunt through Career seasons, build your reputation, and earn your way to better ground, better gear, and bigger game. Take on the Platinum bonus hunt each season for tougher animals and a Platinum gun.
MEET SCOUT, YOUR HUNTING DOG
Every hunt is better with a dog. Scout works the field with you, takes commands, searches cover, and holds point when he catches scent. Pick his coat, bring him into the field, and hunt the way it's meant to be done.
EXPLORE THE WILD
Vast open landscapes to roam, from Rocky Mountain timber to wide-open ground. Camp out, glass the ridgeline, or just drive the property and see what's moving. In American Marksman, the outdoors is the game.
Download American Marksman and head into the wild.

bluejetty:00180615:ios.description:
Transform your cherished memories into timeless art with our Photo to Sketch app. Whether it's a special moment captured with your loved ones or a breathtaking landscape, our app allows you to effortlessly convert your photos into stunning hand-drawn sketches.
Experience the joy of artistic expression as our app meticulously recreates every detail of your photo in a delicate and intricate sketch. With advanced AI algorithms, we ensure that each stroke mirrors the original image's nuances, producing remarkable results that will leave you in awe.
Features:
Realistic Sketches: Our app employs cutting-edge AI technology to generate sketches that closely resemble hand-drawn artworks. The level of detail and shading will amaze you.
Easy-to-Use Interface: Transforming your photos is a breeze with our user-friendly interface. Simply import your photo and let the app do the rest.
Customization Options: Tailor your sketches to your liking with adjustable settings for line intensity, shading, and more. Make each sketch as unique as your memories.
Add texts: Add custom texts to your images. Effortlessly move, scale, and rotate the text to achieve the perfect placement on your image.
Canvas Textures for Authenticity: Choose from a selection of high-quality canvas textures that add depth, character and tactile realism to your sketches. Your photos will appear as though they've been masterfully drawn onto genuine canvas, a blend of modern technology and traditional craftsmanship.
Instant Preview: See a preview of your sketch in real-time, allowing you to make adjustments before finalizing your masterpiece.
High-Resolution Export: Once satisfied with your sketch, save it in high resolution and share it with friends and family. It's perfect for creating personalized gifts or decorating your living space with a touch of elegance.
Unleash your creativity and transform your photos into captivating sketches that transcend time. Download our Photo to Sketch app today and turn your digital images into artistic treasures.

bluejetty:00017077:ios.description:
Rokie is an unofficial remote control app for Roku® Streaming Player and Roku TV™ on iPhone and iPad. It features a sleek design, an intuitive interface, and no unnecessary buttons or complicated settings. With this iOS app, accessing movies, and music becomes even simpler and more enjoyable—making you love your Roku even more. Just connect your iOS device and Roku to the same Wi-Fi network, and you're ready to go!
Main Features:
- Automatically detects Roku devices on your Wi-Fi network;
- Large touchpad for easy menu and content navigation;
- Launch Roku channels directly from the app;
Compatibility:
- Rokie is compatible with all Roku models, including Roku 1, Roku 2, Roku 3, Streaming Stick®, Express, Express+, Express 4K+, Premiere, Premiere+, Ultra, and Roku TV.
- Some apps, such as YouTube and Hulu+, use their own on-screen keyboards and do not support input from the iOS keyboard.

bluejetty:00140142:ios.description:
Estude para concursos públicos resolvendo questões de provas anteriores, no seu ritmo e do seu jeito. Monte simulados personalizados, treine com gabarito na hora ou encare uma prova de verdade, e acompanhe sua evolução até a aprovação.
MONTE SEU SIMULADO
Filtre as questões por banca, nível, instituição, disciplina, cargo e estado. O app mostra na hora quantas questões estão disponíveis para cada combinação de filtros.
DOIS MODOS DE RESOLVER
• Modo treino: veja o gabarito e a explicação logo depois de responder cada questão.
• Modo prova: resolva como no dia do concurso, sem gabarito até o fim e com cronômetro.
Durante o simulado, marque questões para revisar depois e elimine as alternativas que você já descartou.
ACOMPANHE SEU DESEMPENHO
Veja questões respondidas, acertos, erros, tempo total e tempo médio por questão. O gráfico de evolução mostra seu aproveitamento dia a dia, para você saber onde precisa melhorar.
REFAÇA E REVISE
Refaça simulados e volte às questões que você errou ou acertou para fixar o conteúdo.
COMPARTILHE SEU RESULTADO
Terminou o simulado? Gere um card com seu aproveitamento e compartilhe com os amigos.
PARA VÁRIAS ÁREAS E CARREIRAS
Português, matemática, raciocínio lógico, direito, conhecimentos gerais e específicos, com questões de concursos de nível fundamental, médio e superior: polícia, prefeituras, saúde, enfermagem, área administrativa e muito mais.
PREMIUM
Com a assinatura Premium você estuda sem anúncios, recebe explicações das questões feitas por inteligência artificial e tem acesso a todos os simulados, inclusive os exclusivos. A assinatura é renovada automaticamente, a menos que seja cancelada pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do período, e pode ser gerenciada nos ajustes da sua conta da loja.
AVISO IMPORTANTE
Este app é uma ferramenta independente de estudos. Não possui vínculo com nenhum órgão do governo nem com as bancas organizadoras, e não representa nenhuma entidade governamental. As questões são de provas públicas de concursos anteriores e servem apenas para prática.

bluejetty:00160921:ios.description:
Available exclusively for Netflix members.
It's the end of the world. The ultra-rich might be headed to Mars. Explore a flooded planet, discover islands and find allies — can you escape in time?
Amid a great climate catastrophe, the flooded region of Hightower has become a kind of safe zone between the two dry regions: the nearly entirely ravaged land of the War Zone, and the fortified city of Alphaville, where the obscenely wealthy live behind giant walls. Rumors that the rich are escaping to Mars abound. Travel a submerged world by boat as a humble survivor — pick up friends, battle insurgents and steal food — all while fighting to find out if the rumors are true. Can you make it onto the rocket in this atmospheric, story-driven adventure?
Features: 
• Explore a rich, story-driven 3D adventure filled with memorable characters, including friends, foes and creatures
• Discover beautiful urban islands and experience new elements of the story
• Engage in turn-based combat with a puzzle-solving twist 
• An exclusive Highwater Pirate Radio soundtrack and original musical performances by in-game characters color an immersive experience!
- Game by Demagog Studio and Rogue Games.

bluejetty:00146781:ios.name: DogLog - Track your dog’s life
bluejetty:00146781:ios.summary: DogLog is an easy-to-use pet care app that makes pet ownership less stressful. It helps dog owners track their pet’s health, coordinates daily pet-related tasks, and lots more! DogLog is great for single pet parents and for families and has
bluejetty:00146781:ios.description:
DogLog is an easy-to-use pet care app that makes pet ownership less stressful. It helps dog owners track their pet’s health, coordinates daily pet-related tasks, and lots more! DogLog is great for single pet parents and for families and has been downloaded by +100,000 pet owners.
PUPPY OWNERS
1) Track your puppy's training.
2) Understand your puppy's potty schedule to get them potty trained.
3) Set reminders for upcoming vaccination and record vaccination dates. 
OWNERS WITH SICK OR ELDERLY PETS
1) Track your pet's symptoms to understand if they are getting better.
2) Share activity and symptoms data with your vet.
3) Set reminders for giving medicine to your pet so you never miss a dose. 
PET SITTERS AND DOG WALKERS
1) Add your pet sitters and walkers to your Pack so all activities get recorded.
2) Pet sitters/walkers can add photos to your Pack so you never miss a moment.
3) Rest assured that your pet is taken care of.
Don't spend any more time wondering if your dog has been taken care of, download DogLog and enjoy the serenity of always knowing how your dog's day is going.
BENEFITS
1. Form a "pack" with your fellow dog caretakers
2. Log activities, such as giving food, going on a walk, and giving medication
3. Add comments to activities to provide extra information
4. Get notified when activities are logged for your pet with alerts. 
5. Create reminders and alerts so you never forget to take care of your pet. 
6. Use the Statistics page to get insights about your dog’s life
7. Share photos and messages to fellow caretakers with just a few taps.
8. Export data to share with your vet
ACTIVITIES YOU CAN LOG: 
- Food
- Water
- Treat
- Walk
- Pee
- Poop
- Sleep
- Teeth brushing
- Grooming
- Training 
- Medicine
- Custom - Anything else you want

Say cheese! You’ve got plenty to smile about with Cheddar.
Your New Favourite Budget App
Organize your transactions accurately into categories with the help of AI so you can finally stop wondering where your money went. See your net cash up front and monitor your cash position with a beautiful net worth chart. Gain insights into your monthly cashflow trends to stay within your budgeting goals. 
Categorizing Transactions with AI
Cheddar’s AI will automatically recommend categories for your transactions, but won’t sort them until you confirm the category with a tap. If the guess is wrong, you can easily correct it – and Cheddar will learn to make the right recommendation the next time!
Budget Burndown Chart
Learn to pace your expense spending with Cheddar’s precise, real-time budgeting burndown chart. Set your expense limits and monitor your spending trajectory down to the penny. Adjust your spending habits with real-time information to stay within your budget limits and make budget informed choices. 
Bottom Line Budgeting
Budgets rarely fit into an itemized spreadsheet, so while Cheddar will categorize your transactions, our core budgeting goal is to help you stay within your total monthly budget. Plotted on a simple budget burndown chart, you can follow your overall money spending and overall income per month to help stay on track and under budget.
Net Cash Chart
When you open Cheddar, your net cash position is front and center. Updated in real-time, you can observe your net money fluctuations as they happen or observe net cash trends over time. Have assets outside of Cheddar’s tracking? Simply adjust as needed using the cash account in settings.

This app features a scrollable, zoomable map that displays: 
• Road Conditions 
• Traffic Speeds 
• Incidents
• Construction
• Road Closures
• Cameras 
• Message Signs
• Rest Areas
• Mountain Passes
• Weather Radar
• Weather Alerts
• Weight Stations
• Truck Ramps
The app also features audio alerts that notify drivers of incidents, construction, road closures, and other road events.

- Unlock and collect a wide range of characters, captivating skins, and powerful weapons.
- Discover breathtaking environments and intricate block-based structures.
- Earn gold and gems to customize and enhance your gallery.
- Join friends and compete in thrilling multiplayer challenges.
- Regular updates with new content, mini games, and rewards.
Download Block Survivor now and unleash your inner adventurer. Seek, hide, and collect your way to victory in this mesmerizing mobile gaming experience. Can you uncover the secrets of the rainbow?

bluejetty:00141932:ios.description:
Transform your body with Calisteniapp, the calisthenics app that adapts training to your level and helps you make real progress.
Build strength, gain muscle, and improve your physique with programs created by professionals, routines that evolve with you, and safe progressions for exercises like pull-ups, handstands, and muscle-ups.
Over 700 exercises, workouts at home or outdoors, and an intelligent system that adjusts training load based on your performance so you can keep progressing without plateaus.
Start training with purpose and stop improvising.
WHAT IS CALISTENIAPP?
Calisteniapp is the calisthenics app that guides you step by step so you can progress safely, even if you’re starting from zero.
Train wherever you want, with or without equipment, and move forward with clear progressions and workouts that evolve with you.
When you start, the app recommends a program based on your level and goal (strength, muscle gain, aesthetics, weight loss, or skills).
WHAT WILL YOU FIND?
► 40+ step-by-step guided training programs
► Skills & tricks: achieve your first pull-up, handstand, muscle-up, front lever, push-ups, back lever, planche, or human flag with guided tutorials
► Stats & tracking: access a workout calendar with session logs or check the muscle map to see which muscle groups you train the most
► Workout builder: create custom routines based on your goal, available time, and exercises
► EVO routines: a more flexible training method that adjusts daily load based on your performance, allowing safe progress without rigid plans
► Challenges: join 21-day training challenges to build strong habits
► Achievements to reward your progress
WHO IS IT FOR?
• Beginners: if you’re starting from scratch, you’ll find fully guided workouts to achieve your first progressions
• Intermediate users: access advanced plans and create your own routines to organize your training calendar
• Physical test preparation: Calisteniapp can help you prepare for fitness exams and physical assessments
WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT?
• Complete calisthenics training for any goal:
 • Build strength and muscle
 • Lose weight
 • Improve your physique and body control
 • Learn new skills (handstand, muscle-up, front lever, etc.)
 • Improve mobility and flexibility
 • Boost endurance and cardio
• Measurable results: track sessions and optimize your progress
• Flexibility: train at home, in the park, or at the gym, with or without a pull-up bar
• Safe calisthenics progressions, step by step
• Continuous improvement: we’re a small, dedicated team improving the app every day

bluejetty:00066374:ios.description:
Boy Howdy's Spider Solitaire is the best Spider Solitaire app ever, and it's 100% FREE!
• Spider Solitaire is an elegant solitaire game where you try to move all the cards into stacks in descending order to clear them from the board
• NEW - optional video tutorial teaches you how to play Spider if you're new to playing!
• Fast and intuitive controls - Just tap on a card or stack and watch as it magically moves where you want it to go!
• You can also drag and drop cards and stacks if you want to!
• Beautiful, easy to read cards!
• No timers at all! Just relax and have fun!
• Unlimited undo support, with no penalties if you want to go back and try things a different way!
• Auto-highlight shows which cards can be moved and which cards are "stuck" under others until you free them up
• 4 difficulty levels of Spider, either using all cards of 1 suit for a fun game, 2 suits for experienced players, and 3 or 4 suits for a super-challenging game
• Global high score leaderboards with Game Center
• Your progress is automatically saved, all the time, so go ahead and take that call or jump out to any other apps - you can come back and pick up playing right where you left off!
• Sounds can be disabled if you want a quiet game
• You can even listen to your own music while you play
Thanks for playing!
Search for Boy Howdy to see all our free games!

bluejetty:00076445:ios.description:
Welcome to the Nuts and Bolts: Wood Screw! In this mind-bending puzzle extravaganza, you're in for a challenge like no other. Your mission? Untangle, sort, and screw those nuts and bolts into their perfect spots to obliterate the stubborn metal or wood plates. Prepare for a brain-blasting adventure where only the sharpest minds can prevail!
HOW TO PLAY:
In the Nuts and Bolts: Wood Screw Puzzle, your task is to tap on the nuts and bolts, skillfully unscrewing them and placing them strategically into empty slots. Your ultimate goal? To conquer and clear all the plates, but beware – this journey is packed with tricky twists and challenging puzzles that will test your every skill. Are you ready to ascend to the rank of the Screw Puzzle Master?
FEATURES:
- Immerse yourself in a world of brain-teasing puzzles and become the master of tap-tastic gameplay.
- Encounter an array of nuts, bolts, and plates in each level, ensuring non-stop excitement.
- Dive into the spine-tingling Halloween-themed levels for an added layer of mystique.
- Challenge yourself with increasingly twisted and perplexing puzzles that will keep your brain cells buzzing.
- Relish the satisfaction of a satisfying block blast that leaves no plate unturned.
- Navigate through exquisitely designed tiles and pin mechanics, enhancing your gaming experience.
- Get hooked on the thrilling sort puzzle that keeps you on the edge of your seat.
- With hundreds of levels, boredom will be a thing of the past as you unravel the mysteries.
BENEFITS:
- Hone your problem-solving skills with intricately designed puzzles.
- Elevate your strategic thinking and planning abilities to a new level.
- Revel in the ultimate satisfaction of mastering each level and becoming the Puzzle Master.
- Find a delightful and engaging way to unwind and relax after a long day.
- Compete with friends to see who can conquer the Twisted Tangle first and claim the title.
- Whether you're a casual gamer or a puzzle-solving enthusiast, this game caters to all.
Join the Nuts and Bolts: Wood Screw today and embark on a quest filled with challenges, twists, and the ultimate brain-blasting experience. Can you sort, screw, and blast your way through this puzzle masterpiece? Download now and seize the title of Screw Puzzle Master!
